# 822, 2026-09-29 - THE RUNG-37 ARM: CMD13 `SEND_STATUS`, BUILT AND PARKED. NOT PRESSED.
#
# **A BUILD STEP. SOMETHING WAS BUILT AND NOTHING WAS SENT.** No `fastboot`, no gate, no runner, no
# press, no device action of any kind; `33e80afe` was never checked for because no press was prepared.
# The rung-37 entry image and its payload were built, the arm was parked with eleven members, readiness
# is 5 of 5 exit 0 and `make check` is exit 0. **The press is the operator's and no press is owed or
# authorized.**
#
# (1) WHAT CHANGED, AND IT IS ONE COMMAND. `src/entry/entry_storage.c` gains `st_send_status` - guarded
# `#if STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE >= 36`, carrying the switch-value/ordinal pair `36 = 37` - and
# `st_cmd_path` calls it ONCE, UNGATED, immediately after `st_select_card`. The ladder's bound at
# `entry_storage.c:130` is raised to `> 36`. **It needs no new mechanism**: a 48-bit response through
# `st_send_command`, the same result struct `st_select_card` uses, and the same R1 decode the body four
# hundred lines below it publishes. `mmc.h:42`'s `MMC_SEND_STATUS 13 /* ac [31:16] RCA R1 */`; the
# vendor's own body is `mmc_ops.c:470-485`, whose only caller in the driver is `mmc_alive` at
# `mmc.c:1724-1727`.
#
# (2) **THE FLAG WORD IS THE ARM, AND IT IS NOT RUNG 36's.** `mmc_ops.c:479` does not send
# `MMC_RSP_R1`. It sends `MMC_RSP_SPI_R2 | MMC_RSP_R1 | MMC_CMD_AC` = `0x80 | 0x100 | 0x15` =
# **`0x195` = 405**. `sdhci.c:1140-1143` reads exactly five bits out of a flag word, and `MMC_RSP_SPI_S1
# 0x80` and `MMC_RSP_SPI_S2 0x100` (measured in `core.h:40`, `:41`, `:70`) are read by NONE of them - so
# 405 and 21 are **two numbers that produce ONE command word, `0x0D1A`**, and the source carries that as
# a `_Static_assert` rather than as a sentence (`ST_SDHCI_CMD_FLAGS(ST_MMC_RSP_R1_SPI) ==
# ST_SDHCI_CMD_FLAGS(ST_MMC_RSP_R1)`). This is `one value, two definitions` met from the SAFE side: the
# two definitions are asserted equal at compile time, and the rung below's clause asserts 21 on CMD7's
# body while this rung's asserts 405 on CMD13's - so neither clause can be satisfied by the other's body.
#
# (3) **THE ENTRY GROUP CROSSED A PAGE BOUNDARY FOR THE FIRST TIME, AND THE BUILD REFUSED UNTIL THE ONE
# PINNED ADDRESS MOVED.** Rung 37's body does not fit inside rung 36's alignment: `xnu_arm_entry.bin`
# went 5,552,764 -> **5,569,148 B (exactly `+0x4000`)** and the exit's `bl __wrap_FlushPoU_Dcache`
# went 2147787480 -> **2147791576 (`+0x1000` exactly)**. The seam-identification clause refused:
# `returns to 2147791580, while entry_trace.c's STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR is 0x8004a2dc`. **The constant is
# re-derived from that measurement - `0x8004a2dc` -> `0x8004b2dc` - and it is a re-derivation and not a
# patch**: the wrapper identifies the one call site it must hook by comparing `lr` with that address,
# and the build compares the constant against the linked image's own disassembly, two independent
# readings of the same quantity. **A wrong constant would be a silent mis-identification at run time**
# (the hook would either let the site through or wrap a different `bl`), which is why the clause refuses
# instead. The class - a kernel address pinned in an entry source - stays owed; this is its first
# measured instance, and it is written into `entry_trace.c`'s own comment rather than into the
# era-stamped paragraphs above it, which still name their own arms' values by design.
#
# (4) **AND THE SEAM CONSTANT WAS NOT THE ONLY PIN THAT BROKE, BECAUSE A SCAN KEYED ON A MNEMONIC IS NOT
# KEYED ON AN INSTRUCTION.** `xnu_entry_819`'s argument-setup scan reads `mov[ \t]+rN, #` - and
# CMD13's flag word 405 DOES NOT FIT IN A `mov`: the compiler emitted `movw r2, #405`, which that
# pattern does not match. The clause refused with `r2 line []` (the SAFE direction: it refused rather
# than reading a stale `mov` from earlier in the body), and all three patterns in the new clause are
# `movw?[ \t]+rN, #`. **The two are one instruction to a reader and different strings to the scanner**,
# and the value that exposed it is the one this rung exists for.
#
# (5) WHAT THE BUILD PROVED, so the park is not just bytes. `build_entry.sh` gained `xnu_entry_822`,
# modelled on `819` and reading the LINKED image: `st_send_status` at **`0x8000efc4`**, one
# `bl <st_send_command>` (disassembly line 98), `r0=#13` (`SEND_STATUS`), `r1=#65536` (`ST_MMC_RCA_1`),
# **`r2=#405`** (`mmc_ops.c:479`'s own word); device accesses in program order, distinct,
# `f982491c:ldr f9824918:ldr f9824914:ldr f9824910:ldr f9824934:str f9824930:ldr f9824934:ldr
# f9824938:ldr f982492e:ldrb f9824924:ldr` - **byte-for-byte the surface rung 36's clause asserts for
# CMD7's body**, which is the point: CMD13 spends no register CMD7 did not; counts include
# `f9824910:ldr=2` and `f9824934:str=2`; **NO byte below any word and NO second word** (48 bits, not
# 136); the image side is EMPTY; `st_cmd_path` calls it once, ungated, **and the clause reads UNGATED
# rather than saying it** - it requires the two instructions above the call to be `mov r0, r5` and
# `bl <st_select_card>`, so a conditional branch between the two commands would be refused; and the five
# cell strings `_sta_state`, `_sta_pre_state`, `_sta_state_held`, `_sta_illegal`, `_sta_err` are in the
# image. `tools/check_response_word_order.py` reads 9 response-reading functions, 0 divergences, with
# `st_send_status` the ninth. All 11 ladder values (0, 11, 12, 18, 20, 21, 30, 33, 34, 35, 36) compile
# `-fsyntax-only` exit 0.
#
# (6) THE FOUR PRE-REGISTERED OUTCOMES, each naming the next act, and the middle two are the pair this
# press is for. `_sta_complete = 1`, `_sta_err = 0`, **`_sta_state = 4` (TRAN)** is CMD7 LANDED - the
# card is in the transfer state and the frontier is the DATA PATH (CMD8's 512-byte read) and nothing
# else. `_sta_complete = 1`, `_sta_err = 0`, **`_sta_state = 3` (STBY)** is CMD7 DID NOT LAND - the card
# answered the command addressed to it and did not move, which makes CMD7's own `3` the state the card
# was in and not the state CMD7 produced, and the next arm is CMD7 again with SOMETHING ELSE moved (the
# measured candidate is `TIMEOUT_CONTROL 0x2E`, still `0x00` on every press this ladder has made).
# `_sta_illegal = 1` (bit 22) is THE CARD REFUSING CMD13, which puts the wall below CMD13 entirely and
# says the RCA this ladder sends is not the address the card answers to. `_sta_complete = 0` with
# `CMD_INHIBIT` asserted is a hang. **AND `_sta_state_held` is the cell that makes the reading a STATE
# rather than a snapshot**: CMD13 changes nothing, so `_sta_state` equalling `_sta_pre_state` (the same
# field of the same format read a few microseconds earlier, from CMD7's own R1) is the EXPECTED
# reading, and a difference is what would need explaining.
#
# (7) **NOTHING IS PRESSED. THE ARM IS PARKED AND NOT ARMED-FOR-PRESS, NO PRESS IS OWED AND NONE IS
# AUTHORIZED, and the press is the operator's.** Its park is in `out/stage90/frozen/armed-storage-
# 054f8269/`; `frozen/` is a RECORD and not a queue, and every other park in it is superseded.

# (8) **THE MEMBERS, ELEVEN, hashed here by hand and never by the build.** The name's suffix `054f8269`

# 823, 2026-09-29 - THE RUNG-37 PRESS. `armed-storage-054f8269` IS SPENT. THE CARD IS IN TRAN.
#
# **A PRESS, under the operator's authorization asked for and given in this session** (asked with the
# arm parked and verified; the answer was "Press rung 37 now"). ONE gate exit 0 / 614 lines, 0 FAIL;
# ONE runner exit 0. `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage, no reboot
# commanded, `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked immediately before the gate
# (neither log carries that check - this session's own reading, named rather than implied). The phone
# returned to Android 29 s after the send (`seen via: adb`).
#
# CAPTURE `out/stage90/captures/rung37-cmd13-20260929-164239-last_kmsg.txt` 658,021 B
# sha `9bbb36951538274b3deae64c988b63a33ef26d4537f5a477f3e55ab8ac601768`; `-gate.log` 52,771 B
# `94dab03adad52d733080ecdcc22c89e38467449018cbc42daa3cc7b86631c9be`; `-run.log` 89,438 B
# `5b0bca3ccfd3f14f4f08732b21c01baa64e8c2ae6e066e945db89c760399ceb2`. **The name's timestamp is the
# moment the capture was WRITTEN**; earlier archives in this directory name the press sequence's start,
# a gate plus a runner earlier - the convention drifted and the doc says which moment its name means.
#
# (1) THE HEADLINE, AND IT IS ROW 1 OF THE ARM'S FOUR. **`_sta_state = 4` = `R1_STATE_TRAN`.** The card
# is in the TRANSFER state - the state from which every data command is legal - and the frontier is no
# longer a state question.
#
# (2) **AND CMD7 LANDED, BY AN ARGUMENT 821 SECTION 5's OBJECTION DOES NOT REACH.** `_sta_pre_state =
# 3` (STBY, from `_sta_resp_pre = 0x00000700`, CMD7's own R1 still in `RESPONSE + 0`) and `_sta_state =
# 4` (TRAN, from `_sta_resp_post = 0x00000900`). 821 section 5 said `R1_STATE_STBY` is ALSO what a CMD7
# that took no effect leaves, so CMD7's own answer cannot separate the two. **CMD13's `4` can**:
# between the sampling that produced the `3` and the one that produced the `4` **exactly one command
# went on the bus** - CMD13 itself, which cannot move a card - and STBY -> TRAN has exactly one
# producer in the JEDEC state machine, a completed `SELECT_CARD`. **Across two independent boots the
# ladder's own cells walk IDENT (2, `_nidx_state`) -> STBY (3, `_sel_state`) -> TRAN (4, `_sta_state`),
# one step per command, with every intermediate reading byte-identical between the boots.**
#
# (3) **AND THE PRESS FALSIFIES ITS OWN PRE-REGISTRATION, WHICH IS THE FINDING.** Rung 37's source
# called `_sta_state_held = 1` the EXPECTED reading - CMD13 cannot move the card, so the two samples
# must agree. Measured: **`_sta_state_held = 0x00000000`.** The premise is right and the conclusion does
# not follow from it: `_sta_pre_state` is the field of CMD7's RESPONSE - the state the card was in
# **when it answered CMD7**, before CMD7's effect - and `_sta_state` is the field of CMD13's response,
# taken after it. **A command that cannot move the card can still read a different value, because the
# field is sampled at response time and something else moved the card in between**; here that something
# is CMD7 itself. It is `one value, two definitions` one level down: "the state field" read as "the
# card's state now" when it is "the card's state when this response was formed" - the same error 819's
# table made about `CSD_STRUCTURE` and the same one 821 section 5 caught CMD3 with. **A `0` in
# `_sta_state_held` is a TRANSITION and not a defect**, and a later `1` would be the thing needing
# explanation.
#
# (4) THE COMMAND, AS IT WENT OUT. `_sta_word = _sta_word_read = 0x00000d1a` (opcode 13 << 8 | the flag
# byte `0x1A`), `_sta_op = 13`, `_sta_arg = _sta_arg_wrote = 0x00010000` (`ST_MMC_RCA_1`),
# `_sta_sent = _sta_calls = _sta_done = 1`. `_sta_complete = 1`, **`_sta_err = 0x00000000` with
# `SDHCI_INT_INDEX` enabled** (`_sta_ena_wrote = 0x000f0001`, `_sta_ena_held = 0x000f8001`), so the
# block's own comparator ran and matched 13; `_sta_timeout = 0`, `_sta_any_polls = _sta_polls =
# 0x000004ed` (1,261) with `_sta_status_any = 1` - the interrupt latched on the FIRST poll;
# `_sta_inhibit_seen = _sta_inhibit_after = _sta_inhibit_timeout = 0`, so the word `0x0D1A` does not hang
# the block. **`_sta_tout_ctl = 0x00`**: `TIMEOUT_CONTROL` is read and has still never been WRITTEN on
# any rung of this ladder.
#
# (5) **THE SPI FLAG WORD, NOW MEASURED ON THE WIRE.** `_sta_flags_driver = 0x00000195` = 405
# (`mmc_ops.c:479`'s `MMC_RSP_SPI_R2 | MMC_RSP_R1 | MMC_CMD_AC`), `_sta_flags_mapped = 0x0000001a` (what
# `sdhci_cmd_to_flags` makes of it - the two SPI bits read by nothing), and `_sta_flags = 0x00000015` =
# 21, the ladder's own `ST_MMC_RSP_R1`. **Three different numbers, one command word `0x0D1A`** - which is
# exactly why the two build clauses assert different immediates on two otherwise identical bodies.
# `_sta_illegal = 0` (the card did not refuse CMD13), `_sta_ready = 1`, `_sta_switch_err = 0`,
# `_sta_exception = 0`, `_sta_resp_moved = 1`, `_sta_resp_is_arg = 0`.
#
# (6) **AND THE THREE UPPER `RESPONSE` REGISTERS DID NOT MOVE THIS TIME - which narrows 821 section 6.**
# `_sta_raw_pre0/1/2 = _sta_raw_post0/1/2` = `0x8a40401e`, `0xffffffef`, `0x0f5903ff` - the CSD's
# ASSEMBLED words, `0x1e` and all - while `RESPONSE + 0` went `0x00000700` -> `0x00000900`. So CMD7's
# four-register movement (821 section 6's unexplained reading) is **a per-boot settling and not a
# per-command behaviour**: at some point in each boot the three upper registers take the CSD's assembled
# values and then stop, and only `RESPONSE + 0` moves per command. **A 48-bit response moves
# `RESPONSE + 0` ALONE, measured twice in two boots** - so "the registers moved, so the frame was read
# into all of them" is a sentence about a 136-bit format and a non-sequitur about this one. The `0x1e`
# is still in no cell in this tree, and this arm still cannot tell a block behaviour from an artifact.
#
# (7) RUNG 36 -> RUNG 37, CELL BY CELL. Storage cells **611 -> 673**; **0 lost, 62 added (all `_sta_`),
# 585 identical, 26 moved**; whole-log cells 1,525 -> 1,587. Every one of the 26 is free-running (poll
# counts, tick counts, the two absolute power-IRQ timestamps, `_pwr_wait_ticks`, and the clock-stability
# counts `_clk_set_cc_polls` 6 -> 19 / `_clk_set_cc_ticks` 92 -> 193 ticks). **Not one decision cell
# moved**: `_cmd1_resp = 0x40ff8080`, `_cid_gate_word = 0xc0ff8080`, `_nidx_resp = 0x00000500`,
# `_nidx_state = 2`, `_csd_structure = 3`, `_csd_mmca_vsn = 4`, `_csd_capacity_blocks = 0x00200000`,
# `_sel_state = 3`, `_sel_word = 0x071A`, `_sel_illegal = 0`, `_sel_err = 0`, `_sel_complete = 1` and
# the CID's four assembled words are identical across both boots. The OS came up exactly as 818
# measured: `BSD root: md0, major 2, minor 0`, the init load returned, pid 1's AST put it in user mode.
# The run ended on the ladder's own deadline: `_post_end_calls = 8`, `_seam_post_end_ticks =
# 0x06ddd000` = 115,200,000, `_post_cntfrq = 0x0124f800` = 19,200,000 -> **6.0000 s**, with
# `fault_addr=0xfa0065c` the known forced ending (`mi4-the-run-ends-at-entry-epilogue`). **Nothing on the
# device changed**: `fastboot boot` only, and CMD13's whole surface is the registers CMD7's body already
# touches.
#
# (8) **WHAT FOLLOWS: THE DATA PATH, AND WHERE THE COMMAND LADDER STOPS.** `mmc.c:1436`'s
# `mmc_select_card` has landed; the driver's own next statement is `mmc.c:1447`'s
# `err = mmc_get_ext_csd(card, &ext_csd)` - **CMD8 `SEND_EXT_CSD`, a 512-byte DATA read**. This image
# has no `sdhci_prepare_data`, no block-size register write, no DMA or PIO path, and `TIMEOUT_CONTROL`
# has never been written; those are MECHANISMS, and the next rung is the first that needs one.
# **CMD16 `SET_BLOCKLEN` is the recommended next rung**: one 48-bit command, no data phase, the driver's
# own prerequisite for the one that transfers, and a shape this ladder has now proved four times.
# Alternatives and their costs: CMD8 itself (the transfer mechanism first); putting the INDEX bit back
# on CMD3 (821 section 8 - one bit, now with a measured precedent); and the runner's own owed
# structural repair (`EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL` is a fallback that must be edited per arm - a step, not an
# edit, because the gate's clause must accept a labelled absence).
#
# **THE ARM IS SPENT AND NOTHING IS ARMED.** Its park stays in
# `out/stage90/frozen/armed-storage-054f8269/` because a park is the record of what was built -
# `frozen/` is a RECORD and NOT a queue, and re-pressing this arm buys nothing that is not above. No
# build has been made since the press.

# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** 「把基础驱动跑起来」 took its largest single step so far - **the card is in

# 824, 2026-09-29 - THE RUNG-38 ARM. `armed-storage-92b6c552`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE.** No press has been made, none is owed and none is
# authorized; `frozen/` is a RECORD and not a queue, and this arm carries an untested DATA PATH -
# the first such a press in this ladder would make - so it is the LAST park in this file that should
# be pressed without the operator asking for it by name.
#
# (1) THE ACT. Rung 38's body is `st_send_ext_csd`, guarded `#if STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE >= 37`,
# called exactly once from `st_cmd_path` on the line below rung 37's CMD13. It is the driver's own
# next statement after `mmc.c:1436`'s `mmc_select_card`: `mmc.c:1447`'s
# `err = mmc_get_ext_csd(card, &ext_csd)` - CMD8 `SEND_EXT_CSD`, a 512-byte READ.
#
# (2) **THE CENTRAL NUMBER IS A DATA-PHASE BIT AND NOT A FLAG.** `mmc_ops.c:263` passes CMD8
# `MMC_RSP_SPI_R1 | MMC_RSP_R1 | MMC_CMD_ADTC` = 181 = 0xB5. The five-bit `sdhci_cmd_to_flags`
# mapping (`sdhci.c:1140-1143`) makes of it byte 0x1A, word 0x081A - and `sdhci.c:1146-1149` ORs
# `SDHCI_CMD_DATA 0x20` when `cmd->data != NULL` (`core.c:338`), so the register word is **0x083A =
# 2106**. Both numbers are asserted by the build, on two different clauses of the same body: one
# requires 2106 to be the word STORED, the other requires 0x081A never to be. That is 714's class
# refused in both directions and not a sentence in a comment.
#
# (3) **AND THE CHANGE REQUIRED A REPAIR TO `st_send_command` ITSELF.** Until this rung the ladder's
# command-word helper took only (opcode, flags) and never ORed `SDHCI_CMD_DATA`, so a data command
# would have gone out with BLOCK_COUNT armed and no DATA bit - the silent failure the file's own
# header predicts. The OR is added under `#if STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE >= 37`, because
# `ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC` and `ST_SDHCI_CMD_DATA` are declared only at this rung and above; below it the
# body compiles to exactly the byte sequence it did before. **MEASURED**: the value-36 build after
# the guard is byte-identical to the spent rung-37 park (`054f8269...`), and the value-37 build is
# byte-identical before and after the guard - so every park below this rung is still reproducible
# from this tree, which is the property a spent park's recheck rests on.
#
# (4) **THE GATE, AND IT IS THE FIRST GATED COMMAND IN FOUR RUNGS.** The body re-reads
# `RESPONSE 0x10` at decision time and refuses with `_ext_gated=1`/`_ext_done=0` unless
# `R1_CURRENT_STATE` (`_ext_gate_state`) is 4 = TRAN - the state the rung-37 press MEASURED. The
# sequence the three gates below use (gate, argument, word) is repeated against a value a press
# produced rather than one this ladder assumed.
#
# (5) **THE TIMEOUT COMES FROM RUNG 35's CARRIED CSD, NOT FROM `RESPONSE`.** m814 rule 4 refuses a
# right shift of a RAW response word, because the four registers and the four words the driver
# assembles from them are different values; so the assembled CSD is CARRIED - `st_csd_words[4]` plus
# `st_csd_words_valid`, bound to rung 35's body by a coverage assertion the build makes (four words
# by coverage, one validity byte) - and the arithmetic is `sdhci_calc_timeout` over TAAC/NSAC,
# doubled to the first count that covers it and capped at `_ext_tout_max`.
#
# (6) THE PIO PATH, IN THE VENDOR'S OWN ORDER: the `RESPONSE` gate read first; `HOST_CONTROL 0x28`;
# the `INT_ENABLE 0x34` window opened and closed; `TIMEOUT_CONTROL 0x2E` written BEFORE `BLOCK_SIZE`
# (`sdhci.c:827-828` above `sdhci.c:831`); `BLOCK_SIZE 0x04 <- 0x7200`, `BLOCK_COUNT 0x06 <- 1`,
# `TRANSFER_MODE 0x0C <- 0x0012`, each written as a halfword and read back; ARGUMENT and COMMAND; 128
# 32-bit reads of `BUFFER 0x20`; then `INT_STATUS 0x30` and `PRESENT_STATE 0x24`. **It adds no
# megabyte and no device**: every register is the controller's own, mapped since rung 14.
#
# (7) **NOTHING IS PRESSED.** The arm is parked and not armed-for-press, no press is owed and none is
# authorized, and **the press is the operator's.** No build has been made since the park.
#
# (8) **THE MEMBERS, ELEVEN, hashed here by hand and never by the build.** The name's suffix
# `92b6c552` is the first eight hex of `xnu_arm_entry.bin`, which is what `check_set_name_rule`
# requires of every `armed-storage-*` set. **The payload switch set is BYTE-IDENTICAL to rungs 23
# through 37** (`6c2b6038...`, `stage90-build-config.txt`, 682 B) - no payload switch moved. The
# entry config `xnu_arm_entry-config.txt` differs from the spent rung-37 arm's in EXACTLY TWO lines:
# the artifact's own hash and `STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE` 36 -> 37. `xnu_arm_entry-sources.txt` moves
# THREE of its 23 content lines - the `STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY_SHA256` line and the hashes of
# `build_entry.sh` and `entry_storage.c`, the two files this rung edits. The entry `.bin` is 5,569,148
# B, the SAME SIZE as the spent arm's despite a larger `.text` (+2,432) and `.bss` (+512): the
# alignment padding the rung-37 body's page move introduced absorbs the growth, and the `.elf` grew
# by 244. **A size comparison is not a value comparison** - the two entry images differ in 685,691 of
# their 5,569,148 bytes - which is why the identity here is the hash and never the size.

# **AND WHAT THIS ARM DOES NOT SETTLE.** It asserts the WORD the block receives and the ORDER of the
# registers it touches, read out of the linked image. It does NOT assert that a 512-byte read
# completes, because no press has been made: `_ext_words_read` (0 or 128), `_ext_w0`/`_ext_w127`
# (the first and last words) and `_ext_sec_count` (the card's own capacity word out of the ext-CSD)
# are the cells the first press of this arm would read, and the timeout cells
# (`_ext_tout_count`, `_ext_timeout_us`, `_ext_timeout_step0`) are the second question - whether the
# driver's own arithmetic, run off a CARRIED CSD rather than a re-read one, produces a count the
# block accepts.
#
# **AND ONE THING THIS ARM DOES NOT DO, WHICH IT COULD HAVE.** It does not put the INDEX bit back on
# CMD3 (821 section 8), it does not move `TIMEOUT_CONTROL` on any command that is not a data command,
# and it does not repair the runner's owed `EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL` fallback - one rung moves one thing,
# and the data path is the frontier the last press named.
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** 「把基础驱动跑起来」 is one command further along in the SOURCE - the first
# rung whose command transfers bytes rather than only frames - but **no transfer has completed, no
# filesystem is reached and no mount is made**, so 「让os可以正常启动并且挂载存储」 is not reached and
# **TWRP-TO-STORAGE STAYS WITHHELD**: the storage it would be written to is the one thing this ladder
# has not got working. The first clause, 「起码要能进入操作系统」, remains met (818 section 1).

# 825, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-38 PRESS. `armed-storage-92b6c552` IS SPENT. THE 512 BYTES ARRIVED.
#
# **A PRESS, under the operator's authorization asked for and given in this session** ("Press rung 38
# now"). ONE gate exit 0 / 0 FAIL, ONE runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; nothing
# written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists, hand-checked immediately before the
# gate. Capture `out/stage90/captures/rung38-cmd8-20260930-005139-last_kmsg.txt` 653,497 B sha

# The phone returned to Android 29 s after the send.
#
# (1) **THE DATA PATH WORKS.** CMD8's OWN R1 is in the register - `_ext_resp = 0x00000900`, state 4 =
# TRAN, illegal 0, ready 1 - so the command completed and the card answered. The word on the wire is
# `_ext_word = _ext_word_read = 0x0000083A` (the DATA bit the arm was built around). The three setup
# registers held: `_ext_blksz = 0x7200`, `_ext_blkcnt = 1`, `_ext_trns = 0x0012`.
#
# (2) **AND THE 512 BYTES ARRIVED.** `st_ext_csd[128]` is `.bss`, zeroed at image start and written
# by NOTHING but this rung's loop; `_ext_words_gated = 0x80`, `_ext_do_read_seen`/`_ext_data_avail_seen`
# = `0x80`, `_ext_ps_first = 0x01f80a06` (DATA_AVAILABLE set) -> `_ext_ps_end = 0x01f80206` (cleared).
# The four fields at bytes 192-215 are non-zero and mutually consistent: `_ext_rev = 7` (eMMC v4),
# `_ext_structure = 2`, `_ext_card_type = 0x57`, **`_ext_sec_count = 0x01d5a000` = 30,777,344 sectors
# x 512 = 15,757,840,128 B ~= 14.68 GiB (a 16 GB part)**. Four independent non-zero fields at four
# offsets is not something a stuck read produces. `_ext_w0 = _ext_w127 = 0` - the card's own zero
# bytes, which is why 824 published them raw beside the decoded fields and not instead of them.
#
# (3) **BUT `_ext_complete = 0` / `_ext_timeout = 1`, AND THE CAUSE IS THIS RUNG'S OWN WINDOW.**
# `_ext_ena_base = 0` and **`_ext_ena_wrote = 0x30`**: the window enabled only `ST_SDHCI_INT_PIO_IRQS`
# (`DATA_AVAIL | SPACE_AVAIL`) and NEVER `SDHCI_INT_RESPONSE` (bit 0) - the enable bit every command
# rung from 23 ORs via `ST_SDHCI_INT_ENABLE_CMD` (`0x000F0001`). rung 37's window wrote `0x000F0001`
# (`_sta_ena_wrote`) and read `_sta_complete = 1`; rung 38 wrote `0x30` and dropped bit 0. `INT_STATUS`
# latches a bit only for the enables in `INT_ENABLE`, so the block latched the ENABLED data bit
# (`_ext_status_after = 0x20`) but never the DISABLED RESPONSE bit - the poll watched `INT_CMD_MASK`
# and ran its full 1.2 s. **`_ext_complete = 0` is NOT "the command did not complete" but "the witness
# was switched off"** - the `mi4-silence-is-a-reading-only-if-success-is-silent` shape turned on the
# arm's own instrumentation. The body's own outcome table pre-registered `_ext_complete = 1` as the
# green light, so the press FALSIFIES its pre-registration, informatively.
#
# (4) **THE REPAIR IS ONE OR.** The rung-38 window must OR `ST_SDHCI_INT_ENABLE_CMD` with the PIO pair
# (`word = int_enable | ST_SDHCI_INT_ENABLE_CMD | ST_SDHCI_INT_PIO_IRQS`), which is also what the
# vendor leaves set for the host's life (`sdhci_init`, `sdhci.c:291-296`, keeps RESPONSE enabled);
# rung 37's restore to 0 is what left rung 38 a zero base to add to. The build can assert the fix
# structurally, requiring the stored window word to carry bit 0.
#
# (5) THE TIMEOUT RAN OFF RUNG 35's CARRIED CSD, not a raw register. `_ext_csd_carried = 1`,

# `_ext_tout_max = 0xF` (the reserved max this host reaches). `TIMEOUT_CONTROL` was READ

# (6) **CONTAINMENT.** Storage cells 673 -> 746; 0 keys lost; 73 added, the ENTIRE `_ext_*` family and

# `out/stage90/frozen/armed-storage-92b6c552/` as a RECORD and not a queue; re-pressing it buys

#
# **A PRESS, made autonomously under the standing instruction to continue until the OS boots.** ONE
# gate exit 0 / 0 FAIL, ONE runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; nothing written;
# `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked immediately before the gate (adb listed only

# `SDHCI_INT_RESPONSE` - so with the enable added the poll breaks on bit 0 instead of running its 1.2 s

# are the two new cells.

# rung-38 press read non-zero now reads 0: `_ext_words_gated = 0` (was `0x80`),
# `_ext_data_avail_seen = 0` (was `0x80`), `_ext_ps_first = 0x01f80206` (DOING_READ set, NO
# `DATA_AVAILABLE 0x800`; was `0x01f80a06`), `_ext_sec_count = 0` (was `0x01d5a000`),
# `_ext_rev`/`_ext_structure` = 0/0 (was 7/2), `_ext_int_status_end = 0x1` (was `0x20`).
# `_ext_doing_read_seen = 0x80` still - the block entered DOING_READ, but the FIFO is empty and the
# loop reads BUFFER UNCONDITIONALLY, so it returns 128 zero words.
#
# (3) **THE MECHANISM IS ONE WAIT WHERE THERE SHOULD BE TWO.** `st_send_command`'s poll returns on the
# CMD_IRQ; the DATA IRQ comes later. rung 38's missing enable made the poll wait its full 1.2 s, and BY
# THE TIME IT RETURNED THE DATA HAD ARRIVED - the read succeeded BY the timeout. rung 39's correct
# enable makes the poll return in microseconds, so the loop runs BEFORE the data arrives and reads 128
# zeros. **The defect that made `_ext_complete = 0` is the only reason rung 38's read worked**; removing
# it (correctly) unmasked a poll-on-the-command-interrupt used as a signal that data is present, where
# the vendor's own `sdhci_transfer_pio` waits inside `while (PRESENT_STATE & SDHCI_DATA_AVAILABLE)`.
#
# (4) **THE NEXT ARM IS A BOUNDED DATA WAIT** between the command's completion and the read loop: poll
# `PRESENT_STATE`'s `DATA_AVAILABLE` (or `INT_STATUS`'s `SDHCI_INT_DATA_AVAIL`) until it sets, bounded
# so a card that never delivers does not hang. A TIME change - no new command, no new register.
#

# 828, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-40 ARM. `armed-storage-f34cf0fb`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE.** No press has been made and none is owed by this file;
# `frozen/` is a RECORD and not a queue. **THIS ARM ADDS THE WAIT THE RUNG-39 PRESS PROVED WAS
# MISSING** - it adds no new command, no new register, no new megabyte and no new device; it re-reads
# the SAME registers rung 38 already reached.
#
# (1) THE ACT. The rung-39 press measured `_ext_complete = 1` (its one-OR repair worked) AND
# `_ext_words_gated = 0` with 128 zero words: with `SDHCI_INT_RESPONSE` enabled the command poll
# returns in MICROSECONDS, so rung 38's read loop - which reads `BUFFER` unconditionally - runs BEFORE
# the card's data arrives. rung 38's missing enable was the only reason its read worked: the 1.2 s
# timeout WAS the wait. **The defect that made `_ext_complete = 0` hid this one.** The repair is the
# vendor's own shape (`sdhci_transfer_pio` reads only inside `while (PRESENT_STATE & DATA_AVAILABLE)`):
# a SECOND pass over the same 128 words, each word gated on `PRESENT_STATE`'s `DATA_AVAILABLE`
# (`0x800`), bounded by `ST_EXT_DATA_TICK_BUDGET` = 384000 ticks (20 ms at 19.2 MHz) so a card that
# never delivers is a READING (`_ext_data_wait_timeout = 1`) and not a hang. The first pass stays
# exactly as rung 38 left it, so `_ext_words_gated` is still that pass's reading and the four new cells
# (`_ext_data_waited`, `_ext_data_wait_timeout`, `_ext_data_gated`, `_ext_data_ticks`) are the second
# pass's.
#
# (2) **THE CLASSIFIER DEFECT THIS ARM FOUND AND FIXED, WHICH IS THE LARGER FINDING.** rung 38's
# build clause asserted `st_send_ext_csd`'s device surface as an EXACT SET that included
# `f9824904:str` - a WORD store to `BLOCK_SIZE 0x04`, which the clause's own text says would clear the
# sibling `BLOCK_COUNT`. It was not a device store at all: it is the 128-word loop's `str r3, [r2, #4]!`
# writing `.bss` (`st_ext_csd`), and the classifier resolved `r2` - loaded by `ldr r2, [pc, #784]` from
# the literal pool - through a STALE `movt rX, #0xf982` left by a DIFFERENT register. **The value-38
# record's `f9824904:str` was a FALSE PASS by coincidence: the high half `0xf982` came from the stale
# `movt` and the low half `0x4904` happened to be in the register's low set.** This arm's rung-40
# second pass allocates registers differently, so the same artifact surfaced as `NODECL-f982-0:str` -
# a false refusal - and the two together exposed the class. **The fix is CLASSIFIER-WIDE** (it is
# `classify_body`, used by every device clause in the file): `[pc, #N]` bases are resolved EXACTLY out
# of the literal pool; a register loaded from the pool carries its value; `mov rD, rS` and
# `add/sub rD, rS, #imm` propagate it; and any other load clears the destination. It changed the
# value-38 body's own resolution to the corrected one, so this arm's clause was reconciled to the
# fixed classifier (the two bodies, old and new, now classify IDENTICALLY - the second pass changed the
# allocator, not the surface). It also proved rung 38's image-side EXACT-SET assertion was allocator-
# dependent, and that assertion is retired here to two sound forms: NO foreign symbol, and `st_ext_csd`
# (the 512-byte buffer the transfer fills) among them.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. The SAME `_ext_*` cells as the rung-39 press, with the one expected
# change: `_ext_words_gated` non-zero AND `_ext_data_gated` non-zero (the second pass read every word
# the first pass could not) beside `_ext_complete = 1` AT THE SAME TIME - the goal the rung-38 and
# rung-39 presses each got exactly half of. `_ext_data_wait_timeout` should be 0 and `_ext_data_ticks`
# should be the small count the wait actually took. If `_ext_data_gated = 0x80` (128 of 128) the data
# path is working end to end and the frontier moves to CMD16 `SET_BLOCKLEN`.
#
# **AND WHAT THIS ARM DOES NOT SETTLE.** It asserts the WAIT EXISTS and is BOUNDED. It does NOT assert
# that a press will complete the transfer: a card that delivers no data is `_ext_data_wait_timeout = 1`
# with whatever arrived, which is a reading and not a success.
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No block read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

#
# 829, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-41 ARM. `armed-storage-af522aca`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and unlike every rung before it, **its content was decided
# by a PRESS.** The rung-40 arm was built, parked and PRESSED (828's own park, `armed-storage-f34cf0fb`,
# now SPENT); this arm is what that press said to change. **IT ADDS NO COMMAND, NO REGISTER, NO MEGABYTE,
# NO DEVICE AND NO CELL: it moves ONE CONSTANT.**
#
# (1) WHAT THE RUNG-40 PRESS MEASURED, AND WHY IT IS A CONTROLLED EXPERIMENT. The arm was built to wait
# for the card's data inside the vendor's own `while (PRESENT_STATE & SDHCI_DATA_AVAILABLE)` gate, and
# it did exactly that - and it TIMED OUT:
#     _ext_data_waited        = 0x00014dff   the whole budget was walked
#     _ext_data_ticks         = 0x0005ddf7   = 384,503 ticks = 20.03 ms at 19.2 MHz
#     _ext_data_wait_timeout  = 1            the bound FIRED, as designed
#     _ext_data_gated         = 0            not one of the 128 words arrived inside 20 ms
#     _ext_data_avail_seen    = 0            the block never raised DATA_AVAILABLE
#     _ext_doing_read_seen    = 0x80         DOING_READ DID set - the block is reading
#     _ext_irq_data           = 0x0270003a   DATA_END|DMA_END|SPACE_AVAIL|DATA_AVAIL|DATA_TIMEOUT|
#                                            DATA_CRC|DATA_END_BIT|ADMA - the vendor's data IRQ set
#     _ext_complete = 1, _ext_resp = 0x00000900 (CMD8's own R1, state 4 = TRAN), _ext_gated = 0,
#     _ext_done = 1  - the COMMAND completed cleanly. Nothing is wrong with the command.
# **AND THE SAME LADDER HAD ALREADY READ THESE BYTES ONCE**: the rung-38 press measured
# `_ext_words_gated = 0x80` (128 of 128), `_ext_data_avail_seen = 0x80`, `_ext_sec_count = 0x01d5a000`
# (~14.68 GiB), `_ext_rev = 7`, `_ext_structure = 2`. Rung 38 and rung 40 differ in ONE enable bit and
# one wait, and rung 38's only advantage is that its command poll waited its full
# `ST_CMD_DONE_TICK_BUDGET` = **1.2 s** before the read loop ran. **So the card's data DOES arrive, it
# just needs longer than 20 ms after the command completes - and 1.2 s is a value two presses bracket as
# sufficient.** The 516 bytes are not held in the FIFO: `_ext_data_avail_seen = 0` at the second pass's
# `PRESENT_STATE` reads says the block had not yet presented the first word.
#
# (2) THE CLASS, AND THE ARITHMETIC THAT WAS WRONG. Rung 40's comment reasoned that "at 400 kHz a
# 512-byte block takes a little over 10 ms to shift out, so 20 ms is generous headroom". **That
# arithmetic was falsified by the press**: `_ext_data_ticks` measured 20.03 ms of WAITING and the block
# was still silent, so the shift is far slower than the nominal 400 kHz implies - a lazy eMMC's EXT_CSD
# read at the identification clock. **The mechanism (gate every word on DATA_AVAILABLE, bound the wait)
# is confirmed correct; only the NUMBER was wrong**, which is why this rung changes the number and
# nothing else. **AND IT IS `[[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]]` IN THE FORM THAT MATTERS**: 20 ms and
# 1.25 s are two readings of "how long the transfer takes", and the code was using the smaller while
# the hardware needed the larger - a bound that is right in shape and wrong in size reads a working data
# path as an absent one.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. The SAME `_ext_*` cells as the rung-40 press, with the expected change:
# `_ext_data_wait_timeout = 0`, `_ext_data_gated` non-zero, `_ext_words_gated` non-zero, and the card's
# own fields back where rung 38 left them - `_ext_sec_count = 0x01d5a000`, `_ext_rev = 7`,
# `_ext_structure = 2`, `_ext_word = _ext_w0` non-zero - all BESIDE `_ext_complete = 1`, which rung 38
# could not have and rung 40 got with the data missing. **An `_ext_data_gated = 0x80` would be the three
# readings rung 38 bungled together at once: command complete AND 512 bytes correct AND no dependence on
# a timeout.** **AND WHAT IT DOES NOT SETTLE:** if the block is silent for a reason other than a slow
# clock, the press is `_ext_data_wait_timeout = 1` again with `_ext_data_ticks ~ 24000000`, which is a
# reading and would name the next rung.
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No block read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 831, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-42 ARM. `armed-storage-3c6803f6`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and it is the FIRST RUNG OF THE DATA PATH, taken because
# the rung-41 press answered the one question that stood in front of it. **IT ADDS ONE COMMAND BODY,
# ONE CALL TO IT, AND NOTHING ELSE.**
#
# (1) WHAT THE RUNG-41 PRESS SETTLED. 830's press measured the card's own 512 EXT_CSD bytes arriving
# inside the gated second pass - `_ext_data_gated = 0x80` (all 128 words), `_ext_data_wait_timeout = 0`,
# `_ext_data_ticks = 0x67ba5` = 22.13 ms, `_ext_sec_count = 0x01d5a000`, `_ext_rev = 7`,
# `_ext_structure = 2` - all beside `_ext_complete = 1` and `_ext_resp = 0x00000900` (CMD8's own R1,
# state 4 = TRAN). The data path works end to end, and the frontier the press named is CMD16.
#
# (2) WHAT THIS RUNG IS, AND WHY IT IS THIS COMMAND. The driver's own next statement after CMD8 is
# `core.c:2588`'s `mmc_set_blocklen(card, 512)`; its command is `mmc.h:50`'s `MMC_SET_BLOCKLEN`
# (opcode 16), its argument is `core.c:2594`'s `cmd.arg = blocklen` (512), and its flags are
# `core.c:2597`'s `MMC_RSP_SPI_R1 | MMC_RSP_R1 | MMC_CMD_AC` = 0x80 | 0x100 | 0x15 = **405**.
# `sdhci.c:1140-1143`'s five-bit mapping of 405 is `0x1A`, so the word the block receives is
# **`0x101A` = 4122** - and the same mapping of CMD13's 405-mapped word is `0x0D1A`, which is why the
# build asserts THIS body stores 0x101A and does NOT store 0x0D1A or the bare mapping 0x081A (714's
# class, refused in both directions). **NO DATA PHASE**: it is CMD13's shape (`st_send_status`) one
# opcode on, on a controller whose command path this ladder has run since rung 11. **Its argument is a
# LENGTH**, the first command in this ladder whose argument is not an address and not a value the card
# returned - which is why its R1 is read for `SDHCI_INT_ILLEGAL_CMD` (bit 22) beside the state: a card
# that will not be told a block length says so there.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. `_blk_complete = 1` with `_blk_err = 0`, `_blk_illegal = 0` and
# `_blk_state = 4` (TRAN) is CMD16 LANDING and moves the frontier to the FIRST SECTOR READ (CMD17 at
# LBA 1, where the self-verifying reading lives: the eight bytes `EFI PART`, or an MBR ending `55 aa`).
# `_blk_illegal = 1` is THE CARD REFUSING `SET_BLOCKLEN`; `_blk_timeout = 1` with `_blk_complete = 0`
# is the bound expiring; `_blk_inhibit_timeout = 1` is a controller that never came idle; `_blk_stale`
# is a latch already dirty before the window opened. **`_blk_state_held` is the arm's own comparison**:
# `_blk_pre_state` is RESPONSE's R1 state before the command and `_blk_state_held` is 1 exactly when it
# equals the response's own - and on the rung-37 press that comparison read 0 where the arm expected 1,
# because the field is SAMPLED AT RESPONSE TIME (m823), so a 0 here is CMD16 having moved the card.
#
# (4) THE BUILD CLAUSE, `xnu_entry_831`. It refuses BOTH directions: the body at 0x8000fc74 must load
# r0 = 16, r1 = 512, r2 = 405 before its `bl`, must be the ONLY place 0x101A is materialized (0x081A and
# 0x0D1A ABSENT), must have the exact device-access set [f9824910:ldr f9824924:ldr f982492e:ldrb
# f9824930:ldr f9824934:ldr/str] with its counts, must have the asserted program order, must make NO
# store to TIMEOUT_CONTROL (#46), must have an EMPTY image side, and `st_cmd_path` must call it exactly
# once UNGATED immediately after `bl <st_send_ext_csd>`. The build's own `xnu_entry_535` clause printed
# `lr == STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR (0x8004b2dc)` and exited 0 - **the entry-group page move did NOT need a
# `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR`/`EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL` move on this arm**, which is the hazard that caught five
# earlier rungs before a press and is re-checked here by the build rather than by a run.
#
# (5) SAFETY. It is `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, no byte of the medium can change: CMD16 is
# `ac [31:16] 512 R1` with NO data phase, no storage write, and no register this image could not
# already reach. The bound on the command poll is `st_send_command`'s own. **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND
# NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and NOT ARMED-FOR-PRESS, and the park is a RECORD and not a queue.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 832, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-43 ARM. `armed-storage-7228e3f9`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and it is THE LADDER'S FIRST READ OF THE MEDIUM ITSELF,
# taken because the rung-42 press answered the one question that stood in front of it. **IT ADDS ONE
# COMMAND BODY, ONE CALL TO IT, ONE 512-BYTE .bss ARRAY, AND NOTHING ELSE.**
#
# (1) WHAT THE RUNG-42 PRESS SETTLED. 832's press measured CMD16 `SET_BLOCKLEN` LANDING on every cell
# the arm was built to move: `_blk_complete = 1`, `_blk_err = 0`, `_blk_illegal = 0`,
# `_blk_state = 4` (TRAN), `_blk_resp = 0x00000900`, `_blk_word = _blk_word_read = 0x101A`,
# `_blk_arg = _blk_arg_wrote = 0x200` (512), `_blk_state_held = 1`, `_blk_resp_moved = 0`. The card is
# in TRAN with a block length set, and the frontier the press named is the FIRST SECTOR READ.
#
# (2) WHAT THIS RUNG IS, AND WHY IT IS THIS COMMAND. `block.c:1770-1829`'s read-request construction,
# the one-block case: `readcmd = MMC_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK` (`:1821`, taken when `brq->data.blocks <= 1`),
# `cmd.arg = blk_rq_pos(req) << 9` for a byte-addressed card (`:1776-1777`), `cmd.flags =
# MMC_RSP_SPI_R1 | MMC_RSP_R1 | MMC_CMD_ADTC` (`:1779`). The command is `mmc.h:51`'s
# `MMC_READ_SINGLE_BLOCK` (opcode 17), the argument is **LBA 1 << 9 = 512**, and the flags are
# 0x80 | 0x15 | 0x20 = **181 = 0xB5** - **the SAME word rung 38 asserts for CMD8**, because both are
# `adtc`. `sdhci.c:1140-1143`'s five-bit mapping is `0x1A`, so the five-bit word is `0x111A` (4378)
# and the word the block's COMMAND register receives is `0x113A` (4410), the `SDHCI_CMD_DATA 0x20`
# ORed in by entry_storage.c:3334's `if (mmc_flags & ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC)`. **IT IS SECTOR 1 AND NOT 0**
# because a GPT puts the eight bytes `EFI PART` at the head of LBA 1: the reading proves itself. **AND
# 512 APPEARS TWICE FOR TWO UNRELATED REASONS** - a LENGTH one rung down and an ADDRESS here - which is
# why entry_storage.c asserts `ST_MMC_READ_BYTEADDR == ST_MMC_BLK_LEN`. It is the first command in
# this ladder whose answer is the CONTENT OF THE MEDIUM rather than a card register, and the first
# whose data phase this ladder reads into its own buffer.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. `_rd_complete = 1` with `_rd_err = 0` and **`_rd_gpt = 1`** is **THE
# MEDIUM ANSWERING AND LBA 1 HOLDING A GPT HEADER** - the partition table this image could then walk.
# `_rd_gpt = 0` with non-zero `_rd_w0`/`_rd_w1` is A SECTOR READ THAT IS NOT GPT (an MBR's boot code,
# or a device not laid out as expected); `_rd_words_gated = 0x80` with `_rd_data_wait_timeout = 0` is
# THE WHOLE SECTOR; `_rd_words_gated = 0` with `_rd_data_wait_timeout = 1` is THE CARD SILENT after a
# completed command (rung 40's row, one command down); `_rd_int_data_err` nonzero is THE TRANSFER
# failing; `_rd_gated = 1` with `_rd_done = 0` is THE PRECONDITION refusing (the card is not in TRAN).
# **`_rd_gpt` IS THE ARM'S OWN DERIVED CELL**: the comparison of the first two words against
# 0x20494645 and 0x54524150, and all four signature halves are asserted in the LINKED IMAGE by the
# clause, so the press reads a check the build took rather than deciding by eye.
#
# (4) THE BUILD CLAUSE, `xnu_entry_832`. It refuses the build unless the body at 0x8000ffac loads
# r0 = 17, r1 = 512, r2 = 181 before its `bl`; materializes BOTH command words (4378 and 4410) and
# NEITHER of CMD16's 4122, CMD8's 2074 and CMD13's 3354; has the device-access set and PROGRAM ORDER
# of rung 38's body EXACTLY (fifteen accesses: RESPONSE, HOST_CONTROL, INT_ENABLE open/readback,
# SIGNAL_ENABLE, TIMEOUT_CONTROL read and written, BLOCK_SIZE/BLOCK_COUNT/TRANSFER_MODE each written

# 834, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-43 PRESS. `armed-storage-7228e3f9` IS SPENT. CMD17'S COMMAND LANDED,
# ITS DATA DID NOT, AND THE DATA-PHASE INHIBIT GUARD IS THE DEFECT.
#
# (1) THE PRESS. A PRESS, made under the standing instruction (`以后不要再问我 直接自动继续`). ONE gate
# exit 0 / 620 lines, 0 FAIL; ONE runner exit 0. `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, nothing written
# to storage, `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked immediately before the gate. The
# phone returned (adb up afterwards). Capture `out/stage90/captures/rung43-cmd17-20260930-0639-last_kmsg.txt`
# 657,994 B `709a80bedb6de0f9e1c5a2f541b366b5b5698cc1c2b167feabb2b6cf7a8c6a50`; gate
# `...-gate.txt` 54,132 B `1b853cec28a08bf85ef061f42741f9f2d8db87ed172445fb8cf8d28257856d97` (620 lines);
# run `...-run.txt` 90,802 B `19b1c285d8ba23a5975bcfb8efc2d820d29c2dc152f80d15f749c24d89949902` (1125
# lines). Archived by hand into out/stage90/captures/.
#
# (2) THE COMMAND LANDED. Every command-side cell moved right: `_rd_sent = 1`, `_rd_calls = 1`,
# `_rd_op = 0x11` (17), `_rd_lba = 1`, `_rd_arg = _rd_arg_wrote = 0x200` (512), `_rd_flags = 0xB5` = 181
# - **the number the clause enforces, so the 0x19D -> 181 fix is now confirmed on hardware** -
# `_rd_flags_mapped = 0x1A`, `_rd_word_bits = 0x111A`, `_rd_word = _rd_word_read = 0x113A`,
# `_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`, `_rd_state = 4` (TRAN), `_rd_resp = 0x00000900`.
#
# (3) THE DATA DID NOT ARRIVE. `_rd_words_gated = 0`, `_rd_data_wait_timeout = 1`,
# `_rd_data_ticks = 0x016e38cf` = 24,000,719 (the full 1.25 s bound), `_rd_int_status_end = 0x1`
# (RESPONSE only - NO DATA_AVAILABLE), `_rd_int_data_avail = 0`, `_rd_int_data_err = 0`,
# `_rd_w0 = _rd_w1 = _rd_w2 = _rd_w3 = _rd_w127 = 0`, `_rd_gpt = 0`. **`_rd_gpt = 0` is NOT "the
# medium is not GPT"** - it is the derived cell reading a buffer nothing filled; `_rd_words_gated`
# beside it is what tells the two apart.
#
# (4) THE DECISIVE COMPARISON IS IN THE SAME LOG. CMD8 runs earlier in the SAME boot and its read
# delivered all 128 words - through RUNG 40's GATED SECOND PASS (`_ext_data_gated = 0x80`,
# `_ext_data_ticks = 0x67bab` = 424,875 = 22.13 ms, `_ext_data_wait_timeout = 0`,
# `_ext_int_status_end = 0x21` = RESPONSE + DATA_AVAIL) - while its rung-38 FIRST pass read
# `_ext_words_gated = 0`. **AND `_ext_int_data_end = 0` SAYS CMD8'S TRANSFER NEVER ENDED AT THE
# BLOCK.** The two data commands are armed IDENTICALLY (`_rd_ena_wrote = _ext_ena_wrote = 0x000f0031`,
# `blksz = 0x7200`, `blkcnt = 1`, `trns = 0x12`, `readback = 0x8000`) and differ in exactly one
# arming cell.
#
# (5) THE DEFECT: THE GUARD IS BIT-0-ONLY AND THE BLOCK ENFORCES BIT 1.
#   `_rd_blkcnt_held = 0` against CMD8's `_ext_blkcnt_held = 1` - **the duplicate `BLOCK_COUNT = 1`
#   write was silently DROPPED.** SDHCI write-protects `BLOCK_COUNT 0x06` while `PRESENT_STATE 0x24`'s
#   **Command Inhibit (DAT)** bit is set, and `_rd_ps_end = _ext_ps_end = 0x01f80206`
#   (bit 1 set) says **CMD8 left `DATA_INHIBIT` set and never cleared it** (no DATA_END; rung 41's
#   press saw the same `_ext_int_status_end = 0x21` and the class was left unread).
#   `ST_SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT` (entry_storage.c:2114) is `0x1` - Command Inhibit (CMD) - and
#   `st_send_command`'s wait tested that ONE bit. **THE VENDOR WAITS ON BOTH BITS FOR A DATA COMMAND**:
#   `sdhci.c:1087` `mask = SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT;` `:1089` `if (cmd->data || (cmd->flags & MMC_RSP_BUSY))`
#   `:1090` `mask |= SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT;` `:1094` `mask &= ~SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT;` (the non-data arm).
#   **CMD17 is `adtc`, so the vendor would have waited on DATA_INHIBIT and this image did not.**
#   THE CHAIN, closed end to end: CMD8 leaves DATA_INHIBIT set -> CMD17's bit-0-only guard issues anyway
#   -> BLOCK_COUNT is write-protected so the write is dropped -> the block runs a one-block read with a
#   count of ZERO -> no DATA_AVAILABLE, no DATA_END, the bound expires, `_rd_gpt = 0`. **Every cell of
#   the failure is a cell the arm published**, and `_rd_blkcnt_held = 0` - read out BEFORE CMD17 was
#   sent - is the one that names it.
#
# (6) ONE DEFECT, NOT TWO. A stale DATA_INHIBIT with a guard that waits on it never reaches the write;
# a guard that ignores it reaches a write only a data-command predecessor can refuse. They are two
# halves of ONE bug, and the fix belongs in the GUARD - the vendor's own rule, and the only place the
# image can REPORT the condition rather than silently act on a stale bit. [[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]]
# one register up: `PRESENT_STATE` bit 1 is one quantity with two readings.
#
# (7) THE NEXT RUNG (44) IS THAT ONE EDIT - `mask = SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT; if (mmc_flags & ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC)
# mask |= SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT;` - with the mask and the entry bit published as cells. Three outcomes:
# the inhibit clears -> the sector arrives; it does not clear -> `inhibit_timeout = 1`, CMD17 is NOT
# sent, and the reading is *CMD8's transfer never ended at the block* (the next defect, one command
# down); and every NON-data rung below keeps the bit-0-only mask (the vendor's `mask &= ~SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT`
# arm), so no pressed arm's evidence moves.
#
# (8) SAFETY. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; `MMC_DATA_READ` (core.h:41) moves bytes
# CARD-TO-HOST, so no byte of the medium can change. **NO PRESS IS OWED BY THIS RECORD and the press is
# the operator's.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no partition table walked, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#
# 835, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-44 ARM. `armed-storage-65824de4`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and it is THE RUNG-43 PRESS'S OWN REPAIR, taken because
# that press answered the data path's first question by refuting the arming write. **IT ADDS NO
# COMMAND, NO REGISTER, NO MEGABYTE, NO DEVICE ACT AND NO NEW IMMEDIATE: it is ONE CONDITIONAL inside
# `st_send_command`'s existing inhibit wait.**
#
# (1) WHAT THE RUNG-43 PRESS SETTLED, AND THE DEFECT IT NAMED. 834's press measured CMD17's command
# LANDING on every command-side cell the arm was built to move (`_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`,
# `_rd_state = 4`, `_rd_flags = 0xB5`, `_rd_word_bits = 0x111A`, `_rd_word = _rd_word_read = 0x113A`)
# with NO DATA (`_rd_words_gated = 0`, `_rd_data_wait_timeout = 1`, `_rd_data_ticks = 0x016e38cf`,
# `_rd_int_status_end = 0x1` - RESPONSE only, `_rd_gpt = 0`). The decisive cell is a SAME-BOOT
# comparison: `_rd_blkcnt_held = 0` against CMD8's `_ext_blkcnt_held = 1` - the duplicate
# `BLOCK_COUNT = 1` write was SILENTLY DROPPED, because SDHCI write-protects `BLOCK_COUNT 0x06` while
# `PRESENT_STATE 0x24`'s **Command Inhibit (DAT)** bit (bit 1) is set, and **CMD8 left that bit set
# and never cleared it** (`_rd_ps_end = _ext_ps_end = 0x01f80206`, bit 1; `_ext_int_data_end = 0`).
# So the block ran a one-block read with a count of ZERO, no DATA_AVAILABLE fired, and the 1.25 s bound
# expired. **THIS IMAGE'S GUARD TESTED BIT 0 ALONE** (`ST_SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT = 0x1`, entry_storage.c:2114,
# at the wait in `st_send_command`), where the vendor waits on BOTH for a data command
# (`sdhci.c:1087-1094`: `mask = SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT; if (cmd->data || (cmd->flags & MMC_RSP_BUSY)) mask |=
# SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT; ... else mask &= ~SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT`). **CMD17 is `adtc`, so the vendor would have
# waited and this image did not.** It is `<mi4-one-value-two-definitions>`' shape one register up:
# `PRESENT_STATE` bit 1 is one quantity with two readings ("the transfer is still active" vs "a read can
# start"), and this ladder's guard read only bit 0 while the hardware enforced bit 1.
#
# (2) WHAT THIS RUNG IS, AND WHY THE FIX BELONGS IN THE GUARD. `st_send_command`'s wait now computes its
# mask as `mask = ST_SDHCI_CMD_INHIBIT (0x1); if ((mmc_flags & ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC) != 0u) mask |=
# ST_SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT (0x2);` and waits on `mask` where the rung-43 image waited on bit 0 alone.
# `ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC` (0x20) is the ladder's own stand-in for the vendor's `cmd->data` - the same bit
# entry_storage.c ORs into the block's COMMAND word as `SDHCI_CMD_DATA`. The vendor's `else mask &=
# ~SDHCI_DATA_INHIBIT` arm is why EVERY NON-DATA RUNG BELOW (CMD13, CMD16) is UNTOUCHED: no pressed arm's
# evidence moves. **THE TWO HALVES ARE ONE DEFECT AND NOT TWO**: a stale `DATA_INHIBIT` with a guard that
# waits on it never reaches the write, and a guard that ignores it reaches a write that only a
# data-command predecessor can refuse - so either alone is harmless and the pair is the bug, and the
# vendor's own rule is the guard's, and a guard is the only place the image can REPORT the condition
# rather than silently act on a stale bit.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. **FOUR NEW CELLS BESIDE THE COMMAND**: `_rd_inhibit_mask` (the mask the
# wait actually used - **0x3 on CMD17**, `0x1` on every non-data rung below), `_rd_inhibit_dat`
# (`ps_before & DATA_INHIBIT` - the bit the old mask ignored, **0x2 if still set at entry**), and
# `_rd_inhibit_before` / `_rd_inhibit_polls` (whether the wait had to run at all). **READ THE ROWS AS
# THE ARM'S OWN TABLE**: `_rd_inhibit_mask = 0x3` is THE DATA COMMAND WAITING ON BOTH BITS - the repair
# in the press; `_rd_inhibit_mask = 0x1` on CMD17 is **THE RUNG-43 IMAGE WEARING THIS ARM'S NAME** (the
# build refuses it, so a press seeing it means the wrong bin); `_rd_inhibit_dat = 0x2` is DATA_INHIBIT
# STILL SET AT CMD17'S ENTRY - the wait had to happen and, with the mask widened, it did; `_rd_inhibit_dat
# = 0` is the bit ALREADY CLEARED (CMD8's transfer ended at the block after all - the defect is
# elsewhere); and a NON-DATA rung reading `_rd_inhibit_mask = 0x1` is what stops `ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC` from
# leaking into a command with no data phase. **THE THREE OUTCOMES ARE ALL SAFE AND ALL READABLE**: the
# inhibit clears within the bound -> CMD17 proceeds and the sector rung 43 asked for arrives here; it
# does not clear -> `inhibit_timeout = 1`, CMD17 is NOT sent, and the reading is *CMD8's transfer never
# formally ended at the block* - the next defect one command down; and CMD16 and every non-data rung
# below are untouched.
#
# (4) THE BUILD CLAUSE, `xnu_entry_835`. It refuses the build unless `st_send_command`'s linked body
# holds (a) the ADTC test `ands rN, rN, #32` (0x20 = MMC_CMD_ADTC), (b) BOTH compiled mask constants
# `moveq #1` (CMD_INHIBIT alone) and `movne #3` (CMD_INHIBIT | DATA_INHIBIT), (c) the DATA_INHIBIT
# extraction `and rN, rN, #2`, (d) at least three stores into the result struct's low slots (the mask,
# the extracted DATA_INHIBIT bit and the CMD_INHIBIT bit are all PUBLISHED), and (e) all four
# `xnu_live_storage_rd_inhibit_*` keys as strings in the linked image - so a bit-0-only mask wearing this
# arm's name is REFUSED at build time, and each missing half names its own defect.
#
# (5) SAFETY. It is `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, **no byte of the medium can change**: CMD17 is
# `adtc [31:0] data addr R1` and `MMC_DATA_READ` (core.h:41) moves bytes CARD-TO-HOST; the sector read is
# one the card's OWN `EXT_CSD_SEC_CNT = 0x01d5a000` says exists; it touches no register this ladder has
# not already reached since rung 38; and the data-phase bound is rung 41's measured-sufficient 1.25 s.
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and NOT ARMED-FOR-PRESS, and the park is
# a RECORD and not a queue.**

# 836, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-44 PRESS. `armed-storage-65824de4` IS SPENT. THE REPAIR IS IN THE PRESS
# (`_rd_inhibit_mask = 0x3`) AND IT WORKED - AND IT FOUND THE DEFECT ONE COMMAND DOWN.
#
# (1) A PRESS, made under the standing instruction. One gate exit 0 / 613 lines, one runner exit 0;
# `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device
# lists hand-checked immediately before the gate; **the phone returned** (adb up, uptime 2 min).
# Capture `out/stage90/captures/rung44-inhibit-20260930-074538-last_kmsg.txt` 649,975 B `7bab8faa...`;
# gate `...-gate.txt` 53,586 B `835a875a...` (613 lines), run `...-run.txt` 90,529 B `b123f6f0...`
# (1121 lines).
#
# (2) THE REPAIR IS IN THE PRESS, AND IT IS THE ARM'S OWN PRE-REGISTERED ROW 2. **`_rd_inhibit_mask =
# 0x3`** - the wait tested `CMD_INHIBIT | DATA_INHIBIT`, so the fix landed (a `0x1` here would have been
# the rung-43 image wearing this arm's name). **`_rd_inhibit_dat = 0x2`** - `DATA_INHIBIT` WAS still set
# at CMD17's entry. **`_rd_inhibit_timeout = 1`**, `_rd_inhibit_polls = 0xa700` (42,752, the full
# budget). **`_rd_inhibit_before = 0`** - `CMD_INHIBIT` (bit 0) was clear and ONLY the data-phase bit was
# set, which is exactly why a bit-0-only guard issued where the vendor would have waited. **`_rd_sent =
# 0`** - CMD17 was NOT issued: `st_send_command` returns with `sent` still 0 on an inhibit timeout, so
# the command that would have hung instead never went out. **The fix did what it was built to do: it
# turned a silent data-phase failure into a named precondition refusal.** And the non-data control is in
# the same log: `_cmd0_inhibit_timeout = _cid_inhibit_timeout = _blk_inhibit_timeout = 0`, so
# `ST_MMC_CMD_ADTC` did NOT leak into the mask for a command with no data phase (the arm's third row).
#
# (3) THE COMMAND CELLS CONFIRM CMD17 WAS ARMED AND THEN WITHHELD. `_rd_op = 0x11` (17),
# `_rd_arg = 0x200` (512), `_rd_flags = 0xB5` (181), `_rd_word_bits = 0x111A`, `_rd_word = 0x113A`,
# `_rd_lba = 1`, `_rd_blksz = 0x7200`, `_rd_trns = 0x12`, `_rd_readback = 0x8000` - and then
# `_rd_word_read = _rd_complete = _rd_state = _rd_resp = 0` (the block's COMMAND register was never
# written and no response came), `_rd_blkcnt_held = 0`. `_rd_gated = 0` with `_rd_done = 1`,
# `_rd_gate_state = 4`, `_rd_gate_resp = 0x900` - **the precondition PASSED (card in TRAN) and the guard
# refused**, the opposite of row 5.
#
# (4) THE DEFECT ONE COMMAND DOWN: CMD8 LEFT THE DATA PATH STUCK. `PRESENT_STATE` is now measured at
# THREE points in one boot and does not move: `_ext_ps_end = _rd_ps_before = _rd_ps_end = 0x01f80206` -
# **bit 1 (DATA_INHIBIT) AND bit 2 (DAT_LINE_ACTIVE) both set**. So this is not merely a stale flag: the
# block's data state machine believes a transfer is in progress and the DAT line is active. CMD8's own
# end cells agree: `_ext_int_status_end = 0x21` (RESPONSE | DATA_AVAILABLE - the data arrived),
# `_ext_int_data_end = 0` (**DATA_END never latched**), `_ext_data_gated = 0x80` (all 128 words read).
# **The two presses are one story and neither is wrong**: 834 measured CMD17's command landing with no
# data and named the guard because the widened mask had not been tried; 836 tried it and it REFUSED,
# which proves the guard correct AND moves the defect one command down. The guard is the instrument that
# finally read it. `mi4-silence-is-a-reading-only-if-success-is-silent` in its cleanest form.
#
# (5) MEASURED VS HYPOTHESIS, NAMED AS SUCH. MEASURED: the two bits set across three samplings, no
# DATA_END latched, and **the window the transfer ran under had DATA_END (bit 1) NOT enabled** -
# `_ext_ena_wrote = 0x000f0031` = `INT_CMD_MASK 0x000f0001 | PIO_IRQS 0x30` (DATA_AVAIL | SPACE_AVAIL),
# bits 1 and 3 clear (`_ext_ena_held = 0x000f8031` differs by bit 15, a chip-ID bit). **HYPOTHESIS, and
# named as one**: that the missing enable IS the cause. It is consistent - a masked-off completion bit
# cannot latch, and `sdhci.c:806-815` enables DATA_END and waits on it - but this press did not test it,
# and the project does not promote a mechanism to a conclusion on consistency. **The class is the one
# rung 38's repair (825) already fixed once on the COMMAND side**: a witness switched off reads exactly
# like a condition that never happened (`INT_RESPONSE` off there, `DATA_END` off here).
#
# (6) THE NEXT RUNG HAS TWO CANDIDATE REPAIRS AND A MEASUREMENT THAT TELLS THEM APART. **(a) ENABLE
# DATA_END in the window** and re-read `INT_STATUS` after CMD8's transfer - if the bits clear, the
# hypothesis is confirmed AND CMD17 can proceed the same boot; **(b) RESET THE DATA LINE**
# (`SOFTWARE_RESET` byte, `SDHCI_RESET_DAT` 0x04, distinct from rung 4's `RESET_ALL` 0x01) before CMD17,
# the driver's own `sdhci_do_reset(host, SDHCI_RESET_DATA)` - if `DATA_INHIBIT` clears, the HOST was the
# holder; if it clears but `DAT_LINE_ACTIVE` stays, the CARD is holding the line, a different defect.
# **(a) is preferred: it is the diagnosis and not the workaround.** Both are safe (`fastboot boot` only,
# nothing flashed, no byte of the medium moves, the card stays in TRAN).
#
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED: the next rung is not yet built, and the press is the
# operator's.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no partition table walked, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 837, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-45 ARM. `armed-storage-f8d91170`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and it is THE RUNG-44 PRESS'S OWN CANDIDATE (a), the
# DIAGNOSIS rather than the workaround. **IT ADDS NO COMMAND, NO CARD REGISTER, NO MEGABYTE AND NO NEW
# DEVICE: ONE body that makes exactly ONE store, to a register this ladder has written on every command
# rung since 23 - one `INT_ENABLE` bit.**
#
# (1) WHAT THE RUNG-44 PRESS LEFT, AND THE HYPOTHESIS IT NAMED. 836's press measured `PRESENT_STATE`
# STUCK across THREE samplings in ONE boot - `_ext_ps_end = _rd_ps_before = _rd_ps_end = 0x01f80206` -
# with **bit 1 (`DATA_INHIBIT`) AND bit 2 (`DAT_LINE_ACTIVE`) both set**, CMD8's `_ext_int_data_end = 0`
# (no `DATA_END` ever latched), and the transfer window's own enable `_ext_ena_wrote = 0x000f0031` =
# `INT_CMD_MASK 0x000f0001 | PIO_IRQS 0x30`, in which **bit 1 (`SDHCI_INT_DATA_END`) is NOT set**. The
# press named the missing enable as a HYPOTHESIS and not a conclusion - a masked-off completion bit
# cannot latch, and `sdhci.c:806-815` (`sdhci_set_transfer_irqs`) enables `DATA_END` and waits on it -
# and the project does not promote a mechanism to a conclusion on consistency.
#
# (2) WHAT THIS RUNG IS. `st_data_end_probe` reads `INT_ENABLE 0x34` (`_de_ena_before`), ORs in
# `SDHCI_INT_DATA_END` (the `orr rN, rN, #2` the clause asserts), writes it back and READS IT
# (`_de_ena_held`), then reads `INT_STATUS` (`_de_int_status`, `_de_data_end`, `_de_data_avail`) and
# `PRESENT_STATE` (`_de_ps`, `_de_dat_line`, `_de_data_inhibit`, `_de_doing_read`), and restores the
# window (`_de_ena_restore` / `_de_ena_readback`, with `_de_ps_end` the state after). **IT SENDS NO
# COMMAND AND RE-ARMS NO TRANSFER**: `DATA_END` is latched by the block at a transfer's own end, so if
# the enable is the reason it never latched then the latch is a LEVEL the block is still asserting, and
# the reading is taken on the state rung 44 left behind. **IT IS THE PRESS'S CANDIDATE (a) AND NOT (b)**:
# a boot that ran both the enable AND the data-state reset could not say which repair cleared the path,
# so THIS arm is the enable ALONE and the reset is the NEXT arm (rung 46), NOT built. **VALUE 44 =
# ORDINAL RUNG 45**, one rung per value.
#
# (3) WHAT THE PRESS WOULD READ. **READ THE ROWS AS THE ARM'S OWN TABLE.** `_de_ena_held = _de_ena_wrote
# = _de_ena_before | 0x2` is THE ENABLE ACCEPTED and bit 1 the bit added - the precondition for either
# verdict; a `_de_ena_held` unequal to it is the store being DROPPED, a block-side reading. `_de_data_end
# = 1` is **THE HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED** - the completion had latched and was invisible only because its
# enable was off, the same shape rung 38's `INT_RESPONSE` repair measured on the COMMAND side one command
# up. `_de_data_end = 0` with `_de_dat_line = 1` is **THE HYPOTHESIS REFUTED AND THE LINE STILL HELD** -
# the enable was not the explanation - and the NEXT arm is the DATA state machine's own reset (rung 46,
# value 45, NOT built). `_de_data_end = 0` with `_de_dat_line = 0` is the block having released the line
# since the rung-44 press - a reading about the medium and not about the enable. **`_de_dat_line` IS THE
# READING NO ENABLE CAN GATE**: `DATA_END` is a LATCH that can be set and cleared, so a clear bit is
# ambiguous, whereas `DAT_LINE_ACTIVE` is the line's own LEVEL - the same kind of quantity
# `CMD_LINE_LEVEL` (bit 24) is.
#
# (4) THE BUILD CLAUSE, `xnu_entry_837`. It refuses the build unless `st_data_end_probe`'s linked body
# holds (a) the `orr rN, rN, #2` that adds `SDHCI_INT_DATA_END` (bit 1), (b) at least two stores and one
# load of `INT_ENABLE 0x34` (base `0xf9824000`, `[rN, #2356]`) - the write AND the read-back - and (c)
# the six `xnu_live_storage_de_*` keys as strings in the linked image - so an enable written without
# being READ BACK, or an enable of the wrong bit, is REFUSED at build time. The clause `xnu_entry_838`
# (the rung-46 reset, `-ge 45`) is present but INERT at this value: rung 46 is not built.
#
# (5) SAFETY. `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed; **the only store in the body is an `INT_ENABLE` bit,
# in a register the ladder has written on every command rung since 23, restored to `_de_ena_before` at
# the exit**; it adds no device and no megabyte; it sends no command, so **no byte of the medium can
# move**, and the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-44
# left them. **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and NOT ARMED-FOR-PRESS, and
# the park is a RECORD and not a queue.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no partition table walked, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#

# 839, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-46 ARM. `armed-storage-cd3d63bf`. PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.
#
# **A BUILD AND A PARK, AND NOTHING ELSE** - and it is THE RUNG-44 PRESS'S OWN CANDIDATE (b), now the
# ONE LEFT BY ELIMINATION. **IT ADDS NO COMMAND, NO CARD REGISTER AND NO NEW DEVICE**: ONE body
# `st_data_reset` that makes ONE byte store to a register rung 4 already writes.
#
# (1) WHY IT IS THIS AND NOT THE ENABLE. The rung-45 press (838) REFUTED candidate (a): the store to
# `INT_ENABLE` took and read back (`_de_ena_wrote = _de_ena_held = 0x00008002`) and the completion still
# did not latch (`_de_data_end = 0`), with the line still held (`_de_dat_line = 1`). So the block's data
# state machine is GENUINELY STUCK, and the only repair left is the one the standard defines for that
# state: RESET IT.
#
# (2) WHAT THIS RUNG IS. `st_data_reset` (gated `#if STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE >= 45`) reads
# `SOFTWARE_RESET 0x2F` (`_dr_was`), writes **`SDHCI_RESET_DATA` 0x04** (`_dr_wrote`) and polls the byte
# for self-clear within `ST_RESET_DATA_TICK_BUDGET` = 1,920,000 CNTVCT ticks = 100 ms at 19,200,000 Hz
# (the vendor's own bound, `sdhci.c:250-260`), publishing `_dr_held_after`, `_dr_polls`, `_dr_ticks` and
# `_dr_timeout` (1 = the byte never self-cleared); then reads `PRESENT_STATE 0x24` (`_dr_ps_before`,
# `_dr_ps_after`, `_dr_dat_line`, `_dr_data_inhibit`), `INT_STATUS 0x30` (`_dr_status_after`) and
# `INT_ENABLE 0x34` (`_dr_ena_after`), and `_dr_done`. **`0x04` IS `RESET_DATA` ALONE** - NOT
# `RESET_ALL` (0x01, which rung 4 writes and which resets the whole host including the clock) and NOT
# `RESET_CMD` (0x02); two `_Static_assert`s pin that distinction. **IT MOVES NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM**:
# `RESET_DATA` has no effect on the card, so the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its
# CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-45 left them.
#
# (3) THE ROWS. **READ THEM AS THE ARM'S OWN TABLE.** `_dr_timeout = 0` with `_dr_dat_line = 0` and
# `_dr_data_inhibit = 0` is **THE HOST WAS THE HOLDER** - the block was stuck on state it owns, the reset
# released it, and the data path is usable, so the NEXT rung is CMD17 again and the sector read.
# `_dr_timeout = 0` with `_dr_dat_line = 1` is **THE LINE IS HELD BY SOMETHING THE HOST DOES NOT OWN** -
# the card, the pad or the pin; a host-controller reset that does not clear `DAT_LINE_ACTIVE` is a reading
# about the CARD, and it moves the frontier off the block entirely. `_dr_timeout = 1` is **THE BLOCK
# REFUSING THE RESET** (`_dr_held_after` is the byte that would not clear) - a block state, not a card
# state.
#
# (4) THE BUILD CLAUSE, `xnu_entry_838` (present but INERT at value 44; THIS build makes it live). It
# refuses the build unless `st_data_reset`'s linked body holds the `mov rN, #4` (`SDHCI_RESET_DATA`), the
# `strb [rN, #47]` store to `SOFTWARE_RESET 0x2F` (base `0xf9824000`) and the six `xnu_live_storage_dr_*`
# keys - so a reset of the wrong bit, or to the wrong register, cannot be built.
#
# (5) SAFETY. `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed; the only store is one host-controller byte in a
# register rung 4 already writes, and it moves no byte of the medium - the card stays in TRAN. **NO PRESS
# HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and NOT ARMED-FOR-PRESS, and the park is a RECORD
# and not a queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no partition table walked, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 840, 2026-09-30 - THE RUNG-46 PRESS. `armed-storage-cd3d63bf` IS SPENT. THE HOST WAS THE HOLDER.
#
# (1) A PRESS, made under the standing instruction. One gate exit 0 / 623 lines, one runner exit 0;
# `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device
# lists hand-checked immediately before the gate; **the phone returned** (adb up afterwards). Capture
# `out/stage90/captures/rung46-reset-20260930-092219-last_kmsg.txt` 650,939 B `872a4d01...`.
#
# (2) THE RESET IS PROVEN. `_dr_was = 0`, `_dr_wrote = 0x04`, **`_dr_held_after = 0`** - the byte
# SELF-CLEARED on the first poll inside the bound (`_dr_polls = 0x100` = 256 polls, `_dr_ticks = 0x827`
# = 2,087 ticks = 108.7 us), so **`_dr_timeout = 0`** and the block ACCEPTED the reset - and the two bits
# stuck across four boot-samples in rungs 44-45 BOTH CLEARED: **`_dr_dat_line = 0`**,
# **`_dr_data_inhibit = 0`**, with `_dr_ps_after = 0x01f80000` against `_dr_ps_before = 0x01f80206`.
# `_dr_status_after = 0`, `_dr_ena_after = 0x00008000`.
#
# (3) THE VERDICT IS THE ARM'S OWN ROW 1: **THE HOST WAS THE HOLDER.** `_dr_timeout = 0` with
# `_dr_dat_line = 0` and `_dr_data_inhibit = 0` - the block's data state machine was stuck on STATE THE
# HOST OWNS, a host-controller reset released it, and the holder was NOT the card, the pad or the pin.
# `PRESENT_STATE` moved `0x01f80206 -> 0x01f80000` in one store, its first movement since rung 43.
#
# (4) THE COMMAND PATH IN THE SAME BOOT IS THE CONTROL, AND THE COUNTER-INTUITIVE READING IS THE
# ORDERING: the widened guard still refused CMD17 (`_rd_inhibit_mask = 0x3`, `_rd_inhibit_dat = 0x2`,
# `_rd_inhibit_timeout = 1`, `_rd_inhibit_polls = 0xa700`, **`_rd_sent = 0`**, `_rd_ps_end = 0x01f80206`)
# **because the reset runs AFTER `st_read_single_block`.** So the same boot released the line and withheld
# the command - one statement of the sequence, not a contradiction.
#
# (5) THE FRONTIER. **THE RESET IS PROVEN AND IT IS PROVEN TOO LATE**: the next rung moves the same
# `st_data_reset` call BEFORE `st_read_single_block` (after the CMD8/SET_BLOCKLEN chain, before CMD17), so
# the sector read runs against the released line. All the repair's safety properties are unchanged - one
# host-controller byte, no command, no byte of the medium - and the card stays in TRAN. **It is NOT yet
# built.**
#
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED: the next rung is not yet built, and the press is the
# operator's.**
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET.** No sector read, no partition table walked, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 843: THE RUNG-48 ARM - THE PROTECTIVE MBR, READ AT LBA 0. ONE CONSTANT
# CHANGED, NO NEW BODY. STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=47, VALUE 47 = ORDINAL RUNG 48.
# **PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.**
#
# WHAT IT IS: the rung-47 press (842) OPENED THE DATA PATH - the whole chain
# CMD0..CMD17 completes on hardware, the transfer clean end to end (response
# 0x900, the full 512 bytes moved, no data error, no timeout) - and measured that
# LBA 1 is NOT a GPT header (`_rd_gpt = 0`, `_rd_w0 = 0xe8f9decb`,
# `_rd_w1 = 0xdee55679`, `_rd_w127 = 0xcb686a68`). So reading LBA 1 was the
# image's self-verifying GUESS, and on this card it is not a GPT header. **The
# frontier is the medium's own layout.**
#
# **RUNG 48 IS `ST_MMC_READ_LBA` 1 -> 0 AND NOTHING ELSE.** The command, the flags,
# the block length CMD16 set, the reset-before-read order and the whole cell set
# are rung 47's byte for byte; only the sector moves, so the byte address becomes
# `0 << 9 = 0`. A GPT disk keeps a PROTECTIVE MBR at LBA 0, and an MBR's own
# signature is `0x55 0xAA` at bytes 510-511 - so LBA 0 turns "not a GPT" into a
# measurement.
#
# THE BUILD CLAUSES ARE THE RUNG, IN THREE PLACES. `xnu_entry_832`'s argument
# clause is SPLIT BY VALUE: the body must load 512 at values <= 46 (LBA 1 << 9)
# and `0` at value 47 (LBA 0 << 9), because a body that forgot the shift would
# produce a complete, error-free transfer of the WRONG sector whose every cell read
# as success (measured on this build: r1 = #0). The new `xnu_entry_843` requires
# the derived cell `_rd_mbr` to be a real comparison - the `#43605` (0xAA55, a
# `movw`) paired with the one `cmp r?, r?, lsr #16` (its high-half extraction), and
# EXACTLY ONE such shift in the body. The `832` narration and the published-key
# list now name `_rd_mbr`/`_rd_sig`.
#
# **AND THE FIRST DRAFT OF 843 WAS REFUSED BY ITS OWN BUILD**: it looked for the
# literal `#127` and an index of 127 on a `uint32_t[128]` is NOT a `movw #127` -
# GCC folds it into a frame-relative `ldr [r?, #1056]`, so the index never appears
# as a literal. The repair asserts THE SHIFT and THE PAIRING, never the index or
# its frame offset (which is a property of the whole function's stack layout and
# would move with any unrelated local).
#
# THE ENTRY-GROUP PAGE MOVE DID NOT FIRE: `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays 0x8004c2dc,
# printed by `xnu_entry_535` in this build. The arm's bin is 5,569,148 bytes - the
# same size as the rung-47 arm's - and its elf is 6,749,440 (the same size: one
# constant changed, no function added).
#
# READ THE ROWS: `_rd_sent = 1` with `_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`,
# `_rd_state = 4` and `_rd_words_gated = 0x80` is THE MBR READ COMPLETED.
# **`_rd_mbr = 1` with `_rd_sig = 0xAA55` is THE MEDIUM IS MBR-PARTITIONED**; and
# `_rd_mbr = 0` with `_rd_sig` anything else is a sector that is neither an MBR
# nor a GPT header (the layout is something this ladder has not yet named).
# `_rd_gpt` is still published and now reads LBA 0's first two words (expected 0 -
# an MBR's boot code is not `EFI PART`), so one log carries BOTH layouts'
# signatures from the same 512 bytes. The negative cell is exact: `_rd_lba = 1`
# with `_rd_arg = 0x200` would be rung 46's arm wearing rung 48's name - a clean
# read of the wrong sector whose `_rd_mbr` came from LBA 1 - which is exactly what
# `832`'s value-47 half refuses.
#
# NOTHING IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a
# RECORD and not a queue. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; CMD17 reads, so
# the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs
# 42-47 left them. **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition table walked, no
# filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#
