# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 844: THE RUNG-48 PRESS - **THE MEDIUM IS MBR-PARTITIONED**. Arm
# `armed-storage-8f0d41fd` (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=47, rung 48) is SPENT.
#
# One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed,
# nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists
# hand-checked immediately before the gate; the phone RETURNED 82 s after the
# send. Capture out/stage90/captures/rung48-mbr-20260930-101755-last_kmsg.txt
# 661,493 B sha256 f06b01dcdbe809f787fb4a7726d1b1ed9d7d084a9ca07abd69ac649ef0082049.
#
# THE CONSTANT MOVED AND THE TRANSFER IS CLEAN. Against the rung-47 press (842),
# in the read's own cells:
#   _rd_lba       1 -> 0        _rd_arg   0x200 -> 0        _rd_arg_wrote 0x200 -> 0
#   _rd_sent = 1     _rd_complete = 1     _rd_err = 0     _rd_state = 4 (TRAN)
#   _rd_words_gated = 0x80 (the whole 512 bytes)     _rd_word_read = 0x113A
#   _rd_data_wait_timeout = 0     _rd_int_data_err = 0     response 0x900
# The command, the flags, the reset-before-read order and the whole cell set are
# rung 47's byte for byte; ONLY THE SECTOR MOVED.
#
# **THE MEDIUM ANSWERED WITH THE MBR SIGNATURE**: _rd_mbr = 1, _rd_sig = 0xAA55,
# _rd_w127 = 0xaa550000 (the sector's own last word - its high half is 0xAA55,
# bytes 510-511 hold 0x55 / 0xAA), _rd_w0.._rd_w3 = 0 (zeroed boot code),
# _rd_gpt = 0 (LBA 0's first two words are not `EFI PART` - expected, an MBR's
# boot code is not a GPT header). So rung 47's "LBA 1 is not a GPT header" is now
# the POSITIVE statement it was reaching for: **THE MEDIUM IS MBR-PARTITIONED**,
# not GPT.
#
# THE FRONTIER IS THE MBR'S OWN PARTITION TABLE: the 4-entry array at bytes
# 446-509 of this same sector (16-byte records - boot flag byte 0, LBA start
# bytes 8-11, length bytes 12-15). The bytes are ALREADY in the image's
# st_read_block, so the next rung parses the partition entries (or reads the
# first partition's own sector); reading LBA 0 again is not needed.
#
# THE STANDING SEAM READING IS UNCHANGED: seam_lr = 0x8004c2dc did NOT move (the
# entry-group page move did not fire), slot_cwe_win / seam_sctlr = 0x30c57879 with
# SCTLR.C clear, slot_post_calls = 0x8, b1 = 0x80482b04. The one FAIL
# (seam_sp not sleh_sp-8) is the reading on EVERY recent arm and not a regression:
# rung 48 changed nothing in the seam path. xnu_entry_abort_entries = 0,
# xnu_entry_failures = 0, xnu_entry_checks = 5.
#
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET**: no partition entry decoded, no filesystem, no mount.
# NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 845: THE RUNG-49 ARM - THE MBR PARTITION TABLE, DECODED OUT OF THE SECTOR
# THE READ ALREADY MOVED. STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=48, VALUE 48 = ORDINAL RUNG 49.
# **PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.**
#
# WHAT IT IS: the rung-48 press (844) MEASURED THE MEDIUM'S LAYOUT - `_rd_mbr = 1`
# with `_rd_sig = 0xAA55`, so **THE MEDIUM IS MBR-PARTITIONED** (bytes 510-511 of
# LBA 0 hold the signature). The partition table is the FOUR 16-BYTE RECORDS at
# bytes 446-509 of THAT SAME SECTOR - already in the image's `st_read_block` - so
# rung 49 **sends NO command, opens NO window, moves NO byte off the medium and
# writes NO register**: it decodes what the read already fetched.
#
# **ITS SAFETY CLAIM IS A NEGATIVE AND THE BUILD MAKES IT STRUCTURAL.** A claim of
# the form "this body does nothing to the device" is only as strong as the check
# that refuses its violation, so `xnu_entry_844` requires EVERY `bl` in
# `st_mbr_parse`'s linked body to be to `entry_live_write`, the cell-publisher, and
# refuses a body containing ANY other callee by name count. If a later edit let the
# parse issue a command, no cell would change and no run would fail - the arm would
# quietly be rung 48 with an extra sector read, and the partition cells would be
# decoded from a sector nobody meant to fetch. Measured on this build: 14 calls, ALL
# to entry_live_write.
#
# **THE RECORD IS NOT WORD-ALIGNED, AND THAT IS THE ONE WAY THIS GOES WRONG
# SILENTLY.** `446 = 4*111 + 2`, so each record's byte 0 (the boot flag) is the HIGH
# half of word `111+4k` and its TYPE byte is the HIGH half of word `112+4k`, while
# the two 32-bit fields the standard puts at bytes 8-11 and 12-15 ARE word-aligned
# at `113+4k` and `114+4k` and read little-endian with NO swizzle. A parser that
# took the type from a word's low byte, or byte-reversed the LBA word, would read a
# plausible but WRONG number and every cell would still read as success.
#
# **THE SIGNATURE IS RE-CHECKED, NOT TRUSTED.** The module re-tests
# `(st_read_block[127] >> 16) & 0xFFFF == 0xAA55` itself and publishes `_pm_sig_ok`;
# the clause refuses a body that walks the table without materializing 43605. A boot
# where the read was gated or errored leaves the buffer holding whatever the
# previous rung left there, and four LBA-looking numbers with no signature test are
# four numbers with no provenance.
#
# **AND THE CALL SITE IS AFTER THE READ.** The clause refuses unless st_cmd_path
# calls st_mbr_parse EXACTLY ONCE and its line falls BELOW `bl <st_read_single_block>`
# - a parse above it would publish a table one boot stale with no cell changing.
#
# THE ENTRY-GROUP PAGE MOVE DID NOT FIRE: `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays 0x8004c2dc,
# printed by `xnu_entry_535` in this build. The arm's bin is 5,569,148 bytes (the
# same size as the rung-47/48 arms'); the elf is 6,749,472 (32 bytes larger than the
# rung-48 arm's 6,749,440: ONE function added, no device access).
#
# READ THE ROWS: `_pm_sig_ok = 1` is THE SECTOR IS AN MBR AND THE FOUR RECORDS ARE A
# TABLE. `_pm_nonzero = 1` with `_pm_index` names the FIRST record whose type byte is
# not zero, and `_pm_nonzero_type`/`_pm_nonzero_first`/`_pm_nonzero_len` give its
# type code and its first LBA and length - **`_pm_nonzero_first` is the sector the
# next rung reads**. `_pm_p0_*` is entry 0's record whatever it is. `_pm_sig_ok = 0`
# is THE SECTOR IS NOT AN MBR (stale/gated read). `_pm_nonzero` ABSENT with
# `_pm_done = 1` is A TABLE WITH NO NON-ZERO TYPE (a protective-only MBR or an empty
# one), which moves the frontier back to the medium's layout.
#
# NOTHING IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a
# RECORD and not a queue. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; the medium is not
# touched at all. **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition's sector read, no
# filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 846: THE RUNG-49 PRESS - **A PROTECTIVE MBR, AND A DECODE DEFECT IN THE ARM.**
# Arm `armed-storage-ee0ab2e6` (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=48, rung 49) is SPENT.
# One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed,
# nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked
# immediately before the gate; **the phone returned**. Capture
# `out/stage90/captures/rung49-mbrpt-20260930-103845-last_kmsg.txt` 662,245 B 0656f5ea...
#
# THE WALK RAN: _pm_called = 1, _pm_sig = 0xAA55, _pm_sig_ok = 1, _pm_entries = 4,
# _pm_done = 1, _pm_nonzero = 1, _pm_index = 0, _pm_nz_active = 0. The first
# non-zero TYPE byte is _pm_nonzero_type = _pm_p0_type = 0x000000EE - **the EFI
# protective-partition type code**, the single entry a GPT disk keeps in its MBR.
# So the medium is **A GPT DISK WEARING A PROTECTIVE MBR**.
#
# **THE ARM'S OWN 32-BIT CELLS ARE WRONG, AND THE CLASS IS ONE VALUE TWO
# DEFINITIONS.** _pm_p0_first = _pm_nonzero_first = 0x0001FFFF and
# _pm_p0_len = _pm_nonzero_len = 0xFFFF0000 are NOT the first LBA and the length.
# The record is at byte 446 + 16k, so the entry's first-LBA field is at record
# offset 8 = **byte 454 + 16k** and its length field at offset 12 = **byte
# 458 + 16k**. 454 = 4*113 + 2 and 458 = 4*114 + 2: **NEITHER IS WORD-ALIGNED**,
# so each field STRADDLES two words:
#   first = ((w[113+4k] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) | ((w[114+4k] & 0xFFFF) << 16)
#   length= ((w[114+4k] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) | ((w[115+4k] & 0xFFFF) << 16)
# My module published first = w[113+4k] and length = w[114+4k] - ONE WHOLE WORD
# EACH, STARTING ONE WORD TOO EARLY. That is why first = 0x0001FFFF: low 16 bits
# are the CHS-last garbage (0xFFFF), high 16 the first LBA's LOW half (0x0001).
# A reader who took 0x0001FFFF for the first LBA would place partition 0 at sector
# 131071 instead of 1.
#
# **THE ERROR WAS IN THE COMMENT** (arm doc 845 section 2, and the module header):
# both asserted the two 32-bit fields "ARE word-aligned - the standard's own gift"
# - a claim in a comment, bound to nothing ([[mi4-a-claim-in-a-comment-is-not-a-check]]).
# I confused "the field's first byte is at a 4-aligned absolute offset" (452 - also
# wrong; it is 454) with "the field fits inside one word". The type byte came out
# right only because byte 450 IS at (w[112] >> 16). **No build clause caught it**:
# xnu_entry_844 proved the body touches no device, the signature is re-checked, and
# the call site is ordered, but NOTHING asserted the byte offsets of the fields it
# decodes.
#
# RE-DERIVED from the arm's OWN two raw words (the arms read the sector correctly;
# only the labels are wrong), entry 0 is: status byte 446 = _pm_p0_active = 0 (not
# bootable); type = 0xEE; **first LBA = 1**; length = 0xFFFFFFFF sectors. So LBA 0
# is an EFI protective MBR whose single entry points at LBA 1 - AND RUNG 47 ALREADY
# READ LBA 1 AND FOUND IT IS NOT `EFI PART`. That tension is the frontier: a
# protective MBR pointing at a non-GPT-header sector is a stale protective MBR or a
# GPT that was overwritten. **Only a re-read of LBA 1 (or LBA 2) settles it.**
#
# THE STANDING SEAM READING IS UNCHANGED: seam_lr = 0x8004c2dc did NOT move;
# abort_entries = 0, xnu_entry_failures = 0, slot_post_calls up to 0x8.
# xnu_live_post_elapsed = 0x09199d73 = 7,951.8 ms - the machine stayed up and idled.
#
# THE FRONTIER IS **A CORRECTED PARTITION DECODE (the straddled fields) PLUS THE
# FIRST PARTITION'S OWN SECTOR**. NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED.
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition's own sector read, no filesystem, no
# mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#
# 847 - the rung-50 arm (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=49, VALUE 49 = ORDINAL RUNG 50):
#
# **THE RUNG-49 PRESS'S OWN TWO OWED READINGS, AND THE ADDRESSING THAT MAKES THE READ'S
# ARGUMENT A SECTOR.** The rung-49 press (846) read a PROTECTIVE MBR and, in the same boot,
# found the arm's own two 32-bit cells were not the fields they name: it published
# `_pm_p0_first = 0x0001FFFF` and `_pm_p0_len = 0xFFFF0000` because the MBR's first-LBA
# field is at byte `454+16k` = `4*113 + 2` and its length at `458+16k` = `4*114 + 2` -
# **neither is word-aligned**, each straddles, and the arm read one whole word each.
#
# The two fields decoded right are:
#   first  = ((w[113+4k] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) | ((w[114+4k] & 0xFFFF) << 16)   -> 1
#   length = ((w[114+4k] >> 16) & 0xFFFF) | ((w[115+4k] & 0xFFFF) << 16)   -> 0xFFFFFFFF
# so entry 0 is an EFI protective partition whose single entry points at **LBA 1** - the
# sector rung 47 read and found is NOT `EFI PART`. **THAT TENSION IS THE FRONTIER**, and the
# addressing answers why the read was at the wrong sector all along.
#
# **THE ADDRESSING.** `mmc.c:344-345`: `if (card->ext_csd.sectors > (2u*1024*1024*1024)/512)
# mmc_card_set_blockaddr(card);` - the threshold is 4,194,304 sectors. This card's
# `_ext_sec_count = 0x01d5a000` = 30,777,344 > threshold, so `mmc_card_blockaddr` is SET and
# `block.c:1777`'s `if (!mmc_card_blockaddr(card)) brq->cmd.arg <<= 9` is NOT applied.
# **Rungs 43-49 sent BYTE addresses where the card wanted SECTORS**: `_rd_arg = 0x200` at
# value 46 was SECTOR 512, not LBA 1. Rung 50 carries the sector as `st_read_lba` with NO
# shift, and `xnu_entry_832` now REFUSES a CMD17 argument that is an immediate or a body that
# shifts it left. New clause `xnu_entry_845` makes the decode's straddle structural in the
# DISASSEMBLY (2+ high-half extractions and 2+ low-half placements across the 21 loads).
#
# **THE ACT IS UNCHANGED ON THE MEDIUM AND UNCHANGED ON THE REGISTERS.** The read is the
# PROTECTIVE MBR again (sector 0); no new command, no new MMIO, no new enable window, no new
# store. `_pm_next_is_arg = 0` at this rung is the reading that says the table was decoded
# from a sector OTHER than the partition it names; the next arm sets the read's sector to
# `_pm_next_sector` and this cell becomes 1. `_rd_cap_agree = 1` is the EXT_CSD count (rung
# 38) and the CSD count (rung 34) agreeing on the sector-addressed class.
#
# The entry-group page move did NOT fire (`STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004c2dc`).
# `STAGE90_XNU_PWR_WAIT_TICKS=384000` is inherited from rung 9 unchanged - 20 ms at this
# device's own 19,200,000 Hz. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and
# not a queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition's own sector
# read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#

# 848: THE RUNG-50 PRESS - **THE MBR TABLE DECODED RIGHT, AND THE SECTOR THE READ ADDRESSES.**
# Arm `armed-storage-28c82f79` (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=49, rung 50) is SPENT.
# One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed,
# nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked
# immediately before the gate; **the phone returned**. Capture
# `out/stage90/captures/rung50-mbrstraddle-20260930-114357-last_kmsg.txt` 654,864 B b2ef6258...
#
# **BOTH OWED READINGS DELIVERED.** The rung-49 press (846) published
# _pm_p0_first = 0x0001FFFF and _pm_p0_len = 0xFFFF0000 - NOT the fields they name.
# THIS press publishes the CORRECTED decode: _pm_p0_first = _pm_nonzero_first = 1,
# _pm_p0_len = _pm_nonzero_len = 0xFFFFFFFF. Entry 0 is unambiguously an EFI
# protective partition pointing at **LBA 1** - status not bootable,
# _pm_p0_type = 0xEE, first LBA 1, length 0xFFFFFFFF sectors. _pm_sig_ok = 1,
# _pm_entries = 4, _pm_done = 1, _pm_index = 0.
#
# **AND THE ADDRESSING IS MEASURED.** _ext_sec_count_carried = _rd_cap = _pm_cap =
# 0x01d5a000 (30,777,344 sectors); _rd_cap_over = 1 (above mmc.c:344's 4,194,304
# threshold); _rd_shift = 0 (block.c:1777's `<< 9` is NOT applied);
# _rd_blockaddr = _pm_sector_addressed = 1 (**the card is SECTOR-addressed**);
# _rd_lba = _rd_arg = 0 with _rd_arg_lba_agree = 1 (the CMD17 argument is the sector
# variable); _pm_next_in_range = 1. **So rungs 43-49 sent BYTE addresses where the
# card wanted SECTORS**: _rd_arg = 0x200 at value 46 was SECTOR 512, not LBA 1;
# the `0` of rungs 47-49 was accidentally correct.
#
# _pm_next_sector = 1 beside _pm_arg_sector = 0 states the tension - the table
# names sector 1, this rung read sector 0 - so _pm_next_is_arg = 0, and the next
# arm sets the read's sector to _pm_next_sector.
#
# **THE HONEST NEGATIVE**: _rd_cap_csd_valid = 0 (the CSD carried from rung 34 did
# not answer), so _rd_cap_agree is ABSENT and the EXT_CSD count is the SINGLE
# producer - published as a single producer, not asserted as agreement.
#
# The read is the PROTECTIVE MBR again (sector 0), so its own cells are unchanged
# and confirm the act: _rd_complete = 1, _rd_mbr = 1, _rd_sig = 0xAA55,
# _rd_state = 4 (TRAN), _rd_w0 = 0. The card is still in TRANSFER across the press,
# exactly as rungs 42-49 left it.
#
# The standing readings are UNCHANGED: seam_lr = 0x8004c2dc did NOT move,
# xnu_live_seam_sctlr = 0x30c57879, abort_entries = 0, the goal's own floor is met
# as in 504/520/533 (pid 1's syscalls, the fixture's 0xfeedface read back).
#
# **ESTABLISHED**: entry 0 is an EFI protective partition at LBA 1, and the card is
# SECTOR-addressed. **NOT ESTABLISHED (the next arm)**: the partition's OWN sector.
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED.** **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no
# partition's own sector read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage withheld.
#
# 849 - the rung-51 arm (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=50, VALUE 50 = ORDINAL RUNG 51):
#
# **THE FIRST PARTITION'S OWN SECTOR - THE READ THAT FINALLY ASKS LBA 1.** The rung-50
# press (848) measured the protective MBR decoded right (`_pm_p0_first = _pm_nonzero_first
# = 1`, `_pm_p0_len = 0xFFFFFFFF`, `_pm_p0_type = _pm_nonzero_type = 0xEE`) AND the
# addressing class (`_rd_cap_over = 1`, `_rd_shift = 0`, `_rd_blockaddr =
# _pm_sector_addressed = 1` - **the card is SECTOR-addressed**). Its own two cells said so:
# `_pm_next_sector = 1` (the sector the table names) beside `_pm_arg_sector = 0` (the
# sector that rung read), so `_pm_next_is_arg = 0`.
#
# **RUNG 51 IS ONE NUMBER.** `st_read_lba` moves 0 -> **1**: the same CMD17, the same flags,
# the same block length CMD16 set, the same reset-before-read order, the same cells - the
# read now addresses the sector the rung-50 decode named. Under this card's sector
# addressing (`block.c:1777`'s `<< 9` NOT taken) the argument IS the sector, so the 1 on
# the bus is LBA 1 and not byte 512. **That is why rungs 43-49 never answered the
# question**: `_rd_arg = 0x200` was SECTOR 512, not LBA 1 - rung 47's "LBA 1" read garbage
# (`_rd_w0 = 0xe8f9decb`) while rung 50's sector 0 read the real MBR.
#
# **THE CELL RUNG 51 EXISTS FOR IS `_rd_gpt`** - published at rung 43, true only when the
# sector begins `EFI PART`, and never yet read on the right sector. `_rd_gpt = 1` is THE
# MEDIUM IS A GPT DISK (the protective MBR was telling the truth); `_rd_gpt = 0` with the
# transfer clean is A SECTOR THAT IS NOT A GPT HEADER, which moves the frontier to LBA 2.
# **AND THE COMPANION CELL FLIPS**: `_pm_next_is_arg` is 0 at value 49 and 1 at value 50 -
# it says the sector this rung read and the sector the decode named are the SAME NUMBER.
#
# **THE NUMBER IS A BUILD REFUSAL, NOT A SENTENCE.** New clause `xnu_entry_849` reads, out
# of the linked disassembly, the instruction that FILLS `st_read_lba` - found by the same
# `[base, #off]` the argument load used (already resolved to the `st_read_lba` SYMBOL by
# `xnu_entry_832`) - and refuses unless its immediate is **1** and the store is ABOVE the
# load in program order. So "a variable, at the right address, holding the table's own
# sector, stored before it is read" cannot be satisfied by an edit that leaves every cell
# reading as success. The value-49 half of `xnu_entry_832` still holds the variable's kind,
# its symbol and the shift's absence.
#
# **THE ACT IS UNCHANGED ON THE MEDIUM AND UNCHANGED ON THE REGISTERS.** CMD17 reads, so the
# card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-50 left
# them; only the sector NUMBER moves. The entry bin is the SAME 5,569,148 bytes (the change
# is one immediate in one instruction).
#
# The entry-group page move did NOT fire (`STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004c2dc`).
# `STAGE90_XNU_PWR_WAIT_TICKS=384000` is inherited from rung 9 unchanged - 20 ms at this
# device's own 19,200,000 Hz. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and
# not a queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - the partition's own
# sector read is the arm, not yet a reading; no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays
# withheld.
#

# 850: THE RUNG-51 PRESS - **LBA 1 BEGINS `EFI PART` - THE MEDIUM IS A GPT DISK.**
# Arm `armed-storage-960c57c4` (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=50, rung 51) is SPENT.
# One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot` only, nothing flashed,
# nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists hand-checked
# immediately before the gate; **the phone returned**. Capture
# `out/stage90/captures/rung51-lba1gpt-20260930-120713-last_kmsg.txt` 655,146 B 364105d7...
#
# **THE ANSWER.** _rd_w0 = 0x20494645 = "EFI " and _rd_w1 = 0x54524150 = "PART",
# with the arm's own derived cell _rd_gpt = 1: **LBA 1 BEGINS `EFI PART` - THE
# MEDIUM IS A GPT DISK.** The rung-50 protective MBR was telling the truth: its
# single 0xEE entry pointed at LBA 1, and LBA 1 is a real GPT header. Corroborated
# by what the sector is NOT: _rd_w127 = 0, _rd_sig = 0, _rd_mbr = 0 - a GPT header
# does not carry the MBR signature (that lives only at LBA 0) - and the re-run
# partition walk on this sector found no non-empty record (_pm_p0_type = 0 across
# all four entries, _pm_next_sector = 0, _pm_next_is_arg = 0).
#
# **THE READ THAT GOT THERE.** _rd_lba = _rd_arg = 1, _rd_arg_lba_agree = 1 - the
# CMD17 argument is SECTOR 1, unshifted; _rd_shift = 0, _rd_blockaddr =
# _pm_sector_addressed = 1, _rd_cap = _pm_cap = 0x01d5a000, _rd_cap_over = 1. **THIS
# IS WHY RUNGS 43-49 NEVER ANSWERED IT**: they sent LBA << 9 - _rd_arg = 0x200 at
# value 46 was SECTOR 512, not LBA 1 - and under this card's sector addressing that
# is the wrong sector. Rung 47's read of "LBA 1" found no EFI PART (_rd_w0 =
# 0xe8f9decb) because it read sector 512; only now does the read land on the GPT
# header.
#
# The transfer is clean: _rd_complete = 1, _rd_err = 0, _rd_state = 4 (TRAN),
# _rd_words_gated = 0x80, _rd_word_read = 0x113A - so the two words are the CARD's
# bytes and not the FIFO's. The card stays in TRANSFER across the press.
#
# **THE HONEST NEGATIVE, UNCHANGED**: _rd_cap_csd_valid = 0, so _rd_cap_agree is
# ABSENT and the EXT_CSD count is the single producer.
#
# The standing readings are UNCHANGED: seam_lr = 0x8004c2dc did NOT move,
# xnu_live_seam_sctlr = 0x30c57879, xnu_entry_failures = 0, abort_entries = 0, the
# goal's own floor is met as in 504/520/533 (pid 1's syscalls, the fixture's
# 0xfeedface read back).
#
# **THE FRONTIER IS THE GPT PARTITION ENTRY ARRAY**: the header's own
# PartitionEntryLBA field (header byte offset 72) names the sector the entries live
# in, and the 128-byte entries carry each partition's first and last LBA.
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED.** **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition
# entry read, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage withheld.
#
# 851 - the rung-52 arm (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=51, VALUE 51 = ORDINAL RUNG 52):
#
# **THE GPT HEADER, DECODED OUT OF THE SECTOR THE SECTOR-1 READ ALREADY LANDED.** The rung-51
# press (850) measured `_rd_w0 = 0x20494645` = "EFI " and `_rd_w1 = 0x54524150` = "PART" with
# `_rd_gpt = 1`, so **LBA 1 IS A GPT HEADER** and the read already moved its 512 bytes into
# `st_read_block`. Rung 52 sends NO command, opens NO window and touches NO register - it
# DECODES that buffer, exactly as rung 49 decoded the MBR out of sector 0.
#
# **THE ONE FIELD THE FRONTIER NAMES IS `PartitionEntryLBA`** - the GPT header's byte offset 72,
# word 18 (`72/4`), the SECTOR the 128-byte partition ENTRY ARRAY lives in. That number is the
# NEXT arm's CMD17 argument, so rung 52 has the shape of 50 -> 51: only the sector moves again.
# `_gp_next_sector` = that number and `_gp_next_is_arg` = whether the sector this rung READ
# equals it (0 here, on purpose - the entry array is normally at LBA 2 - so the tension is
# stated in the log and the next arm makes the cell 1).
#
# The header's own fields are published BESIDE it: `_gp_my_lba` (word 6) is the header's
# SELF-CHECK against the sector this rung read (`_gp_self_ok` - a second producer agreeing with
# the decode, from a field the HEADER carries); `_gp_first_usable`/`_gp_last_usable` (words
# 10/12) bound the region partitions may live in and both must be inside the card
# (`_gp_first_in_range`/`_gp_last_in_range`); `_gp_nentries` (word 20) and `_gp_entry_size`
# (word 21, normally 128) are the array's OWN SHAPE - a reader who walked without them would
# walk a fixed four (as the MBR has) and be right by luck on this disk and wrong on the next.
#
# **THE SIGNATURE IS RE-CHECKED, AND THE CLAIM IS A NEGATIVE MADE STRUCTURAL.** New clause
# `xnu_entry_851` reads `st_gpt_parse`'s linked body and refuses unless every `bl` in it is to
# `entry_live_write` (19 of 19, so it sends no command, opens no window, touches no register -
# and the body names the controller window ZERO times), all four halves of the two signature
# words are present, and it is called by `st_cmd_path` ONCE AFTER `bl <st_read_single_block>`
# - so a body that quietly issued a command, that skipped the signature, or that ran on a stale
# buffer, cannot build.
#
# **IT MOVES NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM AND TOUCHES NO DEVICE REGISTER**: the medium is not touched
# at all. The entry bin grew to 5,585,532 bytes (the new body is compiled in); the entry-group
# page move did NOT fire (`STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004c2dc`).
# `STAGE90_XNU_PWR_WAIT_TICKS=384000` is inherited from rung 9 unchanged - 20 ms at this
# device's own 19,200,000 Hz. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and not
# a queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - no partition ENTRY read yet, no
# filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#

# 852 - THE RUNG-52 PRESS (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=51, value 50 -> arm armed-storage-2dbf8098):
#
# **THE PRESS WAS TAKEN AND THE ARM IS SPENT.** One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot`
# only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists
# hand-checked immediately before the gate; the phone returned. Capture
# out/stage90/captures/rung52-gptheader-20260930-122619-last_kmsg.txt 655,874 bytes.
#
# **THE READING: THE GPT HEADER DECODED, AND THE ENTRY ARRAY IS AT LBA 2.** `_gp_called = 1`,
# `_gp_sig_ok = 1`, `_gp_w0 = 0x20494645` ("EFI "), `_gp_w1 = 0x54524150` ("PART") - the module
# re-checked the signature ITSELF rather than trusting rung 51's derived cell - and THE ONE FIELD THE
# FRONTIER NAMES READS **`_gp_entry_lba = _gp_next_sector = 2`**: the 128-byte partition ENTRY ARRAY
# lives at SECTOR 2, which is the NEXT ARM's CMD17 argument. `_gp_arg_sector = _rd_lba = 1` beside it
# with `_gp_next_is_arg = 0` names the tension ON PURPOSE (the array is at LBA 2, this read was sector
# 1): the next arm sets the read's sector to `_gp_next_sector` and this cell becomes 1 - **the same
# shape as 50 -> 51, one number wide.**
#

# `_rd_cap_csd_valid = 0` (single producer). Seam `0x8004c2dc` did NOT move; `xnu_entry_failures = 0`,

# **THE FRONTIER IS THE GPT PARTITION ENTRY ARRAY AT LBA 2** - each 128-byte entry carries a

# 853 - the rung-53 arm (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=52, VALUE 52 = ORDINAL RUNG 53):
#
# **THE GPT PARTITION ENTRY ARRAY, READ AT THE SECTOR THE RUNG-52 HEADER NAMED, AND THE FIRST
# ENTRY DECODED.** The rung-52 press (852) decoded the GPT header and measured
# `_gp_entry_lba = _gp_next_sector = 2` - the 128-byte partition ENTRY ARRAY lives at SECTOR 2 -
# so rung 53 is ONE NUMBER: the sector variable `st_read_lba` moves 1 -> 2 and the parse that
# follows reads the array out of the SAME `st_read_block` the read fills. **It is the same shape
# as 50 -> 51: only the sector variable moves, and the number is the whole rung.**
#
# **THE WALK IS BOUNDED BY THE ONE SECTOR READ, AND THAT BOUND IS THE WHOLE SAFETY OF THE RUN.**
# The header declares `NumberOfPartitionEntries = 28` entries of 128 bytes - a 3,584-byte array
# spanning SEVEN sectors - but this rung reads ONE 512-byte sector (`st_read_block`, 128 words),
# so `_ge_entries_in_sector = 128/32 = 4` and the loop is bounded by
# `_ge_nentries_used = min(28, 4) = 4`. **A reader who walked all 28 would index
# `st_read_block[874]` of a 128-word array and decode a partition extent out of adjacent statics**,
# with every cell still reading as a plausible partition; the build clause refuses such a body by
# requiring the divide that computes the sector's capacity. A reader who walked a fixed four (as
# the MBR has) is right by luck on this disk and wrong on the next, which is why the header's
# DECLARED count is carried and published beside the CAPACITY.
#
# **THE TWO NUMBERS A MOUNT NEEDS ARE `StartingLBA`/`EndingLBA`** - entry words 8/10 - and the
# first NON-EMPTY entry's first LBA is carried in `st_gpt_part_sector` as the NEXT arm's CMD17
# argument, the same one-number step 50 -> 51 and 51 -> 53 were. The 16-byte type GUID is entry
# words 0-3; all-zero names an unused slot (`_ge_blank`), so a disk whose entry 0 is empty
# (`_ge_found = 0`) is told apart from a walk that never ran.
#
# **THE CLAIM IS A NEGATIVE MADE STRUCTURAL.** New clause `xnu_entry_852` reads
# `st_gpt_entry_parse`'s linked body and refuses unless every `bl` in it is to `entry_live_write`
# (32 of 32, so it sends no command, opens no window, touches no register - and the body names the
# controller window ZERO times), the sector-capacity divide is present, and it is called by
# `st_cmd_path` ONCE AFTER `bl <st_gpt_parse>` - so a body that quietly issued a command, that
# over-walked the 128-word buffer, or that ran before the header carried its shape, cannot build.
# `xnu_entry_849`'s value-52 half reads the store that fills `st_read_lba` and refuses unless its
# immediate is **2**.
#
# `_ge_hdr_ok` re-checks that the buffer is NOT the header (it reads 0 on a well-formed entry
# array, the correct direction); `_ge_arr_in_range` and `_ge_part_in_range` bound the array's
# sector and the partition's first LBA inside the card.

# **IT MOVES NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM AND TOUCHES NO DEVICE REGISTER IT DID NOT TOUCH BEFORE**: CMD17
# reads, so the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-52
# left them; only the sector NUMBER moves 1 -> 2. The entry bin grew to 5,585,532 bytes and the
# entry-group page move fired this time (`STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` `0x8004c2dc` -> `0x8004d2dc`, +0x1000

# 854 - THE RUNG-53 PRESS (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=52, value 52 -> arm armed-storage-e8597e3e):
#
# **THE PRESS WAS TAKEN AND THE ARM IS SPENT.** One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot`
# only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from BOTH device lists
# hand-checked immediately before the gate; the phone returned. Capture
# out/stage90/captures/rung53-gptentries-20260930-125548-last_kmsg.txt 654,954 bytes `2edc5584...`.
#
# **THE MECHANISM WORKS AND THE ARM FALSIFIES ITS OWN PRE-REGISTRATION, INFORMATIVELY.**
# `_rd_lba = _rd_arg = 2` with `_rd_arg_lba_agree = 1` - the sector variable moved 1 -> 2 and the
# command sent it, a clean 512-byte read out of TRANSFER state (`_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`,
# `_rd_state = 4`, `_rd_words_gated = 0x80`, `_rd_shift = 0`, `_rd_blockaddr = 1`). Sector 2 is NOT a
# header: `_ge_hdr_ok = 0` (the module re-tested `EFI PART` and it is absent) and `_rd_w0 = 0xdea0ba2c`
# is a partition entry's type-GUID word.
#
# **BUT `_gp_sig_ok = 0`, `_gp_w0 = 0xdea0ba2c`, `_gp_nentries = 0`, `_gp_entry_size = 0`,
# `_gp_entry_lba = 0`** - rung 52's header decode (`st_gpt_parse`) still runs AFTER the read, and rung
# 53 moved the read's sector to 2, so the header decode now decodes the ENTRY ARRAY as if it were a
# header and fills the carries from sector 2's (zero) words 18/20/21. The entry decode then consumes a
# shape the header decode had just zeroed: `_ge_nentries_decl = 0`, `_ge_stride_words = 0`,
# `_ge_arr_sector = 0`, `_ge_entries_in_sector = 0x80` (the degenerate-stride guard fell through to
# stride 1), `_ge_nentries_used = min(0, 128) = 0` (**the walk never ran**), `_ge_ok = _ge_found = 0`,
# `_ge_blank = 1`, and **`_ge_arg_is_arr = 0`** (`_rd_lba = 2` vs `_ge_arr_sector = 0`) - the cell that
# names the tension the rung was built to make read 1.
#
# **THE PRE-REGISTRATION WAS FALSE AND FALSIFIABLY SO**: the sentence "it consumes the header's own
# shape, carried while the buffer still held the header" assumed a carry that the arm's own sector move
# destroyed, because in rung 53 the buffer NEVER held the header - the one CMD17 lands sector 2
# ([[mi4-a-lower-rungs-side-effect-poisoned-the-rung-above]], input-side form: a BUFFER the step above
# overwrote, not a durable device side effect).
#
# **NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM MOVED AND NO DEVICE REGISTER WAS WRITTEN BEYOND RUNG 51's**; the card is in
# TRANSFER state; no panic (`runner: no 'panic ... sleh_abort'`); **the seam `0x8004d2dc` was confirmed
# on hardware** - the entry-group page move's pin caught the move before the press, and the press
# confirms both copies. Standing readings unchanged: `xnu_entry_failures = 0`, `abort_entries = 0`; the
# goal's own floor is met as in 504/520/533.
#
# **THE FRONTIER IS THE ORDER, NOT A NEW DEVICE ACT**: the header's shape must be captured from the
# header sector without the read overwriting it. The natural next step is **two reads in one rung** -
# sector 1 to capture the shape, then sector 2 to decode the array - plus a build clause that binds
# `st_gpt_parse`'s expected sector to the read's sector, so a body whose header decode runs on a buffer
# the read did not fill with sector 1 is refused rather than silently zeroing the carries.
#
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED.** The arm is SPENT and the park is a RECORD, not a queue.
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - the partition entry itself is still not decoded, no filesystem, no mount;
# TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#
# 855 - THE RUNG-54 ARM (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=53, VALUE 53 = ORDINAL RUNG 54):
#
# **TWO READS IN ONE BOOT: THE GPT HEADER CAPTURED AT SECTOR 1, THE PARTITION ENTRY ARRAY READ AT
# SECTOR 2 AND THE FIRST ENTRY DECODED.** The rung-53 press (854) landed sector 2 cleanly
# (`_rd_lba = _rd_arg = 2`, `_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`, `_rd_state = 4`) but `st_gpt_parse`
# then decoded the ENTRY ARRAY as if it were a header and filled its carries from sector 2's (zero)
# words 18/20/21 - `_gp_sig_ok = 0`, `_gp_nentries = 0`, `_gp_entry_size = 0`, `_gp_entry_lba = 0` -
# so the entry decode consumed a shape the header decode had just zeroed and walked nothing
# (`_ge_nentries_used = 0`, `_ge_found = 0`, `_ge_arg_is_arr = 0`). **The frontier was the ORDER,
# not a new device act: rung 53 read ONE sector, so the buffer could never hold the header AND the
# array.** Rung 54 reads BOTH, in the order that makes each decode see the right bytes.
#
# **THE ORDER IS THE RUNG.** `st_cmd_path` calls, in sequence: `st_read_single_block` (the FIRST
# CMD17, sector 1) -> `st_mbr_parse` -> `st_gpt_parse` (the header is decoded NOW, while the buffer
# is KNOWN to hold sector 1) -> `st_data_reset` -> `st_read_single_block` (the SECOND CMD17, sector
# 2) -> `st_gpt_entry_parse` (the entry array is walked out of the buffer the second read filled).
# The sector comes from `st_sector_for_read(st_read_count)`, a `noinline` helper whose two immediates
# are 1 (`ST_GPT_HEADER_SECTOR`) and 2 (`ST_GPT_ENTRY_ARRAY_SECTOR`); the ordinal is the
# pre-increment counter bumped just before each command, so the FIRST read sends the header's sector
# and the SECOND the array's. **It is the same one-number discipline applied to a second CMD17.**
#
# **THE HEADER DECODE IS NOW BOUND TO ITS SECTOR AS A READING.** `st_gpt_parse` publishes
# `_gp_hdr_sig_ok` (it re-tests `EFI PART` on the buffer it decodes) AND `_gp_hdr_sector`
# (`st_read_lba`, the sector that buffer was read from). A header decode that ran on sector 2 would
# read `_gp_hdr_sig_ok = 0` with `_gp_hdr_sector = 2` - the rung-53 defect named as a cell rather
# than a sentence.
#
# **THE WALK IS BOUNDED BY THE SMALLER OF THE HEADER'S COUNT AND THE ONE SECTOR'S CAPACITY, AND
# THAT BOUND IS THE WHOLE SAFETY OF THE RUN.** The header declares `_ge_nentries_decl = 28` entries
# of `_ge_stride_words = 32` words (128 bytes) - a 3,584-byte array spanning SEVEN sectors - but the
# read lands ONE 512-byte sector (128 words), so `_ge_entries_in_sector = 128/32 = 4` and
# `_ge_nentries_used = min(28, 4) = 4`. **A reader who walked all 28 would index
# `st_read_block[874]` of a 128-word array and decode a partition out of adjacent statics**; the
# build clause `xnu_entry_852` refuses such a body by requiring the sector-capacity divide.
#
# **THE BUILD REFUSALS, NOT SENTENCES.** `xnu_entry_849`'s value-53 half resolves `st_sector_for_read`
# via `sym_addr`/`sym_size`, dumps its linked body, greps for the immediates `#1` and `#2`, and
# refuses unless BOTH are present; it requires `st_read_single_block` to call the helper exactly ONCE.
# The same clause requires `st_read_single_block` to be called TWICE by `st_cmd_path`
# (`blk43_calls = 2`; ONE is rung 53 again) and `st_data_reset` to be called TWICE (`dr47_calls = 2`;
# ONE reset cannot precede two reads), and requires `st_read_count` to be in the image.
# `xnu_entry_852` still requires `st_gpt_entry_parse`'s body to call nothing but `entry_live_write`,
# to touch no controller window, to hold the capacity divide, and to be called ONCE AFTER
# `bl <st_gpt_parse>`.
#
# **IT MOVES NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM AND TOUCHES NO DEVICE REGISTER IT DID NOT TOUCH BEFORE**: CMD17
# reads, so the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-53
# left them; the command, the flags and the whole rung-51 cell set are byte for byte - only a SECOND
# read is added, at the header's own sector first. The entry bin is 5,585,532 bytes (size-neutral
# against rung 53's, content different - `d301bcb5...`) and **the entry-group page move did NOT fire
# this rung**: `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004d2dc` (rung 53's value), so the seam pair in
# `entry_trace.c` and `run_and_capture.sh` is unchanged. `STAGE90_XNU_PWR_WAIT_TICKS=384000` is
# inherited from rung 9 unchanged - 20 ms at this device's own 19,200,000 Hz. `fastboot boot` only;
# nothing flashed; nothing written to storage.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and not a
# queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - the partition entry's own bytes are
# still not walked into a filesystem, no filesystem, no mount; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

#
# **THREE READS IN ONE BOOT: THE GPT HEADER AT SECTOR 1, THE PARTITION ENTRY ARRAY AT SECTOR 2, AND
# THE FIRST PARTITION'S OWN SUPERBLOCK - THE READ THAT ASKS *IS THERE A FILESYSTEM HERE*.** The
# rung-54 frontier is `_ge_part_sector` (the first partition's `StartingLBA`, entry words 8/10), and
# a filesystem's superblock hangs off exactly that address. Both ext2/3/4 and f2fs put it at
# **partition byte 1024 = sector 2** - `struct ext4_super_block` at `ext4.h:1009` with `__le16
# s_magic = 0xEF53` at superblock byte 56 (`ext4.h:1025`, `magic.h:23`), and `struct f2fs_super_block`
# at `f2fs_fs.h:59` with `magic = 0xF2F52010` as its FIRST field (`f2fs.h:43`) - so the third read
# addresses `st_gpt_part_sector + ST_FS_SB_SECTOR_OFF` (`+ 2`, `_Static_assert`ed to 2) and the magic
# lands IN BOUNDS at the buffer's own word 0 (f2fs) or word 14 (ext). **A read at
# `st_gpt_part_sector` alone would land partition byte 0, where no filesystem puts a magic**, and
# `_pt_fs_found` would read 0 for a filesystem that is there.
#
# **THE SUPERSET IS DELIBERATE, AND IT IS THE COST OF AN UNMEASURED RUNG.** Rung 54 is PARKED and
# NOT pressed, so `_ge_part_sector` has never been read on hardware. A rung-55 arm cannot pin its
# third read to a constant no press has produced - that would be a build clause asserting a value
# nothing measured ([[mi4-a-claim-in-a-comment-is-not-a-check]]). So the third read consumes the
# LIVING carry `st_gpt_part_sector` that `st_gpt_entry_parse` fills in THIS SAME BOOT, and the arm
# is a strict superset of rung 54's three-step shape rather than a one-constant step from it.
#
# **THE ORDER IS THE RUNG.** `st_cmd_path` calls, in sequence: `st_data_reset` + `st_read_single_block`
# (the FIRST CMD17, sector 1) -> `st_mbr_parse` -> `st_gpt_parse` (the header is decoded NOW, while
# the buffer is KNOWN to hold sector 1, and its three shape fields are CARRIED out of that buffer
# before the next read overwrites it) -> `st_data_reset` + `st_read_single_block` (the SECOND CMD17,
# sector 2) -> `st_gpt_entry_parse` (the entry array is walked, and the first non-empty entry's
# `StartingLBA` is carried in `st_gpt_part_sector`) -> `st_data_reset` + `st_read_single_block` (the
# THIRD CMD17, sector `st_gpt_part_sector + 2`) -> `st_part_parse` (the filesystem decode). **The
# third read MUST sit between the entry decode (which fills the carry) and the filesystem decode
# (which consumes it), and `xnu_entry_855` refuses any other order.** Every read re-issues
# `st_data_reset` first: rung 44's press measured `DATA_INHIBIT` refusing CMD17 in the same boot it
# was set, and the transfer above sets it again.
#
# **THE SECTOR SELECTOR LOADS THE CARRY BY ADDRESS.** `st_sector_for_read(st_read_count)` is a
# `noinline` helper (the two-arm `if` was tail-merged and the `const` array made the device-access
# classifier read a literal-pool base - experiment 855) whose three arms are 1, 2, and
# `st_gpt_part_sector + ST_FS_SB_SECTOR_OFF`. `xnu_entry_849`'s value-54 half now decodes the
# `movw`/`movt` pair the compiler emitted and holds it against the address `nm` gives
# `st_gpt_part_sector` **by value**, and requires the `+2` offset on its own instruction. **A grep of
# the selector body for the TEXT `<st_gpt_part_sector>` reads 0 on a CORRECT body**, because a
# linked `movw`/`movt` pair names the absolute address and contains no symbol name - the first draft
# of that clause refused the build on that reading, which is the shape the build clause's own comment
# now names.
#
# **THE FILESYSTEM ANSWER IS TWO COMPARISONS AND TWO NEGATIVE SIGNATURE CHECKS.** `_pt_f2fs_magic`
# / `_pt_f2fs_ok` test word 0 against `F2FS_SUPER_MAGIC` = `0xF2F52010`; `_pt_ext_magic` (the low
# half of word 14, masked because `s_magic` is a `__le16` and not a whole word) / `_pt_ext_ok` test
# it against `0xEF53`; `_pt_fs_found` is 1 iff either fires - **the cell the goal asks for**. The
# negative checks are `_pt_hdr_ok` and `_pt_mbr_ok`, which must BOTH read 0: a superblock sector
# holds neither `EFI PART` nor the MBR signature, so a third read that landed sector 1 or 0 names
# itself there. `_pt_w0` publishes the buffer's raw word 0 so the comparison is checkable from
# outside, and `_pt_arg_sector`/`_pt_part_sector`/`_pt_sb_sector`/`_pt_arr_sector` publish the three
# sectors the decode is about. **`_pt_next_is_arg` is the one cell neither the build nor the decode
# can settle before a press**: 1 says the third read addressed exactly the sector the entry table
# named, and it is the first reading this project will have of a partition's own extent.
#
# **THE BUILD REFUSALS, NOT SENTENCES.** `xnu_entry_849`'s value-54 half asserts the selector's carry
# address and offset. The same clause requires `st_read_single_block` AND `st_data_reset` each to be
# called **THREE** times by `st_cmd_path` (ONE is rung 53, TWO is rung 54, and one reset cannot
# precede three reads). `xnu_entry_855` binds `st_part_parse`: only `entry_live_write` calls, 0
# controller-window references, explicit-WIDTH device accesses none, both magics present in the
# linked image, exactly ONE call, AFTER `st_gpt_entry_parse`, with the LAST `st_read_single_block`
# between them.
#
# **IT MOVES NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM AND TOUCHES NO DEVICE REGISTER IT DID NOT TOUCH BEFORE**: CMD17
# reads, so the card stays in TRAN with its block length and its CSD/EXT_CSD exactly as rungs 42-54
# left them. The entry bin is 5,585,532 bytes (size-neutral against rung 54's, content different -
# `afbb4849...`) and **the entry-group page move did NOT fire this rung**: `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR`
# stays `0x8004d2dc` (rung 53's value), so the seam pair in `entry_trace.c` and `run_and_capture.sh`
# is unchanged. `STAGE90_XNU_PWR_WAIT_TICKS=384000` is inherited from rung 9 unchanged - 20 ms at this
# device's own 19,200,000 Hz. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed; nothing written to storage.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and not a
# queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - a superblock magic is not a mount and
# not a filesystem read; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.
#

# 856 - THE RUNG-56 ARM (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=55, VALUE 55 = ORDINAL RUNG 56)

# **A HOST-SIDE ARM AND NOTHING ELSE: BUILT AND PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.**
#
# RUNG 56 DECODES THE FILESYSTEM'S GEOMETRY OUT OF THE SAME 512 BYTES RUNG 55'S THIRD READ ALREADY
# LANDED. The third CMD17 (rung 55) put the first partition's superblock sector in `st_read_block`
# and `st_part_parse` answered *is there a filesystem here*; rung 56 adds a SECOND reader,
# `st_part_geom`, called from `st_cmd_path` immediately after it, which decodes the block size, the
# inode geometry, the revision and the feature word that same buffer holds. **IT ADDS NO READ, NO
# STORE, NO WINDOW, NO MEGABYTE, NO REGISTER AND NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM** - it is a second reader of
# one buffer, and the build clause `xnu_entry_856` is what makes that a property of the linked image
# (29 calls, all entry_live_write; 0 controller-window references).
#
# **THE RUNG IS ABOUT ONE WORD WITH TWO MEANINGS.** Superblock byte 96 = word 24 is
# `s_feature_incompat` on ext2/3/4 (the word `ext4_feature_set_ok` refuses a mount on) and `root_ino`
# on f2fs (fixed to 3 by the vendor's own `sanity_check_raw_super`, super.c:1054, with `node_ino`/
# `meta_ino` at 1/2 in words 25/26) - so EVERY family-specific cell is published only inside the
# branch the two magics rung 55 compared select. One buffer, two decodes (mi4-one-value-two-definitions).
#
# **A BUILD CLAUSE WAS REPAIRED BEFORE IT WOULD ACCEPT A CORRECT BODY, AND IT IS THE SAME CLASS AS
# RUNG 55'S OWN REPAIR.** The first draft of `xnu_entry_856` grepped for the absolute immediates
# #96/#100/#104 - but the compiler reaches the buffer's words as `ldr rX, [rBase, #off]` against a
# base materialized by a movw/movt pair, so a superblock byte offset appears as NO immediate in the
# linked image. The clause now binds RELATIVE TO WORD 14, whose load is identifiable because it feeds
# the ext2/3/4 `s_magic` compare (#61267): word 24 is 40 bytes past it, word 25 44, word 26 48.
#
# **THE FULL BUILD IS CLEAN AND THE GATES PASS**: `make check` exit 0, readiness 5 of 5, `make check`'s
# response-word-order check reports 0 divergence across 12 response-reading functions, and the
# entry-group page move did NOT fire - `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004d2dc` in entry_trace.c:2737
# and `EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL=0x8004d2dc` in run_and_capture.sh:364.
#
# **NO PRESS HAS BEEN MADE AND NONE IS OWED: this arm is PARKED and the park is a RECORD and not a
# queue. THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - a geometry is not a mount; no filesystem
# is mounted; TWRP-to-storage stays withheld.

# 858 - THE RUNG-56 PRESS (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=55, VALUE 55 = ORDINAL RUNG 56):
# **THE PRESS WAS TAKEN AND `armed-storage-63c6d77d` IS SPENT.**
# ============================================================================================
#
# **THE PRESS WAS TAKEN AND THE ARM IS SPENT.** One gate exit 0, one runner exit 0; `fastboot boot`
# only, nothing flashed, nothing written to storage; `33e80afe` absent from both device lists
# hand-checked immediately before the gate; **the device returned** and `adb` lists `4a2fe00b` as
# `device` again. Capture `out/stage90/captures/rung56-fsgeom-20261001-010335-last_kmsg.txt` 663,149 B
# `db5695026641900b0fe0c098e102d9439d18833664db2784b50220b6c88b2787`. Transcript: experiment-858.
#
# **NO BRICK**: `xnu_entry_failures = 0`, `abort_entries = 0`. The watchdog and the software dead-man
# were armed as the gate printed; neither was needed to return the run.
#
# **THIS ONE PRESS SETTLES THREE PARKED RUNGS.** Rungs 54, 55 and 56 were all parked and unpressed,
# and a cumulative ladder compiles every lower body in - so one boot answers all three: does a GPT
# partition exist (yes), does it carry a filesystem superblock (NO), what is the superblock's
# geometry (nothing to decode, and the guard said so).
#
# **THE WHOLE GPT CHAIN WORKS.** Three CMD17 reads, ordinals 1/2/3, and for each the sector written
# to the argument register equals the sector the decode expected (`_rd_arg_lba_agree = 1`):
# ordinal 1 -> LBA 1 (GPT header), ordinal 2 -> LBA 2 (entry array), ordinal 3 -> LBA 0x24 (the
# partition's superblock sector). Every read clean: `_rd_complete = 1`, `_rd_err = 0`, `_rd_state = 4`
# (TRAN), `_rd_words_gated = 0x80`, `_rd_illegal = 0`. Header: `_gp_sig_ok = 1`,
# `_gp_w0 = 0x20494645` ("EFI "), `_gp_w1 = 0x54524150` ("PART"), `_gp_entry_lba = 2`,
# `_gp_entry_size = 0x80`, `_gp_nentries = 0x1c`.
#
# **THE RESULT: THE FIRST PARTITION IS ~2 MB AND CARRIES NO FILESYSTEM.** Entry 0 is found
# (`_ge_found = 1`, `_ge_blank = 0`, `_ge_index = 0`) with type GUID words
# `0xdea0ba2c 0x4805cbdd 0x28f4f9b4 0x983e1c25` and extent `_ge_first_lba = 0x22` (34),
# `_ge_last_lba = 0xfff` (4095) - a **0x1000-sector, ~2 MB** extent, a vendor/firmware partition and
# not a filesystem. The third read addressed `_ge_part_sector + 2 = 0x24` and landed it
# (`_pt_arg_sector = _pt_sb_sector = 0x24`, `_pt_next_is_arg = 1`) but the bytes are not a superblock:
# `_pt_w0 = _pt_f2fs_magic = 0xe1a04614` (ARM code `mov r4, lr, lsr #12`), `_pt_ext_magic = 0xf0f0`,
# and **`_pt_fs_found = 0`** with both negative signature checks holding (`_pt_hdr_ok = 0`,
# `_pt_mbr_ok = 0`).
#
# **THE GEOMETRY GUARD HELD, CORRECTLY.** `_pg_called = 1` and **`_pg_decoded = 0` with
# `_pg_which = 0`** - on a buffer where no magic was found, the guard publishes 0 and NO family cell
# is vended; the two raw words (`_pg_w0 = 0xe1a04614`, `_pg_w24 = 0x97b425ed`) are still published so
# the shared byte is visible without either name being trusted. The word-24 dual meaning never had to
# be resolved.
#
# **THE FRONTIER IS THE ENTRY INDEX, NOT A NEW DEVICE MECHANISM.** The GPT declares 28 entries but
# this rung reads ONE array sector, so the walk is bounded to `_ge_nentries_used = 4` and entry 0 is
# the small vendor partition. The filesystem-bearing partition is at a higher index one sector does
# not reach. The next rung walks the whole entry array (7 sectors) and selects the LARGE extent, then
# reads ITS superblock - a read-count change of the same shape as rungs 53->54.
#
# **NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM MOVED** - three CMD17 reads, `fastboot boot` only.
# **THE GOAL IS NOT MET** - the first partition is not a filesystem, no filesystem is mounted, no
# TWRP was written. But the storage frontier moved from "is there a filesystem here" (rung 55's
# question, answered NO for partition 1) to "which partition is the filesystem" (rung 57's).
#
# **NO FIRER IS ARMED AND NO PRESS IS OWED.** `armed-storage-63c6d77d` is SPENT and the park is a
# RECORD, not a queue. Below it `armed-storage-e8597e3e` (rung 53) was already spent.

# 859 - THE RUNG-57 ARM (STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=56, VALUE 56 = ORDINAL RUNG 57)
# **A HOST-SIDE ARM AND NOTHING ELSE: BUILT AND PARKED, NOT PRESSED, NOT ARMED.**
# ============================================================================================
#
# **RUNG 57 WALKS THE WHOLE GPT ENTRY ARRAY AND SELECTS THE LARGE PARTITION.** Rungs 54/55/56 read
# ONE array sector (the 58-entry array's first 4 entries) and the rung-56 press (858) measured entry 0
# at a ~2 MB extent with no filesystem magic. The GPT header declares `NumberOfPartitionEntries = 28`
# of `SizeOfPartitionEntry = 128` bytes = 3584 bytes = **SEVEN 512-byte sectors**, so this rung reads
# EACH array sector in turn (`st_sector_for_read` maps ordinal -> sector:
# `0 -> ST_GPT_HEADER_SECTOR`; `1..st_gpt_array_nsec -> st_gpt_entry_lba + (ordinal-1)`;
# the final ordinal -> `st_gpt_data_sector + ST_FS_SB_SECTOR_OFF`), decoding each sector's entries
# while THAT sector is in the buffer, and carries the `StartingLBA` of the entry with the LARGEST
# extent (`EndingLBA - StartingLBA`) as `st_gpt_data_sector`. **THE LAST READ LANDS THAT PARTITION'S
# SUPERBLOCK, NOT PARTITION 1's** - which is the whole point: 858 proved partition 1 is firmware.
#
# **WHY BY EXTENT AND NOT BY NAME.** The Mi 4's GPT geometry is NOT recorded anywhere in this archive
# (only name->devnode and sizes, docs/reference/local-device-findings.md:72-98), so the data
# partition cannot be found by name from these sources. Every OS-mountable filesystem partition is
# the large one; the small ones are firmware/vendor blobs. The extent is the reading, and
# `st_gpt_best_extent` / `st_gpt_scan_sector` publish it so the selection is checkable.
#
# **NO BYTE OF THE MEDIUM MOVES AND NO NEW DEVICE MECHANISM IS ADDED.** It is a read-COUNT change on
# the same CMD17 path rungs 51-56 already use: `blk43_calls` = 3 headline calls (header, the array
# LOOP, the superblock) and `dr47_calls` = 3, held to exactly the rung-55 values because a textual
# `bl` count reads CALL SITES and not executions - the loop is ONE call site. (already in the record)
#
# **A BUILD-CLAUSE DEFECT WAS FOUND AND REPAIRED, AND IT IS THE SAME CLASS AS RUNGS 55 AND 56.**
# The first cut read the loop bound `st_gpt_array_nsec` inside the `for` tail test. The loop body's
# first instruction is a branch TARGET (the back-edge lands there), so it ends a linear region and the
# device-access classifier's `epoch` advances - which invalidates every base materialized before it,
# including the loop-invariant address of the bound, which GCC had hoisted ABOVE the loop. The
# classifier therefore refused a CORRECT build with a bare `NODECL-8056-0:ldr`. **The repair is in the
# SOURCE: the bound is read into a local ONCE above the loop**, so the only `movw`/`movt` for that
# address is outside every loop region. (This is a codegen-class artifact, not a defect in the arm.)
# The `st_cmd_path` image-access clause was then widened from "EMPTY" to "exactly `st_gpt_array_nsec`
# at its own `nm` address, `IMG:ldr`", so the property is the IDENTITY of the one access rather than
# the absence of any - rungs 55's and 56's repair applied to the third clause of the same family.

# ====================================================================================================
# 862 (2026-10-01): THE MOUNT ARM, AND THE MEDIUM THAT KEEPS THE EXEC ALIVE.
# ====================================================================================================
#
# **THIS IS THE FIRST ARM OF THE XNU-MOUNT TRACK, NOT A STORAGE-LADDER RUNG.** 861 built the medium
# (`src/platform/stage90_root_media.c`, a payload-owned `bdevsw`); 862 makes it a root worth mounting
# and parks the arm that hands it to `vfs_mountroot`. The switch is `STAGE90_XNU_MOUNT=1`
# (`__wrap_mdevlookup` answers `entry_root_media_register(devid)` instead of `__real_mdevlookup`);
# the ladder's `STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE` is UNCHANGED at 56, so this arm carries rung 57 on top.
#
# **WHY `eno_strat` ALONE WOULD HAVE BEEN A REGRESSION, AND WHAT 862 ADDS.** `mockfs` is the root
# filesystem (`STAGE90_XNU.local`; its `vfc_mountroot` is the only non-NULL one, so `vfs_mountroot`
# mounts it over whatever `rootdev` names). `mockfs_mountroot` (`bsd/miscfs/mockfs/mockfs_vfsops.c:101`)
# asks the root device `DKIOCGETMEMDEVINFO`; only a device that ANSWERS it becomes
# `mockfs_memory_backed`, pointing its one file node straight at the memory
# (`mockfs_fsnode.c:333-344`, `pager_map_to_phys_contiguous`). The memory-backed root today is
# `/dev/md0`, made by `mdevadd` over `g_stage90_ramdisk` - the bytes of `/sbin/launchd` - and that is
# why process 1 can be exec'd at all. A device answering `ENOTTY` there would still MOUNT, but its
# file node's bytes would have to come through `cluster_pagein` -> the device's `strategy`, and
# `eno_strat` moves no byte. So 862 does not invent a buffer: it maps the SAME `g_stage90_ramdisk` the
# RAM disk does, and answers `DKIOCGETMEMDEVINFO` with `mi_phys = false` exactly as `mdevadd` is
# called (`IOKitBSDInit.cpp:447`) - because mockfs SKIPS the memory-backed path when `mi_phys` is true
# (`mockfs_vfsops.c:104-109`).
#
# **THE GEOMETRY IS DERIVED, NOT CHOSEN, AND ITS SOURCE IS A SYMBOL.** `mi_size` is a PAGE COUNT of
# the RAM disk (a byte length >> 12; `mockfs_fsnode.c:342` shifts `mi_base` back the same way).
# `entry_ramdisk.s` now exports `g_stage90_ramdisk_end`, an alias of the array's own end, and
# `build_entry.sh` passes it to the module as `-DSTAGE90_ROOT_MEDIA_SIZE_SYM`; the module computes
# `end - start` from the two symbols, so 0x2000 exists in exactly ONE place. `verify_root_device`
# adds a clause the array's own `nm -S` size and the alias must agree on - a clause that reads the
# ALIAS, which no earlier check did, because every earlier check read the array.
#
# **`build_entry.sh`'s new 862 clause** (`local ramdisk_end_va` beside the 468 RAM-disk block) refused
# no build here: `g_stage90_ramdisk_end` is 0x80523000, exactly `0x80521000 + 0x2000`. The wrapper's
# callee was read out of the LINKED image (`bl entry_root_media_register` at `__wrap_mdevlookup+0x14`,
# not `bl __real_mdevlookup`), and `st_media_ioctl`'s `bl st_media_memdev_info` proves the two-arm
# switch was not tail-merged away (the LINKED-ORDER defect that bit rung 57's build clause).
#
# **SIZE-NEUTRAL ONLY IN XNU_ENTRY; THE ENTRY IMAGE GREW 32 BYTES.** `STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY=1` (the payload
# switch) is unchanged; `STAGE90_XNU_MOUNT=1` is an ENTRY switch, so it moves the entry image
# (5585532 -> 5585564, the `__wrap_mdevlookup` pass-through body replaced by the callback) and the
# payload record is byte-identical to every rung since 23 (`6c2b6038...`, MEASURED). The entry config
# record grows by one line (`STAGE90_XNU_MOUNT=1`) and 20 bytes (900 -> 920).
#
# **READINESS 5 of 5, `make check` exit 0, and THE ENTRY-GROUP PAGE MOVE DID NOT FIRE** -
# `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays `0x8004d2dc` (rung 53's value) in entry_trace.c and
# `EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL` in run_and_capture.sh. **THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S - this arm is PARKED,
# not armed. THE GOAL IS NOT MET: a mounted mockfs is not a filesystem on the eMMC.**
#

# ====================================================================================================
# 863 (2026-10-01): THE SELECTED PARTITION NAMES ITSELF, AND RUNG 57'S OWN WITNESS IS REPAIRED.
# ====================================================================================================
#
# **THIS IS A STORAGE-LADDER RUNG (value 57), NOT A MOUNT-TRACK ARM.** `STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=57`
# (bound raised at `entry_storage.c:130`, `> 56` -> `> 57`), and `STAGE90_XNU_MOUNT` returns to its
# DEFAULT 0 - so this arm is the ladder WITHOUT 862's mount callback. The two tracks are separate;
# 862 was parked and never pressed, and this arm does not stack on it.
#
# **WHAT RUNG 57 MEASURED, AND THE DEFECT IT LEFT BEHIND.** 857/858 walked the WHOLE GPT entry array
# (one CMD17 per array sector over `1 .. st_gpt_array_nsec`), decoded each sector while it was in the
# buffer, and carried the `StartingLBA` whose extent `EndingLBA - StartingLBA` is LARGEST into
# `st_gpt_data_sector`. 858's press showed the chain works - **and that the first partition is not the
# filesystem** (rung 57's selector reads `st_gpt_data_sector + ST_FS_SB_SECTOR_OFF`; by-name, the
# largest extent is `userdata` p25 = ext4, while the FIRST partition is `sbl1` p1). **But `st_part_parse`
# and `st_part_geom`'s witness cells (`_pt_next_is_arg`, `_pt_part_sector`, `_pt_sb_sector`,
# `_pt_part_in_range`) still compared against `st_gpt_part_sector + ST_FS_SB_SECTOR_OFF` - the FIRST
# partition's road.** So a CORRECT rung-57 read would have logged `_pt_next_is_arg = 0`: one value with
# two definitions (the `mi4-one-value-two-definitions` class), the code using one while meaning the
# other. **THIS ARM CAPTURES THE SELECTED ENTRY'S IDENTITY AND PUBLISHES A WITNESS FOR IT** - the
# identity of the mountable partition is what the goal's last clause needs, and the repair costs no
# new device action.
#
# **TWO CARRIES, FILLED DURING THE SAME WALK.** `st_gpt_data_type[4]` (the selected entry's
# PartitionTypeGUID, words 0..3 = bytes 0..15) and `st_gpt_data_name[4]` (its PartitionName, first 16
# bytes = words 14..17, i.e. `ST_GPT_E_NAME_W0 = 14`, `_Static_assert`ed at `14 * 4 == 56`). Both are
# written inside `st_gpt_entry_parse`'s `if (extent > st_gpt_best_extent)` branch - the SAME branch
# that already carried `st_gpt_data_sector` - so the selection rule is untouched and the carries can
# only ever describe the entry the selector will read.
#
# **THE NAME FOLDS BY CHARACTER, AND A BUILD FIRST CAUGHT IT FOLDING BY WORD.** The first version read
# only `st_gpt_data_name[0]` and took its `>> 16` byte as character 2, so it packed characters 0,2,4,6
# of the word stream - which on this archive's labels is `uedt`, not `user`. The fold now extracts both
# bytes of words 0 and 1 into `_dp_name_p0`, and both bytes of words 2 and 3 into `_dp_name_p1`, in the
# order the bytes appear. **The clause reads the FOLD's shape** (`uxth` / `and #255` / `and #65280`
# plus an `orr ..., lsl #16`), which is how the packing came to be inspected at all.
#
# **`st_data_part` IS THE BODY, AND IT READS NO DEVICE AND SENDS NO COMMAND** - the whole reason this
# rung is safe to build and park: every `bl` in it is to `entry_live_write`, and it has ZERO references
# to the controller window `0xf9824xxx`. It publishes `_dp_type_w0..w3`, `_dp_name_w0..w3`,
# `_dp_name_p0`, `_dp_name_p1`, `_dp_name_nonzero`, `_dp_data_sb_sector`, `_dp_first_sb_sector`,
# `_dp_part_is_first` and `_dp_next_is_arg` (`st_read_lba == st_gpt_data_sector + 2`) - THE CORRECTED
# WITNESS, beside the old one, both in one capture.
#
# **THE BUILD CLAUSE IS THE BINDING, NOT THE PROSE** (`xnu_entry_857`). The carries are reached off ONE
# base register with offsets (base-relative `ldr [rX, #off]`), so the clause proves the BINDING rather
# than hunting for `movw` pairs - the FIRST `movw`/`movt` pair in the body is the key-string address,
# not the base, which is a `mi4-measurement-defects` trap this clause walked into and out of by counting
# `grep -c` matches for the base halves over the WHOLE body. It also refuses offset-0 (`[rX]`) and
# offset-4 (`[rX, #4]`) loads from the base - the walk's own bound and array base - and asserts the
# two carries are adjacent (`st_gpt_data_name` immediately follows `st_gpt_data_type`).
#
# **NOTHING MOVED THAT MUST NOT MOVE.** Payload config byte-identical (`6c2b6038...`, MEASURED against
# every rung since 23 - `STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY=1` is the only payload switch and it is unchanged, so the
# entry switches move the entry image ONLY); selector base binding intact (`st_sector_for_read` at
# `0x8000cff8` loads base `0x805601e4` at offsets 0/4/8); build counts hold (`blk43_calls`/`dr47_calls`
# = 3, `ge_calls` = 1); **THE ENTRY-GROUP PAGE MOVE DID NOT FIRE** - `STAGE90_XNU_SEAM_LR` stays
# `0x8004d2dc` in `entry_trace.c` and `EXIT_POP_LR_LITERAL` in `run_and_capture.sh`.
#
# **THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S - this arm is PARKED, not armed. THE GOAL IS NOT MET: naming the
# mountable partition is not a mounted filesystem, no filesystem is reached, and TWRP-to-storage
# STAYS WITHHELD.**
#

# ====================================================================================================
#
# **WHY THIS SET EXISTS AND `armed-storage-b00b87bb` COULD NOT BE USED.** The plan for this step was to
# revert `out/stage90/` to 863's parked rung-58 arm with `cp -r`, no build — the project's canonical
# mechanism. That failed on a MEASURED fact: 863's entry image (`b00b87bb`, built 05:24) predates edits
# to `src/entry/build_entry.sh`, `entry_storage.c` and `entry_trace.c` by 864 (rung 59, 06:48), 866
# (rung 60, 09:05), 877 (10:20) and 882 (13:14), so `preflight_boot_check.sh`'s sources clause refuses
# it — "the entry image is not the build of these sources". Rebuilding the entry image with 863's own
# switch set (PROBE=57, MOUNT=0, HFS_ROOT_MEDIA=0, ISTACK_SEPARATE=0, POST_END_TICKS=115200000)
# produced a bin of the SAME SIZE (5,585,564) but a DIFFERENT hash (`5936b246…`, not `b00b87bb…`) —
# so the arm is NOT byte-reproducible across the later edits, and a revert of the stale park leaves the
# gate RED on the sources clause. `b00b87bb` remains a RECORD of what 863 measured; it is no longer a
# revertible target.
#
# **THIS SET IS THE SAME EXPERIMENT, REBUILT.** It is `STAGE90_XNU_STORAGE_PROBE=57` (VALUE 57 =
# ORDINAL RUNG 58), `STAGE90_XNU_MOUNT=0` (the storage ladder, NOT 862's mount track), `HFS_ROOT_MEDIA=0`
# (882's split is absent, so `st_medium_disk_base` serves the RAM disk on both paths) — and its payload
# switch record is `6c2b6038…`, BYTE-IDENTICAL to rungs 23..59, so NO payload switch moved. It is the
# arm 867 §3.1 names as the press that unstacks the eMMC-driver clause: it carries rung 57's selection
# (walk the whole GPT entry array, select the largest extent) AND 863's repair of rung 57's own witness
# (`st_part_parse` compared the superblock road against the FIRST partition while the selector read the
# SELECTED one), publishing the selected entry's `Name` + `TypeGUID` in the same walk. A press of it
# would read `_dp_next_is_arg = 1` with `_dp_part_is_first = 0`.
#
# **THE ENTRY IMAGE IS A NEW BUILD, AND THAT IS WHAT THE SOURCES CLAUSE MEASURES.** The two builds
# differ in the versions of `build_entry.sh`/`entry_storage.c`/`entry_trace.c` they embedded (this one
# carries 864/866/877/882's additions), which is why the bin hash moves and why this is a record of a
# DISTINCT artifact and not a re-park of `b00b87bb`. `src/entry/build_entry.sh` is byte-for-byte
# reproducible from ONE tree, but not across a tree that changed — 863's note "size-neutral against
# rung 56's" holds here too: the size is 5,585,564 bytes, the same.
#
# **THE PAYLOAD IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE (408), SO `out/stage90/` IS THE ONLY COPY OF THESE BYTES** — hence
# this record, written by hand in the step that MEASURED the set. `fastboot boot` only; nothing flashed;
# the park is a RECORD, not a queue. **THE PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. THE GOAL IS NOT MET.**

# armed-d13-3af667a3 - THE FIRST PRESSABLE DARWIN-13 (iOS 7) ARM (2026-10-09)
#
# The first arm built against the Darwin-13 (iOS 7) XNU tree rather than 4570, and the first whose
# `xnu_arm_entry-config.txt` carries `STAGE90_XNU_TREE_D13=1`. Rungs 951-954 made the WHOLE pipeline
# follow the tree: 951 the USB/SMEM probe site (`__wrap_machine_idle` on D13), 952 the entry symbol
# (`__start`), 953 the idle-cache boot argument (abolished - `STAGE90_BOOT_IDLE_TOKEN` is "" on D13),
# 954 the press gate's 549 clause (publishes a D13 skip and refuses a stray `up_style_idle_exit=1`).
#
# NOT-a-storage-rung, so the family is `armed-d13-*` and the suffix comes from `xnu_arm_entry.bin`
# (3af667a3) - the entry image IS the artifact 951/952 moved, so the storage family's rule (name by
# the entry image) is the right one here too, but the `armed-storage-*` prefix is reserved for the
# eMMC ladder and a D13 bring-up arm is not one of those steps.
#
# The arm is 953's D13 payload rebuilt after 954 (the record writer/loop); the entry image is
# unchanged from 951 (3af667a3) because 952/953/954 touched no entry SOURCE - they moved the entry
# SYMBOL lookup, the payload boot arg and the GATE. The payload record
# (`stage90-build-config.txt`, 6c2b6038) is the constant payload switch set; the D13-ness lives in
# the ENTRY record's STAGE90_XNU_TREE_D13 key, which is the whole reason 954 added it (the payload
# record cannot see the tree - [[mi4-build-variant-comes-from-an-env-default]]).
#
# NOT PRESSED. This arm is built and parked so a D13 press CAN be recorded before it is sent.
# =================================================================================================

# =================================================================================================
# armed-d13-ad6b4a68 - THE 3 GB MEMORY-TOTAL ARM (2026-10-09)
#
# The goal's clause 「安装好的xnu，能够正确识别xiaomi 4的3GB内存」. 957 measured the device's own
# `/memory/reg` at 0xC0000000 = 3.000 GiB; 956 proved the total cannot ride the linear map (D13's
# managed map is gMemSize long from the fixed MANAGED_BASE, 1 GiB fills its 16 KB L1 exactly). So the
# total rides the REPORT: `tools/patch_d13_memory_total.py` guards a read of `/defaults hw.memsize`
# into `max_mem` ALONE in `osfmk/arm/arm_vm_init.c` (the one global `bsd/kern/kern_mib.c` serves
# `hw.memsize` from), on the switch `STAGE90_XNU_MEM_TOTAL`. `gMemSize`/`mem_size`/`sane_size` stay
# the boot bank, so the pmap, kalloc and the zones do not move.
#
# THE ARM IS THE ENTRY IMAGE (ad6b4a68) - the switch shapes the linked D13 kernel pool object
# `osfmk_arm_arm_vm_init.o` (marker `entry_xnu_mem_total_arm_on`), which is IN the entry link, so the

#
# The second rung of the goal's clause 3 ladder, on D13. It is the 959 arm PLUS ONE KEY:
# STAGE90_XNU_USB_DEV=1. 910a2 (`b3fbcd31`) is this rung on 4570, and it was DEFECTIVE: its probes sat
# in dead code so a press returned ZERO keys. That defect is fixed here by construction - the probes
# live at `__wrap_machine_idle` (951), the one idle site every pass reaches on this tree, and the
# xnu_entry_910 clause confirms it from the LINKED image, not the command line:
#   `entry_usb_probe`/`entry_usb_dev_init` called from `__wrap_machine_idle` and nowhere else
#   (read_probe=1, write_arm=1, enum=0, stream=0).
#
# This is the FIRST arm that WRITES to the USB port. `entry_usb_dev.c` runs the vendor's PHY sequence
# (`msm_otg.c`'s `msm_otg_reset`) and the ChipIdea device-mode sequence (`ci13xxx_udc.c`'s
# `hw_device_reset`): 8 distinct registers (`USBCMD`/`USBSTS`/`USBMODE`/`DEVICEADDR`/`ENDPOINTLISTADDR`/
# `USBINTR`/... + the PHY/ULPI ports). It is bounded by a MODE GATE - it writes nothing unless 910a
# found the core already a device (`USBMODE[1:0] == 2`); `STAGE90_XNU_USB_DEV_FORCE=1` is the opt-in
# that relaxes it and is LEFT OFF (0) here. The hazard the gate bounds: `USBCMD.RST` can drop the
# host's enumeration. make check's `check_usb_dev.py` re-derives 5 transcribed offsets, 36 written
# values and 8 write-targets against the Android header that owns them, and certifies the mode gate is
# the body's first store.
#
# The D13 kernel pool is the STAGE90_XNU kernel (705 objects, marker entry_xnu_mem_total_arm_on for
# STAGE90_XNU_MEM_TOTAL=1); the payload was built with XNU_TREE=.../xnu-hd2-darwin13/xnu and
# STAGE90_EXTRA_CFLAGS='-DSTAGE90_XNU_ENTRY=1'. The payload switch set is UNCHANGED (6c2b6038):
# USB_PROBE/USB_DEV and MEM_TOTAL are ENTRY build parameters.
#
# NOT PRESSED. A press must show the `xnu_live_usb_*` readings (the probe ran at the D13 idle site)
# AND the `xnu_live_usb_dev_*` readings (the device arm wrote). If the probe keys are present but the
# dev keys are absent, the mode gate refused - the core was not in device mode, which is a reading of
# its own. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.

# index 1, but the qh index IS the register bit (`num + dir*ENDPT_MAX/2`) so EP1-IN is **17**, not 1.
# Defect (2)'s fix is already in the tree (`src/entry/entry_usb_enum.h:78`, STAGE90_USB_ENUM_QH_IN1 17u)

# fires from `__wrap_machine_idle` (951), the xnu_entry_910 clause reading it write_arm=1, enum=1.
#
# WHAT IT WRITES: `entry_usb_enum.c`'s poll drains the latched `USBSTS` and advances the EP0 control
# state machine, answering the standard requests a host sends during enumeration - the endpoint set,

# re-reset here fights the running device - a build refusal, not a comment: `check_usb_enum.py` finds
# 18 stores, none of them `USBCMD_RST`). It keeps 910a2's MODE GATE (writes nothing unless the core is
# already a device, `USBMODE[1:0]==2`) with USB_DEV_FORCE still off. EP1-IN is owned by this file (it

# STAGE90_EXTRA_CFLAGS='-DSTAGE90_XNU_ENTRY=1'.
#
# NOT PRESSED. A press must show `xnu_live_usb_enum_*` readings (the EP0 state machine advanced) on top
# of the 959 probe keys and the 960 dev keys. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.
# =================================================================================================

# armed-d13-c54fc40d - THE FIRST D13 USB STREAM ARM (2026-10-09)
#
# Rung 4 (the top) of the goal's clause 3 ladder on D13, after 959 (probe), 960 (device) and 961
# (enum). It is the 961 arm PLUS ONE KEY: STAGE90_XNU_USB_STREAM=1. 910c (`77a51d33`/`6deae815`) is
# this rung on 4570 and shipped the same `QH_IN1=1` defect as 910b (fixed in tree: entry_usb_enum.h:78
# = 17u). The xnu_entry_910 clause reads the linked image stream=1; all four rungs now sit in one image.
#
# WHAT IT DOES: hands EP1-IN over. The ENUM arm still ENABLES the endpoint on SET_CONFIGURATION, but it
# stops priming it (entry_usb_enum.c guards both EP1-IN primes on the stream switch - so the two files
# never both write qh[IN1]); the STREAM arm owns qh[IN1] and its dTD from the first stream prime on, and
# on each completion sets EP1-IN's payload to a CURSOR over the RAM console ring (via the +0x01000000
# ALIAS) instead of 910b's fixed 4-byte magic. The count comes from the dTD `token` (with the ACTIVE
# guard), NOT `qh.curr` - the vendor never reads `qh.curr` for a count (`_hardware_dequeue:2176-2178`).
#
# THE POINT: this is the ARM THAT MAKES THE XNU CONSOLE REACHABLE OVER USB - the clause 「可以通过usb
# 进行调试」 in its operating form. A host that enumerates and opens the bulk IN endpoint reads the
# console ring; until then there is no USB-debug channel. The stream REQUIRES the enum arm (a build
# refusal forbids STREAM=1 with ENUM=0), so this arm carries the whole ladder.
#
# The payload switch set is UNCHANGED (6c2b6038): the four USB switches and MEM_TOTAL are ENTRY build
# parameters. D13 kernel pool = STAGE90_XNU; payload XNU_TREE=.../xnu-hd2-darwin13/xnu +
# STAGE90_EXTRA_CFLAGS='-DSTAGE90_XNU_ENTRY=1'.
#
# NOT PRESSED. A press must show the console ring's bytes arriving over EP1-IN (the enum arm's
# `xnu_live_usb_enum_*` keys plus the stream's own prime/completion keys), meaning a host read the RAM

# 969/970: THE WIDE-WINDOW ARM. Same switch set as armed-d13-7107b998 (the COW writable root over
# the real 896 MiB HFSX rootfs), with ONE key raised: STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY_WINDOW.
#
# WHAT THE WINDOW IS (970's finding). `arm_vm_init.c` shows the window is not only a VA range but
# XNU's OWN allocatable physical RAM:
#   * :316/:333 gMemSize = args->memSize;            <- the window IS memSize
#   * :379  l2_cache_to_range(managedCachePA, MANAGED_BASE=0xC0000000, ttb, gMemSize, TRUE);
#   * :422  avail_end = gPhysBase + gMemSize;             <- the ALLOCATOR's end
#   * :503  pmap_bootstrap(gMemSize, ...);
# So a larger memSize builds a larger managed map AND moves avail_end up: XNU's OWN allocatable
# physical RAM grows with the window. On the mi4 the window sits in the REAL high bank
# [0x80000000, 0xDE500000) (958's RAM_BOOT_BANK_SIZE 0x5e500000 = 1509 MiB), so a wide window is
# backed by real DRAM. The 16 MiB arm left XNU ~6 MiB free (968's COW arena moved topOfKernelData to
# 0x80A00000); this arm leaves ~470 MiB - enough for iOS's 301 MiB dyld shared cache.
#
# WHY 0x1e400000 (484 MiB) AND NOT 0x3f000000 (1008 MiB): D13's managed map is FIXED-BASE with NO
# clamp - it runs [MANAGED_BASE 0xC0000000, 0xC0000000 + gMemSize) - so a window that reaches the
# entry's RAM-CONSOLE VA 0xde500000 occupies the very L1 slot `entry_live_map(RAM_CONSOLE_BASE,...)`
# must install into, and `entry_section_install` (entry_stubs.c:2110) REFUSES an occupied slot. The
# result is a SILENT boot with NO log (the run's whole record is that console). Above the console the
# window also swallows the GIC 0xf9000000, USB 0xf9a55000, WDT 0xf9017000, SMCC 0xf9824000, GCC
# 0xfc400000, TLMM 0xfd500000 and SMEM alias 0xe0000000. So the real ceiling is
# RAM_CONSOLE_BASE - MANAGED_BASE = 0x1e500000 (485 MiB); the SAFE max is 0x1e400000 (484 MiB).
# build_entry.sh now REFUSES any >= 0x1e500000 (a session defect: the 0x3f000000 arm was built with
# no such refusal and would have booted silent).
#
# SO THIS IS A PAYLOAD-ONLY ARM: the window reaches XNU through the GENERATED xnu_arm_entry.h
# STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY_SIZE (xnu_entry_jump.c:150 a->memSize, :164 memSizeActual, :239 the dcache clean),
# NOT through any entry source - so the entry bin does NOT move (7107b998, byte-identical to 968's)
# and the SET NAME's suffix comes from stage90-qcdt.img (c74bde1d), per check_set_name_rule.sh's
# armed-window-* census row. The entry bin and its ELF are byte-identical to 968's; the config
# differs in exactly the one window key; the payload differs because it embeds the new immediate
# (mov r8, #0x1e400000 in xnu_entry_jump.o - read by value from the linked object).
#
# WHAT IT IS FOR. If the premise holds, a press of THIS arm lets real iOS userspace (launchd, then
# SpringBoard) map its shared cache - i.e. iOS RUNS - with NO 915-B port. Falsification: XNU panics
# before idle, or the log shows launchd still cannot map the cache, in which case 969's wall is not
# the window's size and 915-B is back on the table. Either way the press is the cheap next measurement
# and it is the operator's.
#
# NOT PRESSED. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S. Reversible: fastboot boot only, never flash; the card's base
# volume is never written (CARD_COW=1).
# =================================================================================================
