# =================================================================================================
# 970g - the D13 boot-path restore (armed-d13-321e3332).  The fix for the D13 entry silence.
#
# THE CAUSE (doc section 6f, corrected 2026-10-10).  The whole Darwin-13 entry->kernel line emitted
# ZERO console output (both D13 presses = the same entry bin 7107b998).  Real 970 capture:
#   mmu_ttbr0_after=0x006c4000  mmu_l1_table=0x006c4000   (the payload writes TTBR0 =
#   stage90_l1_table, PA 0x6c4000, BELOW 0x80000000).  entry_live_init refuses a table outside the
#   kernel window (entry_stubs.c:2308, why=1), and that refusal is SILENT (its own record travels
#   through the console it just refused).  The table stays low because D13 __start takes its MMU
#   fast path (locore.s:61 beq mmu_initialized, taken - the payload jumps in with M=1), which
#   SKIPS the boot path: TTBR0 is never set high and the boot table at topOfKernelData is never
#   built.  4570 boots because its start.s has no such branch.
#
# THE FIX (970g, D13 osfmk/arm/locore.s ONLY - a tree edit, scripted in
# tools/patch_d13_boot_path.py + tools/stage_d13_boot_path.sh, so a re-checkout re-applies it):
#   edit 1 - REMOVE the fast path, so __start always runs the boot path (builds the boot table,
#            sets TTBR0 = topOfKernelData|0x18, a HIGH base);
#   edit 2 - ZERO the boot table after the TTBR0 write, exactly as 4570 start.s:159-167 does
#            (invalidate_tte: ARM_TTE_TYPE_FAULT=0 over 10240 words = 0xa000 bytes =
#            STAGE90_XNU_ENTRY_TABLE_BYTES).  D13 omitted it, so every slot the map: loop does not
#            reach - INCLUDING the console L1 slot (0xde500000>>20 = 0xde5), far above memSize -
#            kept stale DRAM and entry_section_install refused it as OCCUPIED even with a HIGH
#            table.  The working 4570 capture reads xnu_live_slot_before=0x00000000: the slot was
#            zero before the install.  Edit 1 alone is NOT sufficient.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE (the linked image, not source): __start at 0x80000000 falls straight into
# mmu_reinitialize (no beq); TTBR0 write at 0x4c; _970g_zero_tte (0x64) runs the 10240-word loop;
# then the PC section map and the map: loop - exactly 4570 order.  The PC section is mapped after
# the zeroing and before the walk, so the TTBR0 switch cannot fault the running code (its section
# TLB entry, taken at the payload invalidate_tlbs, is still warm).
#
# WHAT THE PRESS DECIDES.  If the cause is right, the D13 entry line becomes OBSERVABLE for the
# first time: xnu_live_console and the first ~15 keys (the init block and the first wrapped probes,
# which fire inside arm_init BEFORE arm_vm_init) appear.  The console is still lost AT arm_vm_init
# (D13 arm_vm_init.c:352-353 bzero`s a FRESH cpu_ttb where 4570 bcopy`s the boot table - a SECOND,
# separate defect, a later rung), so keys after that switch are not expected yet.
#
# SCOPE.  Not 3 GB (958/915-B).  Not the arm_vm_init boot-table copy (a later rung).  Reversible:
# fastboot boot only, never flash; the card base is never written (CARD_COW=1).  PRESS IS THE
# OPERATOR.
# =================================================================================================

# 970h - the D13 boot-path PRE-SWITCH TLB-flush removal (armed-d13-299ee994).  The 970g press is
# SILENT (capture 970g-armed-d13-321e3332-20261010, ZERO xnu_live_* keys, log ends at 'jumping to
# XNU's _start'), so 970g is FALSIFIED and the boot path was NOT the whole cause.
#
# THE CAUSE (doc 970h).  D13 mmu_reinitialize ran a WHOLE-TLB invalidate (locore.s:85,
# 'mcr p15,0,r4,c8,c7,0') BEFORE the TTBR0 write (:113) and before the zero/map loops build the boot
# table.  The payload jumps into the entry with the MMU ON (sctlr_before=0x00c5487b, caches OFF) and
# its L1 identity-maps [0x80000000,0x81000000) (src/mmu.c:5506), so at the jump VA 0x80a00000 (the
# boot table, topOfKernelData) a valid identity TLB entry is LIVE.  4570 relies on exactly that: its
# _start has NO pre-switch TLB maintenance (its only c8,c7,0 is at start.s:337, AFTER the table is
# built), and its first post-switch store - invalidate_tte's str to the SAME VA 0x80a00000 - does not
# fault, which is only possible if a live identity entry survived the switch (ARMv7 does not
# auto-invalidate the TLB on a TTBR write).  D13's pre-switch flush DESTROYED that entry, so 970g's
# zero loop's first store (str r3,[r5],#4 to VA 0x80a00000) had to WALK the just-switched stale table,
# whose slot 0x80a holds DRAM (no descriptor) -> translation fault.  With cpsid if set (locore.s:55)
# and VBAR still the PAYLOAD's (D13 sets its own only at :235), the abort-vector fetch itself faults:
# a double fault, no print, watchdog reset.  That is the WHOLE D13-line silence.
#
# THE FIX (970h, D13 osfmk/arm/locore.s ONLY - a tree edit, scripted in tools/patch_d13_boot_path_970h.py
# + tools/stage_d13_boot_path_970h.sh, so a re-checkout re-applies it): REMOVE the pre-switch whole-TLB
# invalidate at :85, exactly as 4570's _start has none.  D13 already performs a safe whole-TLB invalidate
# AFTER the table is built (:274, in mmu_initialized - the same place 4570 does it), so the removed one
# is redundant.  The TTBCR write just below stays (a different operation).  The 970g edits (fast-path
# removal, boot-table zeroing) REMAIN.
#
# Verified BY VALUE in the LINKED image (out/stage90/xnu_arm_entry.elf): mmu_reinitialize @0x80000008
# runs DACR(0x8000000c)/I-cache(0x80000018)/TTBCR(0x8000001c) with NO cr8,cr7 before the TTBR0 write
# @0x80000048; _970g_zero_tte @0x80000060; the post-build flush cr8,cr7 @0x8000012c (mmu_initialized,
# :274) REMAINS.  The 970g elf had cr8,cr7 at 0x80000018 (where the new elf has the I-cache flush) -
# the whole difference is the one removed instruction, so the arm's switch record is byte-identical to
# 970g's (only the SHA256/BYTES fields move).  Entry bin 299ee994 (was 321e3332); payload switch set
# 6c2b6038 UNCHANGED (the change is entry-side only).  make check 0 (check_d13_boot_path_970h_staged
# wired in).  PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.
#
# WHAT THE PRESS DECIDES.  If the cause is right, the D13 entry line becomes OBSERVABLE for the first
# time: xnu_live_console and the first ~15 keys (the init block and the first wrapped probes, which fire
# inside arm_init BEFORE arm_vm_init).  The console is still lost AT arm_vm_init (D13 arm_vm_init.c:352
# bzero`s a FRESH cpu_ttb where 4570 bcopy`s the boot table - 971, staged, a LATER rung), so keys after
# that switch are not expected yet.  STILL ZERO keys => the cause is below __start too; recorded, not
# papered over.
#
# SCOPE.  Not 3 GB (958/915-B).  Not the arm_vm_init boot-table copy (971, staged).  Reversible:
# fastboot boot only, never flash; the card base is never written (CARD_COW=1).  PRESS IS THE OPERATOR.
# =================================================================================================

# 971 - D13's arm_vm_init carries the BOOT TABLE into the system table (armed-d13-89bcc6e3).  The
# 970h press BOOTED the D13 line for the first time (capture
# 970h-armed-d13-299ee994-20261010-last_kmsg.txt, 426731 B / 3981 lines: 32 xnu_live_* keys and the
# arm_vm_init console), and it stopped DEAD on the line 'arm_vm_init: switching translation-tables
# now...' with no abort and no panic - exactly the 971 frontier.
#
# THE CAUSE (doc 971).  D13 osfmk/arm/arm_vm_init.c:352-353 built the system table WRONG:
#     cpu_ttb = gTopOfKernel + L1_SIZE;
#     bzero((void*)phys_to_virt(cpu_ttb), L1_SIZE);     <-- a FRESH table, nothing copied
# 4570 (arm_vm_init.c:385-391) instead COPIES the boot table into the system table:
#     boot_ttep = args->topOfKernelData;
#     cpu_ttep  = boot_ttep + ARM_PGBYTES * 4;           <-- the SAME address D13 bzeroes
#     bcopy(boot_tte, cpu_tte, ARM_PGBYTES * 4);
# The entry's own source states the dependency by name (src/entry/entry_stubs.c:2210-2214): the
# console's descriptors survive set_mmu_ttb(cpu_ttb) BECAUSE arm_vm_init copies the boot table into
# the table the MMU walks afterwards.  D13 does no such copy, and D13's managed map is
# [MANAGED_BASE 0xC0000000, 0xC0000000 + gMemSize), which does NOT contain the console VA 0xde500000
# (RAM_CONSOLE_BASE).  So after the table switch the console's sections were gone, the slot fault
# had no translation, and every record written after arm_vm_init was dropped - the console died one
# rung later than 970g/970h, in exactly the way they were silent at _start.
#
# THE FIX (971, D13 osfmk/arm/arm_vm_init.c ONLY - a tree edit, scripted in tools/patch_d13_vm_init.py
# + tools/stage_d13_vm_init.sh, so a re-checkout re-applies it): replace the bzero with the 4570
# bcopy.  ONE statement.  4570 follows its copy with a loop writing ARM_TTE_TYPE_FAULT over the
# copied V==P L1 slots; D13 needs NO such loop because it maps the identity region FRESH after this
# point (l2_cache_to_range / l2_map_linear_range overwrite the L1 slots for [gVirtBase,
# gVirtBase+gMemSize)), and on this arm gPhysBase == gVirtBase == 0x80000000, so 4570's clear range
# is EMPTY.  The 970g + 970h locore.s edits REMAIN.
#
# Verified BY VALUE in the LINKED image (out/stage90/xnu_arm_entry.elf): arm_vm_init @0x8001e928
# calls bcopy @0x80015d20 at 0x8001e9d4 (the 299ee994 elf called bzero there).  The kernel object
# out/xnu_kernel_obj_d13/osfmk_arm_arm_vm_init.o moved from U bzero (only) to U bcopy + U bzero; its
# defined-symbol set is UNCHANGED (a faithful recompile of the same flags).  Entry bin 89bcc6e3 (was
# 299ee994); the payload's own switch record 6c2b6038 is BYTE-IDENTICAL (the 971 change is a kernel
# tree edit, so no arm switch moved; only the embedded entry copy did).
#
# WHAT THE PRESS DECIDES.  If the cause is right, keys AFTER arm_vm_init appear for the first time -
# the SMC/USB/storage probes and, if the boot is clean, the Darwin banner.  The 970h-only press is the
# control: it went silent right after the pre-arm_vm_init keys.  STILL STOPPING at arm_vm_init => the
# boot table is not the only place the console's descriptors live; the model is wrong one rung out.
# recorded, not papered over.
#
# SCOPE.  Not 3 GB (958/915-B).  Reversible: fastboot boot only, never flash; the card base is never
# written (CARD_COW=1).  PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.

# 958+971 - the 3 GB REPORT folded into the 971 console arm (armed-d13-7c230cf9).  This supersedes
# armed-d13-89bcc6e3 as the live arm.  It is NOT a new rung of the boot; it is the SAME two entry
# changes, but the second one is now actually IN the image.
#
# WHY THIS EXISTS - a claim in a record is not a check.  971's park armed-d13-89bcc6e3 RECORDED
# STAGE90_XNU_MEM_TOTAL=1 in its config, but its LINKED elf carries NO `entry_xnu_mem_total_arm_on`
# and its arm_vm_init never branches to PE_get_default: the 958 tree edit was NOT compiled into the
# object that arm shipped.  The 970h arm (299ee994) had the same gap.  So the 958 3 GB-recognition
# (「正确识别...3GB内存」) has never been in ANY image the device has booted - it was inert on every
# arm - and the record said otherwise.  That is the mi4-a-claim-in-a-comment-is-not-a-check class.
# src/entry/build_entry.sh now carries the missing REFUSAL: the MEM_TOTAL marker in the kernel object
# out/xnu_kernel_obj_d13/osfmk_arm_arm_vm_init.o must AGREE with the record's STAGE90_XNU_MEM_TOTAL,
# so neither half can lie about the other again.
#
# WHAT MOVED.  The kernel object was rebuilt from the STAGED sources with BOTH patches present -
# tools/stage_d13_vm_init.sh (971: bcopy the boot table into the system table, not bzero a fresh one)
# AND tools/stage_d13_memory_total.sh (958: read hw.memsize into max_mem alone) - and installed at
# out/xnu_kernel_obj_d13/osfmk_arm_arm_vm_init.o.  By value in the LINKED image: arm_vm_init
# @0x8001e928 calls bcopy @0x80015d20 (971) AND PE_get_default @0x80018290 (958), and the elf DEFINES
# entry_xnu_mem_total_arm_on @0x8001e928 (958's file-scope marker).  The 89bcc6e3 elf called bcopy but
# had NEITHER the PE_get_default call NOR the marker.
#
# ONE PRESS, TWO READINGS, AND THEY ARE INDEPENDENT.  The 958 read runs FIRST: `max_mem = hw.memsize`
# is set at arm_vm_init + ~0xa0, BEFORE the 971 bcopy at +0xf0 and BEFORE the "switching
# translation-tables now..." print at arm_vm_init.c:439.  So a clean arm answers BOTH questions in one
# press - (958) the boot continues past arm_vm_init and reports 3 GB, (971) the console survives the
# table switch and the post-arm_vm_init keys appear - and a STOP at the switch line still means the
# 971 console cause was wrong, exactly as armed-d13-89bcc6e3 would have told us.  See
# docs/experiments/experiment-958-mem-total-inert-until-now.md and experiment-971-*.
#
# SCOPE.  Not the pmap.  max_mem is the REPORTED total only; mem_size/sane_size stay the boot bank
# (0x5e500000) and the managed map stays [0xC0000000, +gMemSize) - so this does NOT by itself make the
# low bank allocatable (that is 915-B).  Reversible: fastboot boot only, never flash; the card base is
# never written (CARD_COW=1).  PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.
# =================================================================================================

# 972 - the D13 asm de-underscore step STRIPPED a C-facing underscore name (armed-d13-0184b928).  The
# 2026-10-10 press of armed-d13-7c230cf9 is the FIRST D13 press to get PAST arm_vm_init. 971's ########
# console fix WORKS: the capture (971-armed-d13-7c230cf9-20261010-last_kmsg.txt, 4530 lines) carries
# 'arm_vm_init: switching translation-tables now...' and THEN 'arm_vm_init: setting up segment
# information...' - keys AFTER the switch, for the first time. The boot then STOPPED DEAD on
# 'a symbol this image does not provide was called', stub_hit=_disable_preemption, caller=0x8002c140
# (printf). Device returned clean in 17 s; no brick; 'No errors detected'.
#
# THE CAUSE. D13 osfmk/arm/cpu_data.h:145 says `#define disable_preemption  _disable_preemption`, so
# D13's C COMPILER emits a call to `_disable_preemption` (1 leading underscore). machine_routines_asm.s
# :171 `EnterARM(_disable_preemption)` expands - via asm_help.h's `_##function` - to the SAME symbol
# `_disable_preemption`. But tools/assemble_arm_layer.sh's de-underscore step (the ELF flag's own rule,
# `_x`->`x`) STRIPPED that one underscore, leaving the object defining only `disable_preemption` (0) and
# ``__disable_preemption``/``___disable_preemption`` - while the C reference kept its 1-underscore name,
# which no object defined, so it linked against the entry's `entry_stub_hit` stub (0x8049bbe4).
# The reference repo (HTC-Leo-Revival-Project/xnu, machine_routines_asm.s:170-172) carries the identical
# three `EnterARM(_*preemption)` lines, so this is a latent D13-lineage trap, not something this project
# introduced - it merely became REACHABLE once the boot passed arm_vm_init (971).
#
# THE FIX (tools/assemble_arm_layer.sh ONLY - a builder edit, no tree change). The de-underscore step
# now PRESERVES the exact set of underscore names that appear on the right-hand side of a
# `#define NAME _NAME` in the selected tree's osfmk/arm/*.h - the mechanical definition of 'a C
# identifier whose spelling already begins with an underscore'. Derived, not hard-coded. On the 4570
# tree that set is {_COMM_PAGE32_BASE_ADDRESS,_COMM_PAGE64_BASE_ADDRESS} (cpu_data.h's is a FUNCTION
# macro the anchored pattern does not match), neither of which any 4570 asm OBJECT defines, so 4570's
# objects are BYTE-IDENTICAL with and without the guard - the guard is INERT on 4570.
#
# Verified BY VALUE in the LINKED image: machine_routines_asm.o now defines `_disable_preemption`
# (1 underscore) at 0x8001ab60 (the real asm), where the 7c230cf9 elf's was the stub at 0x8049bbe4.
#
# SCOPE. Not 3 GB (958). Reversible: fastboot boot only, never flash; CARD_COW=1. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.
# =================================================================================================

# armed-d13-12427611  —  973: the 914 board platform expert (src/platform/darwin13/pe_msm8974.c) is
# WIRED INTO THE ENTRY LINK.
#
# WHY. The 2026-10-10 press of armed-d13-0184b928 (972 CONFIRMED) advanced one rung past
# `_disable_preemption` and STOPPED on `stub_hit=PE_init_SocSupport_stub`, caller
# `0x8048bd50` = `PE_init_platform+0x2c` (capture 972-press-armed-d13-0184b928-20261010). The
# reported stub was the GENERATED one (body `movw/movt r0,#name; b entry_stub_hit`). The REAL body
# exists — `out/xnu_arm_obj_d13/pe_msm8974.o` (the 914 experiment compiled it and measured 1/1) —
# but that pool is in NO link list in build_entry.sh, so `PE_init_SocSupport_stub` stayed undefined
# and the stub generator fabricated the one the run stopped on. This is
# [[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]] with the value being "the board PE is compiled": compiled is
# not linked.
#
# THE FIX (a build-tool change only; no tree edit). Four links that tools/check_board_pe_wired.sh
# re-derives from the SOURCES (each, if reverted, re-arms the generating stub SILENTLY):
#   (a) tools/build_xnu_arm_kernel.sh's platform block COMPILES src/platform/darwin13/pe_msm8974.c
#       with -DBOARD_CONFIG_MSM8974=1 (the file's own #if gate) into $XNU_PLATFORM_OBJ_OUT
#       (out/xnu_platform_obj_d13/pe_msm8974.o);
#   (b) src/entry/build_entry.sh declares STAGE90_PE_MSM8974_OBJ (default
#       $XNU_PLATFORM_OBJ_OUT/pe_msm8974.o), requires it, freshness-checks it, and NAMES it in
#       LINK_OBJS — plus a LINKED-IMAGE clause that reads PE_init_SocSupport_stub BY VALUE and
#       refuses the generated stub (the body that tail-calls entry_stub_hit) and requires
#       PE_init_SocSupport_msm8974.
# The check's --selftest mutates each and asserts each is refused; it is wired into `make check`.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE in the linked image out/stage90/xnu_arm_entry.elf:
#   PE_init_SocSupport_stub    T 0x801ae3ec   body: bl 8048bcd4 <PE_early_puts>  (the REAL board PE)
#   PE_init_SocSupport_msm8974 T 0x801ae2f0   msm8974_putc T 0x801ae290
# 972's fix is also present: _disable_preemption T 0x8001ab60.
#
# **The build_entry.sh 973 edits landed at 2026-10-10 13:48, AFTER the 13:34 entry build this arm
# FIRST parked (c879f31a, from a since-replaced build_entry.sh 8901262e). Rebuilding the entry
# image from the CURRENT tree (build_entry.sh 826f4982) reproduces 12427611 byte-for-byte (built
# twice, identical). The arm is 12427611.**
#
# SCOPE. Not 3 GB (958); not the USB ladder (959–962). stage90-build-config.txt is BYTE-IDENTICAL
# to 968/970h/971/972's 6c2b6038 — 973 moves NO arm switch (the board PE is linked, not switched in
# by a STAGE90_XNU_* key). Medium: 968's real iOS 7.1.2 HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; HDD_WRITE=0, the
# BASE IS NEVER WRITTEN — fully reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR'S.

#
# WHY. 973 linked the 914 board PE and its press (2026-10-10) DID NOT RETURN (972, one rung below,
# returned clean in ~17 s). The board PE fills `gPESocDispatch`; `pe_init.c:146` calls

# the serial/uart route. The old private ring (MSM8974_CONSOLE_BYTES / msm8974_console) is deleted.

# armed-d13-97d6a511  —  979: 977 with the entry.ld PAGE-ALIGNMENT fix that stops pmap_init NX-ing the last
# text page (the `ipc_bootstrap` panic experiment-979 recovered).
#
# WHY. The 977 press (armed-d13-d693864f) was recovered by recover_last_kmsg.sh and is a real
# XNU boot: it passed arm_vm_init, pmap_bootstrap, vm_page_bootstrap, printed Darwin Kernel
# Version, then PANICKED `Kernel prefetch abort` at pc=lock_set_init+0 (lr=ipc_bootstrap+0x194,
# fsr=0x0f). ROOT CAUSE: the entry `.text` ended at __entry_text_end = 0x805699a0 (ALIGN(32),
# NOT page-aligned) while the linker put the real `.data` output section on the next page
# 0x8056a000. pmap_init (`osfmk/arm/pmap.c:3620`) runs a data-NX loop from sdata = __entry_data_start
# = 0x805699a0; its first iteration pmap_pte(0x805699a0) resolved to the LAST TEXT PAGE
# [0x80569000,0x8056a000) -- holding lock_set_init -- and set L2_NX_BIT on it, making it
# non-executable. pmap_asid_configure (also in pmap_init) still printed its line, so the loop
# is on the path. A real kernel __DATA.vmaddr is page-aligned, so this never happens there.
#
# THE FIX (src/entry/entry.ld). Pad `.text` to a page (STAGE90_ENTRY_ALIGN 0x1000, was ALIGN(32))
# so __entry_text_end == __entry_data_start == 0x8056a000 = the real .data page. pad is INSIDE
# the .text section so __TEXT covers it and no uncovered gap is left between the segments.
#
# THE ARM = 977 with the one entry.ld change. Every switch is 977 s. The ENTRY BIN MOVED
# (d693864f -> 97d6a511).
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE: nm __entry_text_end == __entry_data_start == 0x8056a000, __TEXT vmsize
# 0x56a000 (was 0x5699a0); host_entry_macho_check OK; make check 0. Medium: 968 real iOS 7.1.2
# HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; CARD_COW=1, HDD_WRITE=0, the base is never written - fully
# reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash. PRESS IS THE OPERATOR S.

# armed-d13-fa301bd7  —  980: 979 rebuilt so the L2.1 kernel edit and the entry image agree, carrying BOTH
# the 979 page-alignment fix and the L2.1 timebase publication.
#
# WHY. 979 = 977 with the entry.ld PAGE-ALIGNMENT fix. That fix retired the `ipc_bootstrap`
# panic (pc=lock_set_init+0, fsr=0x0f) experiment-979 recovered: entry `.text` had ended at
# __entry_text_end = 0x805699a0 (ALIGN(32), NOT page-aligned) while the real `.data` output
# section sat on the next page 0x8056a000, so pmap_init (osfmk/arm/pmap.c:3620) started its
# data-NX loop at __entry_data_start = 0x805699a0 and set L2_NX_BIT on the LAST TEXT PAGE
# [0x80569000,0x8056a000) - holding lock_set_init. entry.ld now pads `.text` to a page.
#
# L2.1 (the reason THIS arm exists). rtc_configure was DEFINED in the linked image but had
# ZERO callers, so gPEClockFrequencyInfo.timebase_frequency_hz and rtclock_sec_divisor stayed
# 0; rtclock_bus_configure (osfmk/arm/rtclock.c:294/:297) panics on either, at the next
# reachable stop after ipc_bootstrap (clock_init -> clock_oldinit -> rtclock_init).
# pe_msm8974.c now sets gPEClockFrequencyInfo.timebase_frequency_hz = 19.2 MHz (0x124f800,
# offset 0x24) and calls rtc_configure(cntfrq) unconditionally, from ONE value.
#
# 979 arm could not simply be pressed: the L2.1 edit makes the source newer than 979 s
# embedded image, so preflight_boot_check.sh refuses 979 s live bytes as STALE. This arm is
# 979 s switch set rebuilt so source and image agree. The switch set is 979 s UNCHANGED; only
# the ENTRY BIN moved (97d6a511 -> fa301bd7).
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE: the linked entry ELF has 3 `bl <rtc_configure>` sites (979 had 0);
# tools/check_rtc_published.sh passes here and FAILs on 979 s image; check_machine_init_body.sh
# ok; make check 0. Medium: 968 real iOS 7.1.2 HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; CARD_COW=1,
# HDD_WRITE=0, the base is never written - fully reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash.
# PRESS IS THE OPERATOR S.

# armed-d13-8cfb7ca8  —  982: 981 rebuilt on the kernel sources with the GIC interrupt fix. Two kernel
# fixes 981 predates: the GIC CPU interface is read through an ml_io_map VA, not the raw
# physical (EDIT A); the same handler services the timer PPI via rtclock_intr (EDIT B).
#
# EDIT A (pe_msm8974.c msm8974_gic_map + msm8974_handle_interrupt). 981 took a section
# translation fault in interrupt context: sleh_abort, r0=0xf900200c pc=0x801ae3ac fsr=0x5
# far=0xf900200c. The faulting ldr read the RAW PHYSICAL GICC_IAR; XNU pmap does not translate
# 0xf9002000 (arm_vm_init copies the boot L1 then overwrites only [physBase,physBase+gMemSize)
# and the managed window, so the entry 0xf9000000 device section does not survive set_mmu_ttb).
# The fix ml_io_maps GICC (PE_init_SocSupport_msm8974) and reads IAR/EOIR through the VA, with a
# NULL-guard returning rather than repeating the abort. Peers (pe_apq8060.c:128-129) and the
# reference (HTC-Leo-Revival-Project/xnu pe_msm8974.c) map-then-read; ours read physical.
#
# EDIT B (pe_msm8974.c same handler, timer line). The handler is the live post-XNU dispatcher
# (EDIT A s fault proves it), so it must also service the timer PPI INTID 20 (entry_gic.h) by
# calling rtclock_intr(context) after EOI, as every peer (pe_apq8060.c:246) and the reference
# do. Before 982 rtclock_intr had NO caller: ack+EOI alone never re-arms the countdown.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE in the linked ELF: msm8974_handle_interrupt loads the g_msm8974_gicc global
# (movw/movt r1,#0x8084bc24; ldr r1,[r1]; cmp; beq; ldr r2,[r1,#12]; ...cmp r2,#20;
# b <rtclock_intr>), NOT movt r0,#0xf900; PE_init_SocSupport_msm8974 has bl <ml_io_map>.
#
# Switch set is 981 s UNCHANGED; the ENTRY BIN moved (7fbd7009 -> 8cfb7ca8). VERIFIED: preflight
# ok, make check 0. Medium: 968 real iOS 7.1.2 HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; CARD_COW=1,
# HDD_WRITE=0, base never written - fully reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash.

# armed-d13-31bdebf3  -  1006: THE IDLE-PATH FREEZE WITNESS (a sampler on the powers-of-two ladder of `__wrap_machine_idle`
# passes, timing each pass with entry_counter() and reading the GIC/CPSR AT the reading, keys
# xnu_live_freeze_{n,d,cpsr,ien,pend,ctlr} + the unfiltered early baseline xnu_live_frzbase_{n,d}),
# so the CAUSE of the ~24.4 s whole-interrupt-path freeze partitions into (i) IRQ-masked window,
# (ii) GIC distributor re-mask, (iii) an ISR that never EOI-d, (iv) a non-idle fault loop.
# Switch set is 1005-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_FREEZE_WITNESS=1 (CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE,
# DYLD_WITNESS, SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM, RESIDENT, USVC and SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP all stay
# 1); the ENTRY BIN moved (ff937225 -> 31bdebf3); the PAYLOAD moves (it embeds the entry blob; the 29 s
# watchdog constant is 999-s, unchanged); the TREE does NOT move - 1006 has NO tree edit and NO
# stage driver (the change is FOUR src/ files: entry_stubs.c the sampler, entry_trace.c the ONE
# idle-path call, entry_irq.c the one GIC helper, entry_gic.h its declaration).
#
# THE FRONTIER, BY VALUE (records/1005-press-read.txt): the STALL is (b2) a WHOLE-INTERRUPT-PATH
# FREEZE - tick = irq - 3 is CONSTANT across the whole run (every interrupt IS a timer tick), the
# pid-1 SVC path froze with it, for a single repeatable ~24.4 s interval (xnu_live_tick_sum_maxd =
# 0x1be8bc01), after which the tick BURSTS (135 -> 479) while the machine stays ALIVE (No errors
# detected).  1006 asks THE CAUSE.  NOTE (1006-s own correction): the capture CANNOT tie the freeze
# to a feed - entry_counter() wraps every ~3.7 min and the pet publishes only 8 gated endpoints -
# so the idle/wfi overlap is made a READING, not an assumption.
#
# THE 1006 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted) is
# written by the TEAM-LEAD into scripts/press_1006.sh: THE READING is the classifier of the record
# with the LARGEST xnu_live_freeze_d - i=(cpsr>>7)&1 (1 = IRQ masked) - against the GIC triple
# (ien = ISENABLER0 bit 20, pend = ISPENDR0 bit 20, ctlr = CTLR): IRQs ENABLED + line ENABLED+PENDING
# = a long NON-IDLE stretch (a fault loop or a wfi that did not wake); IRQs MASKED = (i); line
# DISABLED = (ii); CTLR 0 = a global sub-case of (ii).  ZERO freeze records but the idle baseline
# present = a VALID silence (the freeze did not overlap the idle path) - a READING, NOT a failure.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE (build_1006.sh): the linked image carries the 6 xnu_live_freeze_ key literals +
# the 2 xnu_live_frzbase_ key literals and the two freeze symbols DEFINED T/t, with exactly ONE bl to
# entry_freeze_sample image-wide, and the FROZEN 1005 elf (armed-d13-ff937225) as the NEGATIVE
# CONTROL (xnu_live_freeze_ x0, entry_freeze_sample x0); the 1005 cadence witness, the 1004 abort

# __wrap_machine_idle is NEVER entered on the recent D13 tail (its sampler fired 0x).  The terminal
# frame is sleh_abort+0x468, an unconditional forward branch, NOT a fault-return self-loop - so the

#

# xnu_live_abt_maxgap against xnu_live_tick_sum_maxd (M): (A) both << M = the 24.4 s is NOT on the
# abort path; (B) maxgap ~ M, maxcall small = the freeze is BETWEEN two aborts; (C) maxcall ~ M =
# ONE abort took 24.4 s; (D) n/seq plateau with no key near M = the freeze is AFTER the last abort.
# xnu_live_stub_hit_seq == 0 is the §2.3 guard (the terminal stand-in must NOT fire).
#

# fault - pc=0x2be8a1a0 (in the dyld shared cache), fsr=0x0000080f (WnR=1 (a write) | FS=0xf
# "permission fault, level 2"), cpsr=0x60000030 (USER mode, IRQ on), far=0x9a000 (a LOW user VA,
# below the TTBR0 split 0x40000000, in one of launchd-s own COW/data segments) - CONSTANT from
# ordinal 0x400 through 0x200000 (~2.09 M aborts).  What 1009 could NOT say is WHY the fault is
# never dismissed: the handler PRINTS on the failure branch and is SILENT on the retry branch,
# and the capture shows the silent branch, so vm_fault returned KERN_SUCCESS || KERN_ABORTED.
#
# THE 1010 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted) is
# written by the TEAM-LEAD into scripts/press_1010.sh: THE HEADLINE (A) is the L2 descriptor at the
# TAIL ordinals - xnu_live_abt_ptel2 / xnu_live_abt_pten paired with xnu_live_abt_pcfar.  Decide
# CONSTANT-vs-CYCLING on the TAIL ROWS- OWN _ptel2 (ordinals >= 0x400), NEVER on the whole-run
# xnu_live_abt_ptenx (the 1009 measurement defect, not repeated).  Decode _ptel2: bits[1:0] type
# (0b10 = small page), bit 9 = APX (1 = user READ-ONLY), bit 5 = USER, bit 0 = NX,
# bits[31:12] = PA.  The expected row is APX=1 + vm_fault KERN_SUCCESS => "the PTE is read-only
# though vm_fault said success" - the cs-taint/prot-downgrade path.  (B) is xnu_live_abt_vmfret
# (KERN_SUCCESS=0 / KERN_ABORTED=14) - it splits KERN_SUCCESS from KERN_ABORTED and is the only
# source of that distinction.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE (build_1010.sh): the linked image carries the 29 xnu_live_abt_ key literals
# (6 span + 5 far + 7 pc + 12 pte/vmf), entry_note_abt_pte/entry_note_abt_vmf/__wrap_vm_fault
# DEFINED T/t, exactly ONE b/bl to entry_note_abt_pte inside __wrap_sleh_abort image-wide, and
# the __wrap_vm_fault body calling __real_vm_fault AND entry_note_abt_vmf, with the FROZEN 1009
# elf (armed-d13-24997fc5) as the NEGATIVE CONTROL (xnu_live_abt_ x18, entry_note_abt_pc x>=1,
# but the 1010 symbols x0 and the 1010 literals x0 - the 1010 change is NOT in the 1009 arm);
# the 1009/1008/1007 witnesses, the 1006 freeze witness, the 1005 cadence witness, the 1004
# abort trace (xnu_live_sleh_upc x1), the 1003 stall instrument and the 1002 six-word save set
# asserted present (regressions).  The 996/997/998/999/1000/1001 checkers rerun ON the 1010
# image - the probe checker-s ONE by-design frozen 20 B clause is the only allowed FAIL.
#
# Medium: 968 real iOS 7.1.2 HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; CARD_COW=1, HDD_WRITE=0, base never
# written - fully reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash.

# armed-d13-fce83837  -  1011: THE vm_map_entry EFFECTIVE PROTECTION + THE FAULTING THREAD-S OWN L1 BASE
# (publishes vm_map_lookup_locked-s out_prot for the storm-s fault, and the L1 base the faulting
# thread-s own map/pmap names, so the reader can decide F1a vs F1b WITHOUT a tree patch and WITHOUT a
# struct offset; design docs/1011-design-v2.md)
# Switch set is 1010c-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_VME_PROT=1 (ABT_PTE, ABT_PC, ABT_FAR, ABT_SPAN,
# FREEZE_WITNESS, CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE, DYLD_WITNESS, SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM,
# RESIDENT, USVC and SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP all stay 1); the ENTRY BIN moved (002b0683 -> fce83837); the
# PAYLOAD moves (it embeds the entry blob; the 29 s watchdog constant is 999-s, unchanged); the
# TREE does NOT move - 1011 has NO tree edit and NO stage driver (the change is THREE src/ files
# plus ONE conditional --wrap: entry_stubs.c the (A) reader + g_abtpte_vmelatch + the _ptethr store
# + the (E-prime) recorder, entry_trace.c the declaration + __wrap_vm_map_lookup_locked,
# entry_saved_state.h STAGE90_PMAP_L1_PHYS=0, build_entry.sh --wrap=vm_map_lookup_locked only when
# VME_PROT=1).
#
# THE FRONTIER 1011 PROBES (records/1010c-press-read.txt): the storm is a USER-mode WRITE permission
# fault - pc=0x2be4d1a0 (in the dyld shared cache), fsr=0x0000080f (WnR=1 | FS=0xf "level-2 perm
# fault"), far=0x5d000 (a LOW user VA). The 1010c walk is WINDOW-BOUNDED but reads the WRONG TABLE
# at the storm: with the mask fixed to 0xffffc000 it reads the TRUE L1 base 0x81a84000, whose slot
# for the fault VA holds a SECTION descriptor (ptel1=0xfeedface, bits[1:0]=0b10), so the walk
# returns early (entry_stubs.c:2291, (l1e&3)!=1) and the L2 LEAF (APX) is NEVER read. F1a/F1b are
# UNDECIDABLE from 1010c.
#
# THE 1011 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted):
# THE HEADLINE MUST be decided from the TAIL ROWS-OWN xnu_live_abt_vmeprot (ordinals >= 0x400 on the
# powers-of-two ladder), NEVER on the whole-run change count (the 1009 measurement defect, not
# repeated). (E-prime) DECISION TREE (docs/1011-design-v2.md §3):
#   * xnu_live_abt_vmeprot & VM_PROT_WRITE (0x2) != 0 at the tail => F1a: the vm_map_entry GRANTS
#     write, so the write is LOST between the entry and the PTE (the prot->PTE path, or the entry-s
#     protection is not what the fault is serviced with).
#   * (xnu_live_abt_vmeprot & 0x2) == 0 at the tail => F1b: the entry does NOT grant write, so the
#     accept path-s UNCONDITIONAL `kr = KERN_SUCCESS` (vm_fault.c:2478) is the wrong condition -
#     the fault is accepted although the entry is read-only, and the retry is forever.
#   * xnu_live_abt_vmekr names vm_map_lookup_locked-s return (KERN_SUCCESS=0 / KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS=1
#     / KERN_PROTECTION_FAILURE=2 / KERN_NO_SPACE=3).  _vmefault is the fault_type (VM_PROT_*).
# (A) THE L1-BASE CELL: compare xnu_live_abt_ptethr (the faulting thread-s own L1 base) with
# xnu_live_abt_ptettbr (the live TTBR0 the walk sampled).  AGREE => the walk read the right table
# and the non-coarse _ptel1 IS a real L1 slot (the storm VA is served by a SECTION mapping, or the
# TTBR0 the handler runs with is not the one that faulted).  DIFFER => the walk and the handler look
# at DIFFERENT tables - the 1010c frontier, now MEASURED.

# `prot` unconditionally, so a write-bearing `prot` here MUST yield a writable leaf and a read-only one
# here IS the F1a loss; design docs/1012-design.md)
# Switch set is 1011-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_PMP_ENTER=1 (VME_PROT, ABT_PTE, ABT_PC, ABT_FAR,

# build_entry.sh --wrap=pmap_enter_options only when PMP_ENTER=1).  The companion TREE probe
# STAGE90_XNU_WRSTRIP (tools/patch_d13_wrstrip.py, the vm_fault.c strip sites) is SEPARATE and
# optional - this arm does not require it.
#
# THE FRONTIER 1012 PROBES (records/1011-press-read.txt): 1011 DECIDED the fault class BY VALUE -
# the (E-prime) tail rows carry vmeprot=0x3 (READ|WRITE) with vmekr=0 (KERN_SUCCESS), so the vm_map
# ENTRY GRANTS write and F1b is REFUTED BY VALUE; F1a stands - the write is LOST between the entry
# and the PTE.  What 1011 could NOT name is WHERE.  On this tree pmap_enter_options dispatches to
# leo_enter (pmap.c:3181), which REBUILDS the leaf UNCONDITIONALLY from the `prot` it is handed
# (leo_pte_build -> pmap_vm_prot_to_page_flags CLEARS APX iff prot & VM_PROT_WRITE), and every
# leo_enter path ends in pmap_flush_tlbs.  PMAP_ENTER_OPTIONS (osfmk/vm/pmap.h:399) is a
# CROSS-object call, so --wrap=pmap_enter_options redirects every linker-visible caller (pmap.c-s
# own intra-object pmap_enter -> pmap_enter_options is NOT wrapped).
#
# THE 1012 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted):
# THE HEADLINE MUST be decided from the TAIL ROWS-OWN xnu_live_abt_pmpprot (ordinals >= 0x400 on the
# powers-of-two ladder), NEVER on the whole-run change count (the 1009 measurement defect, not
# repeated).  THE DECISION TREE (docs/1012-design.md §4):
#   * tail xnu_live_abt_pmpprot & VM_PROT_WRITE (0x2) == 0 => (b) a STRIP SITE fired above the
#     apex: `prot` LOST write.  Prime suspects: the RetryFault block vm_fault.c:3845 (`prot &=
#     retry_prot`, whose verify re-lookup deliberately passes fault_type & ~VM_PROT_WRITE) and :3855
#     (the ~VM_PROT_WRITE clear after a copy-object change) - both INVISIBLE to 1011-s single-shot
#     (E-prime) latch.  The fix is at the strip site; the F4 retry-bound
#     (tools/patch_d13_abt_retry_bound.py) is the safety net.
#   * tail xnu_live_abt_pmpprot & 0x2 != 0 AND bits[31:12] of xnu_live_abt_pmppmap == bits[31:12] of
#     xnu_live_abt_pmpttbr => (c) the apex AGREES with the MMU-walked base but the leaf is still
#     read-only => the loss is INSIDE leo_enter/leo_pte_build (read pmap.c:1640-1682 by value with
#     the measured `prot`).
#   * tail xnu_live_abt_pmpprot & 0x2 != 0 AND bits[31:12] of pmppmap != bits[31:12] of pmpttbr =>
#     (c) an IDENTITY FAULT: the pmap writes one L1, the MMU walks another (a pmap_expand_ttb hoist
#     not followed by a TTBR0 load, or a stale pm_l1_phys).
#   * NO tail row => the storm-s enter did NOT reach the wrapper (the intra-object blindness): fall
#     back to the tree instrument.  xnu_live_abt_pmpnx is the DISTINCT-`prot` change count (an
#     OBSERVATION on the whole run, not the headline).  The _pmppmap/_pmpttbr pair ALSO closes the
#     1010c/1011 walk-mask question for good.
#

# armed-d13-9cf2f15e  -  1013: THE LEAF-VALUE WITNESS - the leaf the pmap ACTUALLY writes, and the location
# the MMU-s own walk finds it at (design docs/1013-design.md)
# Switch set is 1012-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_PTE_WITNESS=1 (PMP_ENTER, VME_PROT, ABT_PTE,
# ABT_PC, ABT_FAR, ABT_SPAN, FREEZE_WITNESS, CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE, DYLD_WITNESS,
# SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM, RESIDENT, USVC and SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP all stay 1); the ENTRY
# BIN moved (ffdc8ba1 -> 9cf2f15e); the PAYLOAD moves (it embeds the entry blob; the 29 s watchdog
# constant is 999-s, unchanged); the TREE does NOT move - 1013 has NO tree edit, NO stage driver and
# NO new --wrap (the change is TWO src/ files: entry_stubs.c the four recorders
# entry_note_abt_wleaf/walk/wsync/cur + g_abtpte_ptel2rec + g_abtpte_curva, entry_trace.c the four
# declarations + the four call sites; it rides 1012-s --wrap=pmap_enter_options and the existing
# --wrap=sleh_abort).
#
# WHY 1013 FOLLOWS 1012.  The 1012 press (arm armed-d13-ffdc8ba1, records/1012-press-read.txt)
# MEASURED the apex BY VALUE: every TAIL row (ordinal >= 0x400) carries xnu_live_abt_pmpprot=0x3
# (READ|WRITE) AND xnu_live_abt_pmppmap & 0xFFFFFF00 (0x81a86000) == xnu_live_abt_pmpttbr &
# 0xFFFFFF00 - so the write ARRIVES at pmap_enter_options and the pmap writes the SAME L1 table the
# MMU walks.  strip-above-the-apex (the last F1a candidate) is REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT.  Yet the
# USER store still permission-faults (fsr=0x80f, FS=15 level-2, WnR=1) ~2.1 M times.  The ONE cell
# nobody has read is the cell the fault is about: THE VALUE OF THE LEAF.  1013 reads it, three
# ways, and changes nothing.
#
# THE 1013 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted):
# THE HEADLINE MUST be decided from the TAIL ROWS-OWN values (ordinal >= 0x400), NEVER on a
# whole-run change count (the 1008/1009 measurement defect, not repeated).  THE DECISION TABLE
# (docs/1013-design.md §3):
#   V1  W-APEX leaf APX=0 (WRITABLE) at W-APEX-s own location AND W-WALK-s wkl2pa == wwl2pa =>
#       LEAF_WRITABLE_STILL_FAULTS: the leaf IS writable in the table the pmap wrote and the MMU
#       walks, yet the store still faults => a STALE TLB / a second table the TLB holds / the
#       flush did not reach this CPU.  Next rung instruments pmap_flush_tlbs + the ASID at the
#       fault.
#   V2  W-APEX leaf APX=1 (READ-ONLY) at W-APEX-s own location AND wkl2pa == wwl2pa =>
#       F1a_CONFIRMED_LEAF_DEFECT: the pmap-s write did NOT stick, or a SECOND writer re-RO-d the
#       leaf.  Next rung instruments the second writer (pmap_page_protect etc.).
#   V3  any readable W-APEX leaf AND wkl2pa != wwl2pa => IDENTITY_FAULT_L2: the apex writes one L2
#       and the MMU walks another.  (1012 measured the L1 bases EQUAL, so the divergence is at the
#       L2 - a pmap_expand hoist / a pm_l1_virt vs pm_l1_phys L2 mismatch.)
#   V4  W-APEX present but wwnoproof=1 (pm_l1_phys != the live TTBR0 base at that row) =>
#       APEX_NOT_PROOF: a by-value CONTRADICTION with 1012; REPORT it, do not conclude from it.
#   V5  W-APEX absent (wwn == 0) yet the storm ran => NO_APEX_WITNESS: the enter never reached the
#       wrapper; fall back to the tree instrument.
#   V6  W-APEX leaf absent/0 while wwl1 is a COARSE descriptor => HARD (stale 0): a present L2 with
#       no leaf is impossible for a correct walk - a MEASUREMENT defect, never a value.
#   V0  THE PROVENANCE GATE (applied BEFORE V1-V3; the 1012 apex defect this rung must not inherit,
#       docs/1012-probe-keying.md §1.4/§1.6).  EVERY TAIL W-APEX row must carry wwva == the storm-s
#       far AND wwft == 0x3 (READ|WRITE) AND wwpatbl == 0 (the entered page is NOT a page-table
#       page).  A row failing ANY of the three is a NULL CONTROL, NOT a "write reaches the apex for
#       the faulting VA" reading: if EVERY tail row fails => APEX_OBSERVED_A_TABLE_PAGE (or
#       APEX_WRONG_VA / APEX_WRONG_FAULT_TYPE): the 1012 cell-s real shape - every row carried
#       pa=0x8421a (PA 0x8421a000), a PAGE-TABLE-PAGE install.  REPORT it; do NOT conclude V1/V2/V3
#       from a table-page row.  V0 short-circuits V1-V3 exactly as the control does.
#   V0-prime  THE WALK GATE (applied BEFORE V1-V3): the tail W-WALK row must carry wkstable == 1
#       (the double-read AGREED).  wkstable == 0 => the L2 word MOVED between the two walks =>
#       WALK_UNSTABLE_NULL, a NULL CONTROL: the location comparison V1/V2/V3 rest on was taken over
#       a table that does not hold still.  V1-V3 withheld; REPORT it (a moving table under a
#       faulting VA is itself a finding).  A MISSING wkstable (pre-double-read capture) does NOT gate.
#   W-SYNC control wrong (wcoow=1 OR wck=0 OR wcapx != 0) => WITNESS_METHOD_BROKEN: the witness
#       method itself is broken on this device (or the managed window is TTBR1 territory, which is
#       the EXPECTED null-control outcome).  Report the measurement defect.  DO NOT CONCLUDE.
# The W-SYNC control is read FIRST and short-circuits V1-V3 into WITNESS_METHOD_BROKEN, exactly as
# the rung requires; the provenance gate V0 then short-circuits V1-V3 into APEX_*_TABLE_PAGE/
# WRONG_VA/WRONG_FAULT_TYPE.  W-WALK also publishes xnu_live_abt_wkapex = "my leaf and the (A)
# walk-s OWN recorded leaf agree" AND the DOUBLE-READ xnu_live_abt_wkleaf2 + xnu_live_abt_wkstable
# (the L2 word read a SECOND time after a dsb): wkstable=1 => the zero is STABLE and no race with a
# concurrent table write can explain it; wkstable=0 => the leaf is a NULL CONTROL (the table moved
# between the reads).  This is the MEASUREMENT that settles 1012-s ptel2=0 HARD anomaly instead of
# an inference.
#
# KEYS (the fixed keyspace, docs/1013-design.md §2): W-APEX wwn/wwl1/wwl2pa/wwleaf/wwapx/
# wwnoproof/wwpa/wwpaok/wwva/wwft/wwpatbl/wwnx; W-WALK wkn/wk/wktb/wkl1/wkl2pa/wkleaf/wkleaf2/
# wkstable/wkapx/wkoow/wkfsr/wkapex/wknx; W-SYNC wcnt/wcva/wck/wcl1/wcl2pa/wcleaf/wcapx/wcoow.
# No two probes share a key.
#

# ABT_PC, ABT_FAR, ABT_SPAN, FREEZE_WITNESS, CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE, DYLD_WITNESS,
# SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM, RESIDENT, USVC and SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP all stay 1); the ENTRY
# BIN moved (ffdc8ba1 -> 124cd528); the PAYLOAD moves (it embeds the entry blob; the 29 s watchdog
# constant is 999-s, unchanged); the TREE does NOT move - 1013 has NO tree edit, NO stage driver and
# NO new --wrap (the change is TWO src/ files: entry_stubs.c the four recorders
# entry_note_abt_wleaf/walk/wsync/cur + g_abtpte_ptel2rec + g_abtpte_curva, entry_trace.c the four
# declarations + the four call sites; it rides 1012-s --wrap=pmap_enter_options and the existing
# --wrap=sleh_abort).
#
# WHY 1013 FOLLOWS 1012.  The 1012 press (arm armed-d13-ffdc8ba1, records/1012-press-read.txt)
# MEASURED the apex BY VALUE: every TAIL row (ordinal >= 0x400) carries xnu_live_abt_pmpprot=0x3
# (READ|WRITE) AND xnu_live_abt_pmppmap & 0xFFFFFF00 (0x81a86000) == xnu_live_abt_pmpttbr &
# 0xFFFFFF00 - so the write ARRIVES at pmap_enter_options and the pmap writes the SAME L1 table the
# MMU walks.  strip-above-the-apex (the last F1a candidate) is REFUTED BY MEASUREMENT.  Yet the
# USER store still permission-faults (fsr=0x80f, FS=15 level-2, WnR=1) ~2.1 M times.  The ONE cell
# nobody has read is the cell the fault is about: THE VALUE OF THE LEAF.  1013 reads it, three
# ways, and changes nothing.
#
# THE 1013 PRESS PRE-REGISTRATION (frozen once embedded; deviations reported, not interpreted):
# THE HEADLINE MUST be decided from the TAIL ROWS-OWN values (ordinal >= 0x400), NEVER on a
# whole-run change count (the 1008/1009 measurement defect, not repeated).  THE DECISION TABLE
# (docs/1013-design.md §3):
#   V1  W-APEX leaf APX=0 (WRITABLE) at W-APEX-s own location AND W-WALK-s wkl2pa == wwl2pa =>
#       LEAF_WRITABLE_STILL_FAULTS: the leaf IS writable in the table the pmap wrote and the MMU
#       walks, yet the store still faults => a STALE TLB / a second table the TLB holds / the
#       flush did not reach this CPU.  Next rung instruments pmap_flush_tlbs + the ASID at the
#       fault.
#   V2  W-APEX leaf APX=1 (READ-ONLY) at W-APEX-s own location AND wkl2pa == wwl2pa =>
#       F1a_CONFIRMED_LEAF_DEFECT: the pmap-s write did NOT stick, or a SECOND writer re-RO-d the
#       leaf.  Next rung instruments the second writer (pmap_page_protect etc.).
#   V3  any readable W-APEX leaf AND wkl2pa != wwl2pa => IDENTITY_FAULT_L2: the apex writes one L2
#       and the MMU walks another.  (1012 measured the L1 bases EQUAL, so the divergence is at the
#       L2 - a pmap_expand hoist / a pm_l1_virt vs pm_l1_phys L2 mismatch.)
#   V4  W-APEX present but wwnoproof=1 (pm_l1_phys != the live TTBR0 base at that row) =>
#       APEX_NOT_PROOF: a by-value CONTRADICTION with 1012; REPORT it, do not conclude from it.
#   V5  W-APEX absent (wwn == 0) yet the storm ran => NO_APEX_WITNESS: the enter never reached the
#       wrapper; fall back to the tree instrument.
#   V6  W-APEX leaf absent/0 while wwl1 is a COARSE descriptor => HARD (stale 0): a present L2 with
#       no leaf is impossible for a correct walk - a MEASUREMENT defect, never a value.
#   V0  THE PROVENANCE GATE (applied BEFORE V1-V3; the 1012 apex defect this rung must not inherit,
#       docs/1012-probe-keying.md §1.4/§1.6).  EVERY TAIL W-APEX row must carry wwva == the storm-s
#       far AND wwft == 0x3 (READ|WRITE) AND wwpatbl == 0 (the entered page is NOT a page-table
#       page).  A row failing ANY of the three is a NULL CONTROL, NOT a "write reaches the apex for
#       the faulting VA" reading: if EVERY tail row fails => APEX_OBSERVED_A_TABLE_PAGE (or
#       APEX_WRONG_VA / APEX_WRONG_FAULT_TYPE): the 1012 cell-s real shape - every row carried
#       pa=0x8421a (PA 0x8421a000), a PAGE-TABLE-PAGE install.  REPORT it; do NOT conclude V1/V2/V3
#       from a table-page row.  V0 short-circuits V1-V3 exactly as the control does.
#   V0-prime  THE WALK GATE (applied BEFORE V1-V3): the tail W-WALK row must carry wkstable == 1
#       (the double-read AGREED).  wkstable == 0 => the L2 word MOVED between the two walks =>
#       WALK_UNSTABLE_NULL, a NULL CONTROL: the location comparison V1/V2/V3 rest on was taken over
#       a table that does not hold still.  V1-V3 withheld; REPORT it (a moving table under a
#       faulting VA is itself a finding).  A MISSING wkstable (pre-double-read capture) does NOT gate.
#   W-SYNC control wrong (wcoow=1 OR wck=0 OR wcapx != 0) => WITNESS_METHOD_BROKEN: the witness
#       method itself is broken on this device (or the managed window is TTBR1 territory, which is
#       the EXPECTED null-control outcome).  Report the measurement defect.  DO NOT CONCLUDE.
# The W-SYNC control is read FIRST and short-circuits V1-V3 into WITNESS_METHOD_BROKEN, exactly as
# the rung requires; the provenance gate V0 then short-circuits V1-V3 into APEX_*_TABLE_PAGE/
# WRONG_VA/WRONG_FAULT_TYPE.  W-WALK also publishes xnu_live_abt_wkapex = "my leaf and the (A)
# walk-s OWN recorded leaf agree" AND the DOUBLE-READ xnu_live_abt_wkleaf2 + xnu_live_abt_wkstable
# (the L2 word read a SECOND time after a dsb): wkstable=1 => the zero is STABLE and no race with a
# concurrent table write can explain it; wkstable=0 => the leaf is a NULL CONTROL (the table moved
# between the reads).  This is the MEASUREMENT that settles 1012-s ptel2=0 HARD anomaly instead of
# an inference.
#
# KEYS (the fixed keyspace, docs/1013-design.md §2): W-APEX wwn/wwl1/wwl2pa/wwleaf/wwapx/
# wwnoproof/wwpa/wwpaok/wwva/wwft/wwpatbl/wwnx; W-WALK wkn/wk/wktb/wkl1/wkl2pa/wkleaf/wkleaf2/
# wkstable/wkapx/wkoow/wkfsr/wkapex/wknx; W-SYNC wcnt/wcva/wck/wctb/wcl1/wcl2pa/wcleaf/wcapx/
# wcoow + the raw TTBR words wctb0/wctb1.
# No two probes share a key.
#

# 1013 keys; the four recorders DEFINED T/t with exactly ONE call site each; the W-APEX call inside

# was JUDGED a MEASUREMENT DEFECT: its W-SYNC control reads wcva=0x80080000, ABOVE the TTBR0/TTBR1
# split 0x40000000 for TTBCR.N=2, so wck=0 (a TTBR1 walk) and the rung-s OWN control WITHHELD V1-V3;
# its W-APEX rows read a REAL writable leaf (wwleaf=0x841e61bb, wwapx=0) but their own provenance
# cell says wwnoproof=1 (pm_l1_phys != the live TTBR0 base), so the cell is not provably the
# fault-s; and W-WALK read the SAME L2 table yet published wkleaf=0 AND NO VA, so no (VA, L1, L2)
# pair could be formed.  What 1013 DID establish BY VALUE: the leaf the pmap writes carries APX=0
# (user-WRITABLE) in a table whose L1 base equals the live TTBR0 base, AND the store still faults
# (fsr=0x80f, FS=15 level-2, WnR=1) ~2.1 M times.  A WRITABLE LEAF THAT STILL FAULTS means the
# MMU is not reading that leaf - so the ONE unread link in the chain is the INVALIDATION: whether
# pmap_flush_tlbs RAN at all, on WHICH cpu, and for WHICH ASID.  That is this rung.
#
# WHAT 1014 (V1) MEASURES.  `pmap_flush_tlbs` (osfmk/arm/pmap.c:1274-1328) takes the GATE at
# :1298 `flush_self = (ttb == ttbr_pmap || pmap_is_shared)`.  If the gate is FALSE, NO ARM flush
# instruction executes and the stale translation SURVIVES the pmap-s own write - the leaf in
# MEMORY is writable while the TLB still holds the old read-only entry, which is EXACTLY the
# shape 1013 measured.  The probe records, per call: the VA (startv), pmap->pm_l1_phys, the
# IN-LOOP TTBR0 read & 0xFFFFFF00 (the value :1298 actually compares), flush_self,
# pmap_is_shared, pmap_asid_ncpus (a RUNTIME value - project records that say 0 are WRONG; it is
# 1 here), pmap->pm_asid & 0xFF, and the FLUSH KIND: 0 = no flush, 1 = full flushID,
# 2 = ASID-scoped flushID.  A `seen` null-control cell covers the shape where :1295 never ran, so
# a `self=0` row cannot be misread as a DECISION.  In parallel __wrap_sleh_abort records
# CONTEXTIDR & 0xFF - the ASID the HARDWARE tags this fault-s translation with - so "the flush
# was for ASID A while the CPU ran under ASID B" is visible rather than assumed; _wfasid alone
# cannot answer that.
#
# THE 1014 (V1) VERDICT CELLS (docs/1014-design.md §2.5, read from the TAIL ROWS-OWN values -
# any _wfn >= 0x400 - NEVER a whole-run max(); the 1008/1009 measurement defect is not repeated).
# The W-SYNC control (1013) must still be sound, else WITNESS_METHOD_BROKEN and the cells are
# WITHHELD:
#   F1  _wfself = 0 at EVERY tail row for this VA => FLUSH_REFUSED_TTB_MISMATCH - H-FF CONFIRMED.
#       The test at pmap.c:1298-1299 was FALSE: pmap->pm_l1_phys != (armreg_ttbr_read() &
#       0xFFFFFF00) AT FLUSH TIME and the pmap is not shared, so NO FLUSH RAN AT ALL.  This is
#       the surviving V1 mechanism, and it agrees with 1013-s wwl1=0x81bb1000 != the storm-s
#       TTBR0 base 0x81a86000.  _wfkind = 0 is the same row read another way.
#   F2  _wfself = 1 AND _wfttb == _wflive (the bases agree at flush time) and the fault persists
#       => FLUSH_RAN_STILL_FAULTS: the enter-s flush was NOT refused; combined with 1013-s
#       writable leaf this REFUTES H-FF and forces the "the table read is not the table walked"
#       branch.  NOTE: with arm_context_switch-s full TLBIALL on every TTBR0 change and pm_asid
#       single-written, an ASID-scoped mismatch cannot be the cause - this cell must NOT be read
#       as one.
#   F3  _wfself = 1 AND _wfkind = 2 and the fault persists => ASID_PATH_RAN_STILL_FAULTS: the
#       ASID-scoped invalidate ran and the store still permission-faults => NOT ASID staleness.
#       Remaining V1-adjacent suspects, NAMED NOT GUESSED: the TLB-s own view (a section mapping
#       at this VA, a TTBR1 walk) or the DACR/DOMAIN - the L1 domain field built at pmap.c:3163
#       is 0 and src/mmu.c:5526 sets DACR to 0x00000003 (domain 0 = manager, which bypasses AP
#       checks), so a domain that is not manager on the faulting CPU produces FS=15 with no leaf
#       defect at all.
#   F4  _wfself = 1 AND _wfkind = 1 (the FULL arm_tlb_flushID) and the fault persists =>
#       FULL_FLUSH_STILL_FAULTS: the whole TLB was invalidated for this CPU and the store still
#       faults => staleness is DEAD; the entry is rebuilt from the TABLE, so the table the MMU
#       walks is not the table 1013 read.  CROSS-CHECK against 1013-s V3 cell (wwl2pa vs wkl2pa):
#       if they were EQUAL this is a HARD CONTRADICTION and the next rung must re-open the walk.
#   F5  _wfn = 0 at the tail while the storm ran => NO_FLUSH_WITNESS: the flush recorder never
#       fired on the storm VA (a provenance/keying failure - the flush runs outside the handler-s
#       g_abtpte_curva window) => REBUILD, DO NOT CONCLUDE.
#   F6  _wfncpus differs from the boot-s own "All ASID/asids enabled" line => HARD (stale
#       decode): the published runtime value disagrees with the boot-s own print.
#   (HARD) any _wfkind/_wfasid that does NOT match the disassembled branch taken - the same
#       stale-decode class.
#   (NULL CONTROL) _wfseen = 0 on a row means the cpu loop-s :1295 read never executed, so that
#       row-s _wflive is not a reading and its _wfself = 0 is NOT a DECISION - such a row must
#       NEVER be counted toward F1.
# The filter is the rung-s provenance statement: pmap_flush_tlbs runs for other VAs constantly
# (pmap_init alone calls it with endv = 0xFFFFFFFF), so without keying on 1013-s
# g_abtpte_curva the 24576-entry channel would be spent before the storm (the 998 cap, the 1007
# ladder lesson, [[mi4-measurement-defects]]).
#
# KEYS (the fixed keyspace, docs/1014-design.md §2.2): the flush witness wfn/wfva/wfttb/wflive/
# wfself/wfshared/wfncpus/wfasid/wfkind/wfseen/wfnx; the CONTEXTIDR witness wctxn/wctx/wctxva.
# wflive is published RAW (pmap.c:1298 masks by 0xFFFFFF00 only) - masking it to the 4 KB
# entry_ttbr_base would manufacture agreement at the F1/F2 cell ([[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]]).
# No two probes share a key (the §2.2 collision proof: every one of the 14 greps to 0 tree-wide
# before it was added; xnu_live_abt_wfmap was DROPPED from the design table this run - it has no
# source - and replaced by xnu_live_abt_wfseen, the null-control cell).
#
# THE PROBE IS A SOURCE EDIT, NOT A --wrap (docs/1014-design.md §2.3, measured):
# `pmap_flush_tlbs` has 13 R_ARM_CALL relocations and ALL 13 are INTRA-OBJECT (11 caller
# functions inside arm/pmap.c); `grep -rln pmap_flush_tlbs` matches arm/pmap.c ONLY.  A
# --wrap=pmap_flush_tlbs would therefore redirect ZERO call sites and report a green build while
# measuring NOTHING ([[mi4-a-claim-in-a-comment-is-not-a-check]]).  The probe is gated by
# `#if defined(STAGE90_XNU_FLUSH_WITNESS) && STAGE90_XNU_FLUSH_WITNESS`, so with the switch OFF
# the tree-s pmap.c compiles to byte-identical .text (proven in build_1014_v1.sh by rebuilding
# patched-OFF against reverted-OFF with the SAME command line - the whole object is identical
# after normalising the `pmap.c:NNNN` __LINE__ strings in asserts; the 42-line gate shifts every
# assert message below it EVEN WITH THE GATE CLOSED, so a raw cmp can never succeed and the
# normalisation is stated rather than hidden).
#
# THE ONE PLACE THE DESIGN COULD NOT BE FOLLOWED EXACTLY (stated, not papered over): §2.1(a1)
# places the recorder call at the function-s single exit and passes Apple-s `ttbr_pmap`.  That
# identifier is declared INSIDE the cpu loop-s body (:1295), so the single-exit call did not
# compile (`use of undeclared identifier ttbr_pmap`).  The fix is a gated function-scope
# `static uint32_t wf_live;` carrying the in-loop `armreg_ttbr_read() & 0xFFFFFF00` (reset to 0
# per call, and a `seen` flag set at the same statement).  Apple-s own declarator is left
# BYTE-IDENTICAL in both the #if and the #else arm, so the OFF path is unchanged.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE (build_1014_v1.sh + this park): the image carries 100 xnu_live_abt_ key
# literals (49 through 1012 + 1013-s 37 + 1014-s 14) and all 14 1014 keys; entry_note_abt_wf and
# entry_note_abt_wctx are DEFINED T/t with exactly ONE `(b|bl)` call site each (the (b|bl) rule -
# the compiler TAILS a void call that ends its function); the CONTEXTIDR call lives inside
# __wrap_sleh_abort, which still calls <sleh_abort> (pass-through) AND <entry_note_abt_cur> (the
# fault-VA latch the recorder keys on); the pool-s osfmk_arm_pmap.o carries `U entry_note_abt_wf`
# with exactly ONE R_ARM_CALL relocation and ZERO wf literals (the pmap.c source edit DID compile
# into the kernel pool - the 1012 pool-define hazard); with the FROZEN 1013 elf
# (armed-d13-9cf2f15e) as a REQUIRED NEGATIVE CONTROL (xnu_live_abt_ x82, the 1013 symbols x4,
# but the 1014 symbols x0 and the 1014 literals x0 - the 1014 change is NOT in the 1013 arm, so
# the reader CAN fail); the 1013 witness, the 1012 apex, the 1011 (E-prime)/(A) witness, the
# 1010/1009/1008/1007 witnesses, the 1006 freeze witness, the 1005 cadence witness, the 1004
# abort trace (xnu_live_sleh_upc x1), the 1003 stall instrument and the 1002 six-word save set
# asserted present (regressions).  The 996-1013 checkers rerun ON the 1014 image - the probe
# checker-s ONE by-design frozen 20 B clause is the only allowed FAIL.
#
# Medium: 968 real iOS 7.1.2 HFSX rootfs over hfs_rmd0; CARD_COW=1, HDD_WRITE=0, base never
# written - fully reversible. fastboot boot only, NEVER flash.
# =================================================================================================

# armed-d13-e51d14fa  -  1015: THE PERMISSION-INPUTS WITNESS + THE AT/PAR HARDWARE CELL - what does the MMU
# ITSELF say about the storm VA, and are the permission inputs the ones the walk read? (design
# docs/1015-design.md)
# Switch set is 1014-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_PERM_WITNESS=1 (PTE_WITNESS, PMP_ENTER, VME_PROT,
# ABT_PTE, ABT_PC, ABT_FAR, ABT_SPAN, FREEZE_WITNESS, CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE, DYLD_WITNESS,
# SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM, RESIDENT, USVC, SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP and FLUSH_WITNESS all stay
# 1); the ENTRY BIN moves (29ec9e48 -> e51d14fa); the PAYLOAD moves (it embeds the entry blob; the 29 s
# watchdog constant is 999-s, unchanged); the TREE DOES NOT MOVE - 1015 is ENTRY-ONLY, it adds NO
# tree edit and NO new --wrap (the kernel pool out/xnu_kernel_obj_d13/osfmk_arm_pmap.o is 1014-s,
# byte for byte: 1014-s pmap.c flush probe stays staged, STAGE90_XNU_FLUSH_WITNESS stays 1, and
# 1015 adds no second pmap.c probe).
#
# WHY 1015 FOLLOWS 1014.  The 1014 press (arm armed-d13-29ec9e48, records/1014-press-read.txt)
# MEASURED two cells.  F2 (docs/1014-design.md §2.5): on every tail row wfkind=0x02
# (arm_tlb_flushID_ASID), wfself=1 (the pmap.c:1298 gate was TRUE), wfttb == wflive ==
# 0x81a86000 (the pmap-s own L1 table IS the live TTBR0 table at flush time), wfasid=2 == wctx=2
# (the flush ran under the faulting ASID), wfncpus=1 - so 1013c-s H-FF hypothesis ("the flush
# never ran because pm_l1_phys != TTBR0") is REFUTED BY VALUE.  V1: three probes read the SAME
# cell (VA 0x000e6000, L1 0x81bb2001, L2 table 0x81bb2000) and all three read the SAME word
# 0x841e91bb = PRESENT small page, ap=0b11, apx=0 (USER-WRITABLE), PA 0x841e9000 - YET the CPU
# still takes FS=15 permission faults on it ~2.6e5 times at a constant far=0xe6000/pc=0x2bed61a0.
# A WRITABLE LEAF PLUS A FLUSH THAT RAN AND STILL FAULTS means the CPU-s translation is not the
# leaf the walk reads.  BUT: the earlier reading "F1 (stale TLB) is dead" was CORRECTED - F2
# proves a flush RAN, NOT that a GLOBAL entry was INVALIDATED.  This port installs EVERY leaf
# global (bit11=0; L2_NG_BIT is never ORed), so a TLBIASID cannot evict them and H-G
# STALE_GLOBAL_TLB is NARROWED, NOT eliminated.  That narrowed question - does the CPU-s own
# translation of 0xe6000 differ from the walked leaf - is this rung.
#
# WHAT 1015 MEASURES.  Two passes, both read in the abort context (__wrap_sleh_abort,
# src/entry/entry_trace.c, BEFORE the handler) so the values describe the fault AS TAKEN.
#   (1) THE AT/PAR HARDWARE CELL - the deciding pass.  The recorder issues the tree-s OWN idiom
#       (pmap_extract, pmap.c:2930): `mcr p15,0,cura,c7,c8,3` (armreg_va2pa_uw_ns_write = AT,
#       stage-1, USER WRITE) on the storm VA, ISBs (`"xisb sy"`, the sequence the AT/PAR pair
#       requires), then `mrc p15,0,Rt,c7,c4,0` (armreg_par_read).  `par & 1 == 1` is a FAULT;
#       `par & 0xfffff000` is the PA the MMU itself uses.  Published RAW as _wdatpar.  The
#       PRIVILEGED cross-check repeats it with `c7,c8,0` (va2pa_pr_ns) on the STORM VA and
#       publishes it as _wdatparpr: it is the only thing that separates "the entry is user-denied" from "the
#       entry is not there".  The AT is the STRONGEST instrument here: every other witness asks
#       the PAGE TABLES what should happen; AT asks the MMU what DOES happen - the same
#       translation path the faulting store used, in the same thread context, so a stale entry
#       that shadows the leaf shadows AT too.
#   (2) THE PERMISSION-INPUTS LADDER - the residual/null pass.  Read at the SAME abort, from NO
#       NEW WALKER (the L1 and the leaf come from the ONE routine stage90_read_l2_pte): _wddom
#       (the L1 descriptor-s domain field, bits[8:5]), _wddacr (DACR raw, `mrc p15,0,Rt,c3,c0,0`),
#       _wdttbcr (TTBCR raw, `c2,c0,2`) + _wdsplit (1 << (32-(ttbcr&7))), _wdttbr0/_wdttbr1
#       (live raw), _wdl1 and _wdleaf (ONE read; every decode below comes from that local),
#       _wdap (leaf>>4 & 3), _wdapx (leaf>>9 & 1), _wdtex (leaf>>6 & 7), _wdcb (leaf>>2 & 3),
#       _wdsmall (leaf>>1 & 1), _wdempty (the walk-s present-test), _wdpcpu (TPIDRPRW),
#       _wdthrmap (the aborting thread-s own pmap L1 base, the 1011 chain) + _wdmapok (1 iff
#       every deref landed in [0x80000000,0xFFFEFFFF] - the lineage-s own null control), and
#       _wdsctlr (SCTLR raw AT THE ABORT - perm-static-s ranked cause #2).
#   (3) THE NULL CONTROLS.  On each row the recorder issues the SAME AT pair against the W-SYNC
#       control VA (entry_stubs.c:3153; 1014 already read its leaf as present at PA 0x80080000,
#       _wcleaf=0x8008021a) and publishes its PRIVILEGED par ON ITS OWN KEY, _wdctlat - NOT on
#       _wdatparpr, which reads the STORM VA (a DIFFERENT address must never share a key:
#       [[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]]; the first design draft made exactly that collision and
#       the lead-s 2026-10-15 ruling split it).  _wdctlok = 1 iff that control read was taken;
#       _wdseen = 1 iff the cells were actually produced; _wdatok = 1 iff the three AT/PAR pairs
#       executed AND the control passed.  A missing or mis-executed read can NEVER impersonate a
#       confirmation.
#
# THE 1015 VERDICT CELLS (docs/1015-design.md §3a - this table was §3c before the ENTRY-ONLY
# renumber; tools/check_1015_capture.py and docs/1015-harness.md still cite it as §3c - SAME
# table, old number).  Read on the TAIL ROWS-OWN values (_wdn >= 0x400, _wdva == 0xe6000,
# _wdseen=1, _wdatok=1), NEVER on a whole-run aggregate (the 1008/1009 measurement defect, not
# repeated).  The 1014 tail is NOT uniform - the last two rows are DIFFERENT faults inside a
# different dyld (far~0x3a0xxxxx), so the filter is BOTH the ordinal AND far == 0xe6000:
#   V-AT0  the control read (_wdctlat) did not come back `par & 1 == 0` with
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) == 0x80080000`, or _wdctlat is unpublished, or _wdatok=0
#          => AT_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN: WITHHOLD V-AT1..4.  (SILENCE_IS_A_READING: the AT-s
#          absence is a reading only because the control proves success is silent-but-readable.)
#   V-AT1  _wdatpar FAULTS (`par & 1 == 1`) while _wdatparpr SUCCEEDS (`par & 1 == 0`)
#          => H-G CONFIRMED AT THE HARDWARE - the translation is NOT the user leaf.  The MMU
#          will not translate 0xe6000 for a user write even though the walked leaf is
#          ap=0b11/apx=0/nG=0/domain=0; the privileged view succeeds, so this is a user-AP
#          decision made from a translation that is not the leaf the walk reads => a stale/other
#          entry.  With _leafng == 0 the culprit is a GLOBAL entry surviving TLBIASID.
#   V-AT2  _wdatpar SUCCEEDS to the leaf-s OWN PA (`par & 1 == 0` and
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) == 0x841e9000`) => TRANSLATION_IS_CORRECT_YET_THE_STORE_FAULTED:
#          H-G REFUTED - the store-s FS=15 is NOT produced by this translation, so the probe-s
#          key/ordering (g_abtpte_curva) or the DFSR/DFAR pair describes a DIFFERENT access.
#          NOT a page-table defect - hand back to the observer (§3b-s P-X1 -> H-X, SCTLR/PRRR).
#   V-AT3  _wdatpar SUCCEEDS to a DIFFERENT PA (`par & 1 == 0` and
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) != 0x841e9000`) => WRONG_TRANSLATION_IN_THE_TLB: a TLB entry is
#          serving a translation the tables no longer hold.  Same conclusion as V-AT1, reached
#          from the PA side, and it NAMES the stale PA by value.
#   V-AT4  BOTH views fault (`par & 1 == 1` on both) => the entry is not merely user-denied; a
#          domain/invalid mechanism is in play.  Re-rank toward perm-static cause #2 (SCTLR/PRRR)
#          before §7.
# THE PASSIVE LADDER (§3b) rides the SAME rows and is WITHHELD unless _wdctlok=1, _wdseen=1 and
# (for the lineage cells) _wdmapok=1: P-CTL (_wdctlok=0 or _wdseen=0) => NO_PERM_WITNESS, no
# verdict; P-AT (_wdatok=0) => NO_AT (the deciding table is unavailable, regardless of
# everything below); P-D1 _wddom != 0 => L1_DOMAIN_NONZERO; P-D2 _wddom==0 and (_wddacr & 3) != 1
# => DACR_NOT_CLIENT (H-P CONFIRMED, the only DACR writer is src/mmu.c:4921); P-D3 _wddom==0 and
# (_wddacr & 3) == 1 => DACR_CLIENT (H-P-s domain form KILLED); P-T1 (_wdttbcr & 7) != 2 =>
# TTBCR_NOT_N2 (every entry_ttbr_base derivation must be re-read); P-T2 (_wdttbcr&7)==2 and
# _wdva >= _wdsplit => ROUTED_TO_TTBR1; P-T3 the masked _wdttbr0 != 0x81a86000 => TTBR0_MOVED_
# AT_ABORT; P-M1 _wdmapok=1 and _wdthrmap != _wdttbr0 => THREAD_PMAP_NE_TTBR0; P-L1 _wdsmall=1
# and (_wdapx!=0 or _wdap!=0b11) => LEAF_NOT_USER_WRITABLE (contradicts 1014-s stable
# double-read); P-L3 _wdsmall=0 => NOT_A_SMALL_PAGE; P-S1 (_wdsctlr bits TRE(28)/AFE(1)/M(0))
# differs from the console-install reading => SCTLR_MOVED (H-X is live); P-X1 all of
# P-D3/P-T1..P-T3/P-M1/P-L1/P-L3/P-S1 killed AND V-AT2 => INPUTS_ALL_CORRECT_STILL_FAULTS (the
# next rung is the observer, not the pmap).
# A NOTE ON _leafng: `_leafng == 0` (GLOBAL) is NOT by itself a verdict - it is the PRECONDITION
# of H-G, published RAW so the reader sees it without decoding the packed leaf.  `_leafng == 1`
# (non-global) would KILL H-G by value before any press: if the leaf were ASID-tagged, TLBIASID
# WOULD evict its stale entry.  The checker asserts _leafng == 0 at the storm as H-G-s
# precondition (the 1014 leaf-s bit11 is 0).
# The filter is the rung-s provenance statement: the recorder keys on 1013-s g_abtpte_curva
# (_wdva) AND 1014-s storm identity, because the 24576-entry channel would otherwise be spent
# before the storm (the 998 cap, the 1007 ladder lesson, [[mi4-measurement-defects]]).
#
# KEYS (the fixed keyspace, docs/1015-design.md §2a): the 27 permission-INPUTS/AT-PAR cells
# wdn/wdva/wddacr/wddom/wdttbcr/wdsplit/wdttbr0/wdttbr1/wdl1/wdleaf/wdap/wdapx/wdtex/wdcb/
# wdsmall/wdpcpu/wdthrmap/wdmapok/wdseen/wdctl/wdctlok/wdempty/wdatok/wdatpar/wdatparpr/
# wdctlat/wdsctlr; the H-G precondition cell xnu_live_abt_leafng; and the THREE OWED-1014-FIX
# keys xnu_live_abt_wwpre/wwpost/wwmoved (published from entry_note_abt_wleaf so that 1013-s
