# armed-d13-16fe8885  -  1015b: THE GLOBAL-FIX RUNG - the storm-s own flush widened to a FULL TLBIALL, and the
# behaviour read-out that decides H-G (design docs/1015b-design.md; the cell is pre-registered in
# tools/check_1015b_capture.py).
# Switch set is 1015-s VERBATIM plus STAGE90_XNU_GLOBAL_FIX=1 (PTE_WITNESS, PMP_ENTER, VME_PROT,
# ABT_PTE, ABT_PC, ABT_FAR, ABT_SPAN, FREEZE_WITNESS, CADENCE, STALL, ABORT_TRACE, DYLD_WITNESS,
# SHREG_PROBE, SHREG_WIRE, SHREG_GEOM, RESIDENT, USVC, SUBMAP_PMAP_SKIP, FLUSH_WITNESS and 1015-s
# own PERM_WITNESS all stay 1); the ENTRY BIN moves (e51d14fa -> 16fe8885); the PAYLOAD moves (it embeds
# the entry blob; the 29 s watchdog constant is 999-s, unchanged).
# **THE TREE MOVES, AND THE KERNEL MOVES WITH IT - THAT IS THE RUNG.** Where 1015 was ENTRY-ONLY,
# 1015b stages ONE SOURCE EDIT: tools/stage_d13_globalfix.sh inserts, at
# external/xnu-hd2-darwin13/xnu/osfmk/arm/pmap.c:1346-1349, a third arm between Apple-s
# `arm_tlb_flushID();` (:1347) and Apple-s `else` (:1348):
#       #if defined(STAGE90_XNU_GLOBAL_FIX) && STAGE90_XNU_GLOBAL_FIX
#                   else if (pmap != kernel_pmap)
#                       arm_tlb_flushID();
#       #endif
# so every NON-KERNEL pmap-s steady-state flush is a FULL TLBIALL instead of the ASID-scoped
# TLBIASID.  `pmap_is_shared` is `pmap->pm_shared || (pmap == kernel_pmap)` (pmap.c:1291), so the
# added condition is FALSE for the kernel and the KERNEL-S SEMANTICS ARE UNCHANGED; OFF removes the
# three lines entirely (the #if wraps them), which is what makes the build-s OFF proof a
# byte-identical .text comparison rather than a promise.
# THE POOL OBJECT MOVES: out/xnu_kernel_obj_d13/osfmk_arm_pmap.o now materializes `kernel_pmap`
# THREE times inside pmap_flush_tlbs - where 1015-s object has TWO (Apple-s :1291 pmap_is_shared
# init + the :1382 terminal panic; the inserted non-kernel test is the third, at the offset just
# before the full arm-s `bl`). The arm_tlb_flushID / arm_tlb_flushID_ASID CALL counts are x1/x1 in
# BOTH objects (codegen: the two identical full-flush sites tail-merge; the ASID arm stays as
# unreachable text), so they are reported, not asserted. The 1014 flush probe-s ONE entry_note_abt_wf relocation is
# UNDISTURBED (1015b inserts BETWEEN Apple-s two lines).
# AND THE DECLARATION: STAGE90_XNU_GLOBAL_FIX is a POOL switch that no writer in src/entry/
# echoes (MEASURED x0 in build_entry.sh AND in preflight_boot_check.sh-s ENTRY_CFG_KEYS, whose
# converse check is a SET DIFFERENCE), so the record CANNOT carry it and park_1015b.sh appends it
# to out/stage90/xnu_arm_entry-arm-extra.txt (frozen beside this file as
# xnu_arm_entry-arm-extra.txt). A reader that wants to know what this arm-s kernel does must read
# that line; the config record alone describes 1015-s kernel.
#
# WHY 1015b FOLLOWS 1015.  The 1015 press (arm armed-d13-e51d14fa, records/1015-press-read.txt,
# RESIDENT, wdt_pets=0x61) read V-AT1 AT THE HARDWARE: _wdatpar FAULTS (par & 1 == 1) while its
# null control _wdatparpr SUCCEEDS (par & 1 == 0) to PA 0x8419d000, on a leaf read as
# _wdleaf=0x8417e1bb (AP=0b11, APX=0, PA 0x8417e000) with _wddom=0, _wddacr=1, _wdttbcr=2 and
# _leafng=0 (GLOBAL).  The MMU-s translation for a USER WRITE is therefore NOT the leaf the walk
# reads. With every user leaf GLOBAL (L2_NG_BIT 0x800, pmap.h:231, is never ORed tree-wide) and
# TLBIASID unable to evict a GLOBAL entry, a STALE GLOBAL entry is the standing explanation - H-G.
# 1015b is its BEHAVIOURAL half: if H-G is the cause, giving the storm-s own pmap a full TLBIALL
# stops the storm. The secondary observation that 1015b-s fix also gives the arm a NEW code path
# is why the reader has an ATTRIBUTION GUARD (see the cells below).
#
# WHY 1015 FOLLOWS 1014.  The 1014 press (arm armed-d13-29ec9e48, records/1014-press-read.txt)
# MEASURED two cells.  F2 (docs/1014-design.md §2.5): on every tail row wfkind=0x02
# (arm_tlb_flushID_ASID), wfself=1 (the pmap.c:1298 gate was TRUE), wfttb == wflive ==
# 0x81a86000 (the pmap-s own L1 table IS the live TTBR0 table at flush time), wfasid=2 == wctx=2
# (the flush ran under the faulting ASID), wfncpus=1 - so 1013c-s H-FF hypothesis ("the flush
# never ran because pm_l1_phys != TTBR0") is REFUTED BY VALUE.  V1: three probes read the SAME
# cell (VA 0x000e6000, L1 0x81bb2001, L2 table 0x81bb2000) and all three read the SAME word
# 0x841e91bb = PRESENT small page, ap=0b11, apx=0 (USER-WRITABLE), PA 0x841e9000 - YET the CPU
# still takes FS=15 permission faults on it ~2.6e5 times at a constant far=0xe6000/pc=0x2bed61a0.
# A WRITABLE LEAF PLUS A FLUSH THAT RAN AND STILL FAULTS means the CPU-s translation is not the
# leaf the walk reads.  BUT: the earlier reading "F1 (stale TLB) is dead" was CORRECTED - F2
# proves a flush RAN, NOT that a GLOBAL entry was INVALIDATED.  This port installs EVERY leaf
# global (bit11=0; L2_NG_BIT is never ORed), so a TLBIASID cannot evict them and H-G
# STALE_GLOBAL_TLB is NARROWED, NOT eliminated.  That narrowed question - does the CPU-s own
# translation of 0xe6000 differ from the walked leaf - is this rung.
#
# WHAT 1015 MEASURES.  Two passes, both read in the abort context (__wrap_sleh_abort,
# src/entry/entry_trace.c, BEFORE the handler) so the values describe the fault AS TAKEN.
#   (1) THE AT/PAR HARDWARE CELL - the deciding pass.  The recorder issues the tree-s OWN idiom
#       (pmap_extract, pmap.c:2930): `mcr p15,0,cura,c7,c8,3` (armreg_va2pa_uw_ns_write = AT,
#       stage-1, USER WRITE) on the storm VA, ISBs (`"xisb sy"`, the sequence the AT/PAR pair
#       requires), then `mrc p15,0,Rt,c7,c4,0` (armreg_par_read).  `par & 1 == 1` is a FAULT;
#       `par & 0xfffff000` is the PA the MMU itself uses.  Published RAW as _wdatpar.  The
#       PRIVILEGED cross-check repeats it with `c7,c8,0` (va2pa_pr_ns) on the STORM VA and
#       publishes it as _wdatparpr: it is the only thing that separates "the entry is user-denied" from "the
#       entry is not there".  The AT is the STRONGEST instrument here: every other witness asks
#       the PAGE TABLES what should happen; AT asks the MMU what DOES happen - the same
#       translation path the faulting store used, in the same thread context, so a stale entry
#       that shadows the leaf shadows AT too.
#   (2) THE PERMISSION-INPUTS LADDER - the residual/null pass.  Read at the SAME abort, from NO
#       NEW WALKER (the L1 and the leaf come from the ONE routine stage90_read_l2_pte): _wddom
#       (the L1 descriptor-s domain field, bits[8:5]), _wddacr (DACR raw, `mrc p15,0,Rt,c3,c0,0`),
#       _wdttbcr (TTBCR raw, `c2,c0,2`) + _wdsplit (1 << (32-(ttbcr&7))), _wdttbr0/_wdttbr1
#       (live raw), _wdl1 and _wdleaf (ONE read; every decode below comes from that local),
#       _wdap (leaf>>4 & 3), _wdapx (leaf>>9 & 1), _wdtex (leaf>>6 & 7), _wdcb (leaf>>2 & 3),
#       _wdsmall (leaf>>1 & 1), _wdempty (the walk-s present-test), _wdpcpu (TPIDRPRW),
#       _wdthrmap (the aborting thread-s own pmap L1 base, the 1011 chain) + _wdmapok (1 iff
#       every deref landed in [0x80000000,0xFFFEFFFF] - the lineage-s own null control), and
#       _wdsctlr (SCTLR raw AT THE ABORT - perm-static-s ranked cause #2).
#   (3) THE NULL CONTROLS.  On each row the recorder issues the SAME AT pair against the W-SYNC
#       control VA (entry_stubs.c:3153; 1014 already read its leaf as present at PA 0x80080000,
#       _wcleaf=0x8008021a) and publishes its PRIVILEGED par ON ITS OWN KEY, _wdctlat - NOT on
#       _wdatparpr, which reads the STORM VA (a DIFFERENT address must never share a key:
#       [[mi4-one-value-two-definitions]]; the first design draft made exactly that collision and
#       the lead-s 2026-10-15 ruling split it).  _wdctlok = 1 iff that control read was taken;
#       _wdseen = 1 iff the cells were actually produced; _wdatok = 1 iff the three AT/PAR pairs
#       executed AND the control passed.  A missing or mis-executed read can NEVER impersonate a
#       confirmation.
#
# =================================================================================================
# THE 1015b DECISIVE CELL - PRE-REGISTERED BEFORE THE PRESS (design docs/1015b-design.md §5;
# adjudicated by tools/check_1015b_capture.py, whose verdict strings are quoted here VERBATIM so
# the cell cannot be re-worded after the run).  **THIS IS THE CELL THE RUNG EXISTS FOR.**
# THE QUESTION: H-G says the storm is a STALE GLOBAL TLB ENTRY that TLBIASID could not evict. If
# so, taking the FULL arm_tlb_flushID() (TLBIALL) for this pmap EVICTS it and the storm STOPS.
#   * G-CONFIRMED  -  the storm STOPS: H-G CONFIRMED IN BEHAVIOUR.  Read BY VALUE: the reader
#     RECOVERS the storm VA from the capture rather than matching a literal, because the storm-s
#     `far` moves per run (1014 read 0xe6000, 1015 read 0x27000, 1011 read 0x61000); no literal
#     identifies it.  A stop REQUIRES the storm rows to be ABSENT and the capture to be
#     STRUCTURALLY COMPLETE - the truncation guard runs FIRST, because a truncated log is exactly
#     what a stopped storm looks like in bytes (and because /proc/last_kmsg is what the carrier
#     gives back; a missing tail is not a quiet run).
#   * G-REFUTED   -  the storm PERSISTS: H-G REFUTED IN BEHAVIOUR.  This is a POSITIVE
#     measurement: the reader must point at a storm ROW, never at an absence.  What follows is not
#     1015b-s fix tried harder but 1015-s §3b ladder (P-X1: inputs all correct and it still
#     faults) and then H-X - the CPU-s own state (SCTLR/PRRR via _wdsctlr), not another table
#     read.  A refutation here is INFORMATIVE, not a null result.
#   * G-WITHHOLD   -  the reader NAMES the exact missing or contradictory key.  NEVER a negative:
#     the cell is withheld when the capture cannot decide it.  A reader that cannot withhold
#     certifies nothing ([[mi4-silence-is-a-reading-only-if-success-is-silent]]).
# THE STOP DEFINITION IS PRE-REGISTERED AND IS NOT "FEWER ROWS".  A storm row is a tail abort row
# whose VA equals the BY-VALUE RECOVERED storm VA; the storm is STOPPED iff fewer than three such
# rows exist AND none of them is at `_pcn >= 0x4000` (the 1014/1015 storm-s own band - it ran to
# `_pcn=0x40000`).  Three rows at low ordinal is NOT a stop: it is a storm the ladder caught
# early, which is why the band condition carries half the definition.
# THE ATTRIBUTION GUARD - READ THIS BEFORE BELIEVING A G-CONFIRMED.  1015b CHANGES KERNEL
# BEHAVIOUR, so a stopped storm is only evidence about THIS arm if the WIDENED arm is the one the
# faulting pmap took. The reader therefore requires a `_wfkind=1` row (1014-s W-FLUSH publishes
# `_wfkind`: Apple-s arm is 0, Apple-s ASID arm is 2, and the widened arm is 1) whose `_wfva` or
# `_pcfar` EQUALS the recovered storm VA. Without such a row the verdict text says the stop is
# UNATTRIBUTED rather than implying the fix caused it - because a widened arm that the storm-s
# pmap never reached cannot have stopped anything, and the remaining explanations (a different
# dyld, a shorter run, a different fault) would all produce the same absent rows.
# THE SECOND CELL, re-run over the SAME capture: 1015-s AT/PAR table (V-AT1..4, the block below)
# and its passive ladder.  The reader re-runs them so that a G-CONFIRMED can be read AGAINST the
# hardware cell rather than in isolation: V-AT1 (the CPU-s translation is not the walked leaf)
# PLUS a stopped storm is the strongest pair this rung can produce, and the reader prints both.
# WHAT WOULD FALSIFY 1015b-S READING ENTIRELY: a G-CONFIRMED with NO `_wfkind=1` row on the storm
# VA (the attribution guard), or a stop whose capture is TRUNCATED (the truncation guard), or a
# `_leafng != 0` (a NON-GLOBAL leaf would kill H-G by value before any press - TLBIASID WOULD
# evict its stale entry - which is why 1015 published the bit RAW).
# =================================================================================================
#
# THE 1015 VERDICT CELLS (docs/1015-design.md §3a - this table was §3c before the ENTRY-ONLY
# renumber; tools/check_1015_capture.py and docs/1015-harness.md still cite it as §3c - SAME
# table, old number).  Read on the TAIL ROWS-OWN values (_wdn >= 0x400, _wdva == 0xe6000,
# _wdseen=1, _wdatok=1), NEVER on a whole-run aggregate (the 1008/1009 measurement defect, not
# repeated).  The 1014 tail is NOT uniform - the last two rows are DIFFERENT faults inside a
# different dyld (far~0x3a0xxxxx), so the filter is BOTH the ordinal AND far == 0xe6000:
#   V-AT0  the control read (_wdctlat) did not come back `par & 1 == 0` with
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) == 0x80080000`, or _wdctlat is unpublished, or _wdatok=0
#          => AT_INSTRUMENT_BROKEN: WITHHOLD V-AT1..4.  (SILENCE_IS_A_READING: the AT-s
#          absence is a reading only because the control proves success is silent-but-readable.)
#   V-AT1  _wdatpar FAULTS (`par & 1 == 1`) while _wdatparpr SUCCEEDS (`par & 1 == 0`)
#          => H-G CONFIRMED AT THE HARDWARE - the translation is NOT the user leaf.  The MMU
#          will not translate 0xe6000 for a user write even though the walked leaf is
#          ap=0b11/apx=0/nG=0/domain=0; the privileged view succeeds, so this is a user-AP
#          decision made from a translation that is not the leaf the walk reads => a stale/other
#          entry.  With _leafng == 0 the culprit is a GLOBAL entry surviving TLBIASID.
#   V-AT2  _wdatpar SUCCEEDS to the leaf-s OWN PA (`par & 1 == 0` and
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) == 0x841e9000`) => TRANSLATION_IS_CORRECT_YET_THE_STORE_FAULTED:
#          H-G REFUTED - the store-s FS=15 is NOT produced by this translation, so the probe-s
#          key/ordering (g_abtpte_curva) or the DFSR/DFAR pair describes a DIFFERENT access.
#          NOT a page-table defect - hand back to the observer (§3b-s P-X1 -> H-X, SCTLR/PRRR).
#   V-AT3  _wdatpar SUCCEEDS to a DIFFERENT PA (`par & 1 == 0` and
#          `(par & 0xfffff000) != 0x841e9000`) => WRONG_TRANSLATION_IN_THE_TLB: a TLB entry is
#          serving a translation the tables no longer hold.  Same conclusion as V-AT1, reached
#          from the PA side, and it NAMES the stale PA by value.
#   V-AT4  BOTH views fault (`par & 1 == 1` on both) => the entry is not merely user-denied; a
#          domain/invalid mechanism is in play.  Re-rank toward perm-static cause #2 (SCTLR/PRRR)
#          before §7.
# THE PASSIVE LADDER (§3b) rides the SAME rows and is WITHHELD unless _wdctlok=1, _wdseen=1 and
# (for the lineage cells) _wdmapok=1: P-CTL (_wdctlok=0 or _wdseen=0) => NO_PERM_WITNESS, no
# verdict; P-AT (_wdatok=0) => NO_AT (the deciding table is unavailable, regardless of
# everything below); P-D1 _wddom != 0 => L1_DOMAIN_NONZERO; P-D2 _wddom==0 and (_wddacr & 3) != 1
# => DACR_NOT_CLIENT (H-P CONFIRMED, the only DACR writer is src/mmu.c:4921); P-D3 _wddom==0 and
# (_wddacr & 3) == 1 => DACR_CLIENT (H-P-s domain form KILLED); P-T1 (_wdttbcr & 7) != 2 =>
# TTBCR_NOT_N2 (every entry_ttbr_base derivation must be re-read); P-T2 (_wdttbcr&7)==2 and
# _wdva >= _wdsplit => ROUTED_TO_TTBR1; P-T3 the masked _wdttbr0 != 0x81a86000 => TTBR0_MOVED_
# AT_ABORT; P-M1 _wdmapok=1 and _wdthrmap != _wdttbr0 => THREAD_PMAP_NE_TTBR0; P-L1 _wdsmall=1
# and (_wdapx!=0 or _wdap!=0b11) => LEAF_NOT_USER_WRITABLE (contradicts 1014-s stable
# double-read); P-L3 _wdsmall=0 => NOT_A_SMALL_PAGE; P-S1 (_wdsctlr bits TRE(28)/AFE(1)/M(0))
# differs from the console-install reading => SCTLR_MOVED (H-X is live); P-X1 all of
# P-D3/P-T1..P-T3/P-M1/P-L1/P-L3/P-S1 killed AND V-AT2 => INPUTS_ALL_CORRECT_STILL_FAULTS (the
# next rung is the observer, not the pmap).
# A NOTE ON _leafng: `_leafng == 0` (GLOBAL) is NOT by itself a verdict - it is the PRECONDITION
# of H-G, published RAW so the reader sees it without decoding the packed leaf.  `_leafng == 1`
# (non-global) would KILL H-G by value before any press: if the leaf were ASID-tagged, TLBIASID
# WOULD evict its stale entry.  The checker asserts _leafng == 0 at the storm as H-G-s
# precondition (the 1014 leaf-s bit11 is 0).
# The filter is the rung-s provenance statement: the recorder keys on 1013-s g_abtpte_curva
# (_wdva) AND 1014-s storm identity, because the 24576-entry channel would otherwise be spent
# before the storm (the 998 cap, the 1007 ladder lesson, [[mi4-measurement-defects]]).
#
# KEYS (the fixed keyspace, docs/1015-design.md §2a): the 27 permission-INPUTS/AT-PAR cells
# wdn/wdva/wddacr/wddom/wdttbcr/wdsplit/wdttbr0/wdttbr1/wdl1/wdleaf/wdap/wdapx/wdtex/wdcb/
# wdsmall/wdpcpu/wdthrmap/wdmapok/wdseen/wdctl/wdctlok/wdempty/wdatok/wdatpar/wdatparpr/
# wdctlat/wdsctlr; the H-G precondition cell xnu_live_abt_leafng; and the THREE OWED-1014-FIX
# keys xnu_live_abt_wwpre/wwpost/wwmoved (published from entry_note_abt_wleaf so that 1013-s
# _wwnoproof becomes a READING - the pre- and post-call TTBR0 bases plus a moved flag - rather
# than the bare, polarity-inverted 1 that 1014-s HARD #1 adjudicated).  No two probes share a
# key: every one of the 31 greps to 0 tree-wide before it was added.
# THE THREE OWED-1014-FIX KEYS are 1015-s only ENTRY-SIDE correction and they are the reason the
# 1013 W-APEX cell is re-read this rung: 1014 could not form a (VA, L1, L2) pair because W-APEX-s
# own provenance cell contradicted the SAME row-s pmp cells.
#
# VERIFIED BY VALUE (scripts/build_1015b.sh + this park - read the two scripts, this list is a

#  OWN compiler-emitted NEON then faults. records/1021-fpu-rootcause.txt.)
# Switch set is 1020b-s VERBATIM (STAGE90_XNU_UNDEF_RAISE=1, STAGE90_XNU_UNDEF_DIRECT=1,

# STAGE90_XNU_GENERAL_REGS=1.
# **THE FIX IS A FLAG, NOT A -D, AND NOT -mgeneral-regs-only.** -mgeneral-regs-only is
# AARCH64-ONLY in clang and is SILENTLY DROPPED for armv7 (measured: byte-identical codegen
# with and without it), so a build that used it would read as ON and re-measure 0x8047b0ac.
# The measured fix is -msoft-float, the exact spelling Apple-s own ARM kernel CFLAGS_ARM uses
# (external/xnu-hd2-darwin13/xnu/makedefs/MakeInc.def:377-379). It is the -mfloat-abi=softfp
# half of the pre-rung flags that lets clang allocate FP registers; -msoft-float removes the
# FP register file from the allocator, so no vld1/vst1/vldr/vstr/vpush/vpop is emitted.
# OFF appends NOTHING to CC_ARGS/CXX_ARGS, so the arrays are exactly the pre-rung ones

# nothing about this half.

# armed-d13-35a7e83e  -  1028: THE H2 FIX - GIVE THE INITIAL USER-STACK BLOCK ONE WORD OF HEADROOM.
# 1027-s press RAN and its own console was recovered (records/1027-press-read.txt). The reading is
# H2 (off-the-end), BY VALUE, at the launchctl[2] stack fault:
#   lookup_far=0  far_in_map=1  entry=[0,0)  e2=[0x2bce1000,0x2bde0000)
#   e2_hi == far == ustack == 0x2bde0000     map == taskmap == 0xc0005688
# The user-stack region is [0x2bce1000,0x2bde0000) and its EXCLUSIVE TOP IS far; the word just
# below (far-4) IS in the map. H1 (wrong map) is refuted by value (map == taskmap). By source,
# create_unix_stack sets p->user_stack to the requested top and allocates [user_stack-size,
# user_stack), and exec_copyout_strings places the initial argv/env block with its TOP at
# p->user_stack - so the word AT user_stack is UNOWNED and userspace-s touch of it faults.
# docs/1028-design.md.
# Switch set is 1027-s VERBATIM with **ONE NEW SWITCH: STAGE90_XNU_H2_STACK_HEADROOM=1**.
# THE ARM (ONE POOL EDIT, one switch), staged by tools/patch_d13_h2_stack_headroom.py:
#   kern_exec.c -> in create_unix_stack, the FIXED `mach_vm_allocate(map,&addr,size,...)` extent
#                  becomes `size + 16`. The base, the block, sp, p->user_stack, and the guard
